Title: Analytics Engineer (w/m/d)
Description:
Daten sind für uns kein Nebenprodukt, sondern ein zentraler Erfolgsfaktor und das Fundament unserer KI-Strategie. Als Analytics Engineer (m/w/d) bist du die treibende Kraft hinter unserer Datenplattform: Du baust und pflegst die Datenmodelle, auf denen Analytics, Reporting und Data Science im gesamten Unternehmen aufsetzen. Mit robusten, skalierbaren und vertrauenswürdigen Pipelines sorgst du dafür, dass alle Teams auf einer sauberen, konsistenten Datenbasis arbeiten – und machst unser Unternehmen damit messbar datengetriebener und KI-fähiger.

Schwerpunkte deiner Rolle


Du entwickelst und pflegst dbt-Modelle und Datenpipelines, die Rohdaten in saubere, dokumentierte und verlässliche Datensätze überführen
Du etablierst eine Single Source of Truth für Kennzahlen und sorgst dafür, dass alle Teams mit denselben vertrauenswürdigen Zahlen arbeiten
Du designst skalierbare Data-Warehouse-Schemata (dimensionales Modell, Fakten/Dimensionen) mit Fokus auf Performance, Skalierbarkeit und Kosten
Du integrierst Daten aus unternehmensweiten Systemen in unseren Data Lake / unser Data Warehouse und führst systemübergreifende Datenflüsse zusammen
Du baust und pflegst Dashboards und Reports (z. B. in Metabase), die Fachbereiche zu eigenständigem, datenbasiertem Handeln befähigen
Du sicherst und verbesserst kontinuierlich die Datenqualität – inkl. Monitoring, dbt-Tests und klarer Standards für zuverlässige Analytics- und KI-Use-Cases
Du arbeitest eng mit Operations, Produkt, Engineering und dem Leadership-Team zusammen und übersetzt Business-Fragen in aussagekräftige Metriken und Analysen


Das bringst du mit


Mehrjährige Erfahrung als Analytics Engineer, Data Engineer, Data Scientist oder in einer vergleichbaren datengetriebenen Rolle
Sehr gute SQL-Skills sowie praktische Erfahrung mit dbt in Produktionsumgebungen (inkl. Tests, Dokumentation, CI/CD und GitHub-Workflows)
Fundiertes Verständnis von Datenmodellierung, Data-Warehouse-Design, ETL-/ELT-Prozessen und der Auswirkungen auf Skalierbarkeit und Reporting-Performance
Praxiserfahrung mit Snowflake (oder vergleichbaren Cloud-DWH-/Data-Lake-Lösungen) sowie einem BI-Tool wie Metabase, Power BI oder Tableau
Kenntnisse in Python oder einem ähnlichen Skript-/Analyse-Tool zur tiefergehenden Analyse, Prototyping und Automatisierung
Fähigkeit, komplexe Daten und Zusammenhänge verständlich zu erklären – hohe Service- und Lösungsorientierung im Umgang mit internen Stakeholdern
Strukturierte, selbstständige Arbeitsweise, Ownership-Mentalität und sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift


Das bieten wir Dir

Arbeitskultur

Dich erwartet eine lösungsorientierte und datengetriebene Arbeitsweise, eine offene Feedbackkultur sowie ein starker Teamspirit. Zwei vom gesamten StackFuel-Team gewählte Trustees unterstützen Dich bei Fragen und Anliegen als neutrale, vertrauliche Anlaufstelle.

Ownership

Übernehme ab dem ersten Tag Verantwortung, bringe Deine eigenen Ideen aktiv ein, gestalte Prozesse nachhaltig und präge unsere Abläufe maßgeblich mit.

Hybrides Arbeiten

Wir arbeiten in einem hybriden Modell und sind üblicherweise 3 Tage pro Woche vor Ort in unserem Office in Berlin.

Workation

Bis zu 10 Tage pro Jahr kannst Du von überall aus der EU, dem EWR und der Türkei arbeiten.

Raum für Austausch

Regelmäßiger Austausch im Team, saisonale Feiern und eine immer gut gefüllte Küche sorgen für ein lebendiges Miteinander.

Weiterentwicklung

Absolviere unsere Online-Trainings, um Deine fachlichen Fähigkeiten auszubauen und Dich zur Expert:in für Daten und KI zu entwickeln.

  • Fähigkeit, komplexe Daten und Zusammenhänge verständlich zu erklären – hohe Service- und Lösungsorientierung im Umgang mit internen Stakeholdern
  • Strukturierte, selbstständige Arbeitsweise, Ownership-Mentalität und sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

Arbeitskultur

Ownership

Wir arbeiten in einem hybriden Modell und sind üblicherweise 3 Tage pro Woche vor Ort in unserem Office in Berlin.

Workation

Bis zu 10 Tage pro Jahr kannst Du von überall aus der EU, dem EWR und der Türkei arbeiten.

Regelmäßiger Austausch im Team, saisonale Feiern und eine immer gut gefüllte Küche sorgen für ein lebendiges Miteinander.

Absolviere unsere Online-Trainings, um Deine fachlichen Fähigkeiten auszubauen und Dich zur Expert:in für Daten und KI zu entwickeln.

Gestalte mit uns die Zukunft von e-Health als Data Analyst (m/w/d)

Wir von docmetric suchen ausgezeichnete Data Analysts, die von unserer Mission "Niemand soll leiden oder gar sterben, nur weil einmal irgendwann, irgendwo wichtige medizinische Informationen fehlen.", getrieben sind. Es ist Deine Leidenschaft mittels neuester Tech-Stacks und Tools das Gesundheitswesen zu digitalisieren? Du hast Spaß an der Arbeit in einem interdisziplinären Team mit ausgeprägter Start-Up-Mentalität? Dann freuen wir uns auf Deine Bewerbung!

Dein Beitrag


Als Data-Analyst bist Du für die Bewertung von Datenquellen und die programmatische Aufbereitung, Anreicherung und Normalisierung von Daten in Python zuständig
Dabei verantwortest du die kontinuierliche Optimierung der Datenqualität und unterstützt uns beim Aufbau und der Weiterentwicklung interner Datenbanken und Datenstrukturen
Du analysierst strukturierte und unstrukturierte Daten aus einer Vielzahl von Quellen des Gesundheitswesens
Durch die Erstellung und Pflege von Reports und Dashboards übersetzt du Anforderungen interner und externer Stakeholder in die Welt der Daten


Das Bringst Du Mit


Abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich der (Medizin-) Informatik, Mathematik, Naturwissenschaften oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation
Ein agiles Mindset und eine Leidenschaft für die Analyse von Daten
Erfahrung mit Python, Pandas, SQL sind ein Muss; Erfahrung mit Elasticsearch (oder vergleichbaren NoSQL Datenbanken) und PowerBI sind von Vorteil
Mindestens 3 Jahre Berufserfahrung im Bereich Data Analytics, idealerweise in der Arbeit mit Gesundheitsdaten
Gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (mind. B1)


Das Kannst Du Von Uns Erwarten


Sinn und Zweck: Werde Teil einer wichtigen Mission. An der Schnittstelle von Gesundheitswesen und Digitalisierung gestalten wir die Zukunft von e-Health.
Attraktive Standorte mit echten Communities: Bei uns stehen die Menschen und der Zusammenhalt im Mittelpunkt. Hierfür bieten wir Dir attraktive Standorte.
Sicherheit: Wir bieten Dir einen sicheren Arbeitsplatz in einem krisenfesten Marktumfeld.
Flache Hierarchien: Best of Both Worlds - Wir sind ein Konzern mit stabilen Strukturen und absoluter Expertise, aber bieten Dir gleichzeitig ein agiles Umfeld mit flachen Hierarchien.
Gestaltungsspielraum: Du kannst in spannenden Projekten viel bewegen. Wir bieten Dir vielfältige Weiterentwicklungsmöglichkeiten und langfristige Perspektiven.
Rundum-Paket: Mitarbeiterrabatte, ein ausgereiftes Feel-Good-Management sowie weitere standortspezifische Angebote.

Title: Risk Analyst B2B (m/f/d)
Description:
Company Description

Everyone’s story matters. Come shape your story with us at Riverty.

But where does that take you?

To one of our 30 hybrid workspaces – designed for exchanging ideas, learning from others, and shaping the way we work. An international community of over 4,000 people, representing almost 80 nationalities across 11 countries. United by one mission: Combining empathy, advanced technology and data-driven insights to keep people and businesses in flow. With payments made for them. So that they don’t have to worry about it.

And there’s more. We are part of the family-owned Bertelsmann group. Established. Corporate. In a fast-paced industry. We enable flexible payments in various industries, simplifying the financial management of known brands and helping people repay debt to build financial confidence. In short: shaping FinTech.

Job Description

We are looking for a

Risk Analyst – B2B (m/f/d) (unlimited, full-time)

Join our team at our location in Berlin, Verl, Amsterdam, Heerenveen, Luxembourg – flexible working conditions available

We are looking for a Risk Analyst – B2B for our Risk Analytics team in the Client Underwriting Unit with a hands-on attitude that is keen to have an impact on our risk assessment by mitigating risk in terms of affordability / solvency for the B2B end customer in a balanced risk decision environment.

The focus of the team lies on contributing to the definition of our risk strategy in the B2B space, its (further) development and the constant monitoring and steering according to it.

In line with Riverty's overarching vision to become the most human-centric FinTech, the Risk Analytics team develops appropriate customer risk strategies for different markets and ecosystems. The organization is characterized by technology-based rapid learning and decision-making cycles and guided by a strong common purpose to jointly create value for all stakeholders. Strong footprint in DACH/NL & Nordics with further expansion ambition within Europe, e. g. UK , Italy.

The Main Responsibilities Are


Lead the redesign of B2B underwriting models, including scorecards, decision engines, rule sets, and rating methodologies.
Continuous improvement of underlying data analysis and existing business processes to support our B2B product expansion in new countries.
Build harmonized multi-country credit frameworks while adapting strategies to local market dynamics, regulations, and data availability.
Establish best practices for ad-hoc & deep-dive analyses.
Partner with Data Science to build and deploy next-generation ML-based credit models for customers in the B2B space.
Enhance reporting frameworks, dashboards, and risk KPIs to support leadership decision-making.
You will work in close collaboration with other functions such as Risk Product, Fraud Risk Steering, Data Science, Finance, etc.
The function is reporting into the Risk Analytics & Steering Lead, which is reporting into the Functional Unit Lead for Client Underwriting.
The location is flexible, preferred locations are Germany (Berlin, Verl), Luxembourg or the Netherlands (Amsterdam, Heerenveen).


Qualifications

What you should bring:


Significant experience in B2B risk analytics, ideally within BNPL, lending, payments, or fintech.
Relevant experience in a credit risk management environment.
Expertise in using various programming languages (SQL / Python / R) to perform complex analytical tasks.
Experience in working in an international, agile, cross-functional environment.
You embrace new technology and understand the potential of data and advanced analytics.
You are a strategic thinker with vision and a strong operator - you get things done.
Language: English (mandatory); German or Dutch is a plus.


Additional Information

Disclosure requirements pertaining to the collection of your personal data:

Responsible for processing the information provided in your application is the company specified in the job advertisement, with its registered office as indicated. The company processes your data for the purpose of establishing an employment relationship on the basis of Art. 6 (1) b GDPR / Section 26 (1) sentence 1 BDSG.

The retention period for your data is determined by the statutory time limits applicable in the respective country, beginning upon completion of the recruitment process. You can find these here.

You can contact the company’s Data Protection Officer at the above-mentioned postal address.

Further information on data protection and your rights can be found here.

Description:
Deloitte bietet führende Prüfungs- und Beratungsleistungen in Audit & Assurance, Tax & Legal, Consulting und Advisory - für nahezu 90 % der Fortune Global 500® und zahlreiche private Unternehmen. Wir liefern innovative Denkansätze, lösen komplexe Herausforderungen und fördern nachhaltiges Wachstum. Mit rund 470.000 Mitarbeitenden weltweit eröffnen wir hervorragende Karrierechancen - getragen von einem starken „Wir“ und einer Vielfalt an Perspektiven und Fähigkeiten.

Du willst im Bereich Consulting – Artificial Intelligence and Data Kunden helfen, strategische Entscheidungen zu AI & Data zu treffen? Unser Team unterstützt von der Definition der AI & Data-Strategie über die Implementierung groß angelegter Datenplattformen und Visual Analytics Programme bis hin zu Einführung smarter "Age of With"-Lösungen. Sichere unseren gemeinsamen Erfolg und mach mit uns den Unterschied: als Consultant Business Intelligence (m/w/d).

Standorte: Berlin, Düsseldorf, Frankfurt (Main), Hamburg, Hannover, Köln, München und Stuttgart.

Dein Impact:

Als Consultant Business & AI Insights (m/w/d) steigst du in die Welte von KI und Analytics ein und baust erste Erfahrungen aus. Du arbeitest du im Team an kundenrelevante Lösungen mit, die einen Impact erzeugen. Lösungen, die auf Basis komplexer Daten echte Orientierung geben – von der ersten Idee über Prototypen bis zur produktiven Anwendung und dem zugehörigen Betrieb.


Beratung: Du unterstützt Unternehmen bei der Entwicklung und Umsetzung von KI- und Analytics-Lösungen und übersetzt Anforderungen in strukturierte Lösungsansätze.
Lösungsdesign: Gemeinsam mit Deinem Team entwickelst Du Lösungdesigns für KI- und Analytics-Anwendungen, Datenpipelines und nutzerorientierte Analyticsanwendungen.
Entwicklung: Du arbeitest hands-on in Kundenprojekten mit und unterstützt die Entwicklung von Prototypen sowie produktiven Daten- und KI-Lösungen.
Datenanalyse & Analytics Engineering: Du analysierst Daten, entwickelst Modelle, Algorithmen und Dashboards und machst Erkenntnisse für Kunden nutzbar.
Innovation & Zusammenarbeit: Du bringst Dich aktiv ins Team ein, arbeitest an hochwertigen Projektergebnissen mit und verfolgst neue Technologietrends und bringst Ideen ein, wie neue Ansätze in Kundenprojekten sinnvoll eingesetzt werden können.

Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium in Informatik, Statistik, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Data Analytics oder einem vergleichbaren Fachgebiet; alternativ relevante Praxiserfahrung im KI- und Analytics-Umfeld
Erste praktische Erfahrung in KI-/ML-Projekten, Data Analytics oder Analytics Engineering sowie gute Kenntnisse in Python und SQL
Idealerweise Kenntnisse in Cloud-Technologien, DevOps, MLOps, Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, Frontend-Technologien, GenAI-Frameworks oder RAG-Architekturen
Idealerweise Erfahrung mit Datenmodellierung, ETL, Datenplattformen wie Databricks oder Snowflake sowie BI-Tools wie Power BI, Qlik, Tableau oder QuickSight
Deutsch und Englisch verhandlungssicher in Wort und Schrift sowie die Fähigkeit, analytische Ergebnisse verständlich zu kommunizieren und erfolgreich im Team zu arbeiten


Deine Chance:


Spannende Aufgaben in einem innovativen Umfeld mit hochmotivierten Kolleg:innen, die sich schon jetzt auf deine Impulse freuen
Gute Rahmenbedingungen mit attraktivem Gehalt und zahlreichen Zusatzleistungen, z. B. Firmen-Smartphone zur privaten Nutzung, Fahrradleasing und Corporate Benefits
Work-Life-Balance durch mobiles Arbeiten, Sabbaticals, Mitarbeiter:innen-Events, Well-being Angebote wie z. B. Gesundheitstage, Kooperationen mit Fitness-Anbietern und den Familienservice, der dich bei privaten Herausforderungen unterstützt
Exzellente Weiterbildung an der Deloitte University, in On- und Offline-Seminaren und im Rahmen der Berufsqualifikation, zum Beispiel durch diverse Zertifizierungslehrgänge im Bereich PowerBi, Teableau, Qlik und Scrum
Vielfältige Gestaltungsspielräume und aktive Förderung einer inklusiven Unternehmenskultur – u. a. durch unsere Diversity & Inclusion Mitarbeiter:innen-Netzwerke

Title: Senior Analyst — People & Workforce Intelligence (PWI) (d/f/m)
Description:
Personio's intelligent HR platform helps small and medium-sized organizations unlock the power of people by making complicated, time-consuming tasks simple and efficient. Our team of 1,500 Personios is building user-friendly products that delight our 15,000+ customers and their 1.5 million employees. Ready to make an impact from day one?

This role requires 2 days per week in the office and is based in Munich, Berlin or Dublin.

We empower Personio's decision-making with reliable data and strategic insights, while improving productivity through scalable infrastructure and automation. Be part of our transformative journey in HR technology, where your contributions shape how a leading people management platform understands its own workforce.

The Senior Analyst — PWI sits within the Data, Systems & AI department and partners closely with the People & Workplace Intelligence (PWI) function. Bitte beachte, dass für diese Stelle eine Arbeitserlaubnis für Deutschland erforderlich ist.

Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium in Data Science, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Informatik, Statistik, Mathematik, Physik oder einen vergleichbaren Werdegang.
Du hast bereits einige Jahre in datenanalytischen Rollen gearbeitet und eigene Analysen von der Fragestellung bis zur Handlungsempfehlung verantwortet. Wir suchen jemanden mit solider Praxis, der eigenständig arbeitet und in der Rolle weiter wächst.

Title: (Junior) Energy Data Scientist – Energiedaten & Automatisierung (MSB) (m/w/d)
Description:
Über uns

Bei VREY bauen wir das EnergyOS für Mehrfamilienhäuser.

In Deutschland stehen über 3,3 Millionen Mehrparteienhäuser – und sie sind das schwarze Loch der Energiewende. <1% Solardurchdringung. <2% Smart Metering. Kaum Flexibilität oder intelligentes Energiemanagement.

Gleichzeitig zwingt die Regulierung Eigentümer zu massiven Investitionen: Solar wird zur Pflicht, Smart Meter müssen in den nächsten 5 Jahren flächendeckend ausgerollt werden, Heizung und Mobilität elektrifizieren sich. Das Mehrfamilienhaus wird vom Betongold zum aktiven Teil der dezentralen Energieinfrastruktur.

Was fehlt, ist ein integriertes System, das diesen Wandel wirtschaftlich und operativ beherrschbar macht.

VREY kombiniert zertifizierten Messstellenbetrieb mit eigener Software und ermöglicht Eigentümern erstmals, ihren selbst erzeugten Solarstrom direkt an ihre Mieter zu verkaufen – einfach und ohne selbst zum Energieversorger zu werden (


42b EnWG).


Damit wird regulatorischer Zwang zu einer profitablen und planbaren Chance:


Zweistellige Renditen und Wertsteigerung für Eigentümer,
~20 % Stromkostenersparnis für Mieter, und
digitale Infrastruktur für Speicher, Wärmepumpen und Flexibilität.


Bereits heute betreuen wir eine dreistellige Anzahl an Projekten - darunter die größten Bestandshalter und Wohnungsbaugenossenschaften - in allen 16 Bundesländern. Damit gehören wir nach kürzester Zeit zu den führenden Anbietern im Markt.

Im Zuge unserer Seed-Finanzierung haben wir 3,3 Mio. € von führenden Impact- und Energy-VCs (u. a. Rubio Impact Ventures, HTGF, Kopa Ventures) eingesammelt. Mit dem frischen Kapital gehen wir in die nächste Wachstumsphase und bauen unser Team gezielt aus.

Wir stehen am Anfang eines strukturellen Marktumbruchs. Wer heute die Energieinfrastruktur im Mehrfamilienhaus definiert, prägt sie für Jahrzehnte. Werde Teil von VREY und baue mit uns das führende EnergyOS.

Dein Profil


Du hast bereits erste Erfahrungen im Consulting (Tier 1/Tier 2), High-Growth Start-ups (idealerweise Operations oder Prozessoptimierung), oder im Projektmanagement gesammelt und ein abgeschlossenes Studium in einem relevanten Bereich
Erfahrung oder starkes Interesse an Datenanalyse, Automatisierung und KI/LLM-Agents (z. B. Python, APIs, Umgang mit größeren Datenmengen)
Sehr gutes Zahlen- und Datenverständnis; Freude daran, Datenqualitätsprobleme systematisch und datenbasiert zu durchdringen
Idealerweise Erfahrung in der Energiewirtschaft / Marktkommunikation (MaKo, Messstellenbetrieb, GGV/Mieterstrom, Bilanzierung) - oder die klare Bereitschaft, sich schnell tief einzuarbeiten.
Strukturierte, gewissenhafte Arbeitsweise: du gibst dich nicht mit „Job abgeschlossen" zufrieden, sondern prüfst, ob das Ergebnis inhaltlich stimmt
Eigenverantwortung und Ownership-Mentalität: du übernimmst einen Bereich, statt nur Aufgaben abzuarbeiten; und strebst danach, dein volles Potenzial in diesem Bereich zu entfalten
Du suchst bewusst keinen 9-to-5-Job, sondern willst in einem schnelllebigen, gründer-nahen Umfeld Verantwortung übernehmen, Strukturen aufbauen und das Wachstum aktiv mitgestalten
Du bist in Berlin (oder bereit umzuziehen) - unser Büro ist unser Homebase
Du sprichst Deutsch und Englisch fließend


Deine Aufgaben

Mission der Rolle

Du sitzt an einer unternehmenskritischen Schnittstelle: tief drin im operativen Energiedaten-Geschäft und mit dem Mandat, dieses Geschäft durch eigene Datenanalysen, Tools und KI-Agenten grundlegend zu automatisieren. Du siehst den unmittelbaren Effekt deiner Arbeit - jedes gelöste Ticket bringt ein Projekt näher an die Abrechnung, jeder gebaute Agent spart dem ganzen Team Zeit.


Datenanalyse & Automatisierung durch eigene KI-Agents
Du analysierst Messwerte, Zählerstände und Versandjobs auf Muster, Ausreißer und wiederkehrende Fehlerursachen
Du übersetzt dieses Wissen in KI-Agenten, die Fehler eigenständig diagnostizieren und Lösungswege vorschlagen oder umsetzen
Du bist der fachliche Motor der Messstellenbetrieb (MSB) App: du erkennst aus dem Tagesgeschäft, welche Features fehlen, spezifizierst sie und bringst sie mittels eigener Entwicklung ins Produkt
Operative Energiedaten-Verantwortung bis zur Abrechnungsreife
Du bringst Projekte Monat für Monat zur Abrechnungsreife: fehlende oder unplausible Messwerte korrigieren, Ersatzwerte über Referenzprofile bilden, Werte maskieren und neu berechnen lassen
Du legst Versandjobs an, überwachst deren Status und plausibilisierst die Daten nach jedem Fix
Du arbeitest dabei täglich in der App unserer Partner und unserer internen MSB App entlang der marktüblichen MSB-Prozesse
Ownership & Skalierung des MSB-Bereichs
Du verantwortest alle Energiedaten-Tickets intern (Projekt- und Abrechnungsteams) wie extern (VNB, Lieferanten, ÜNB) - von Annahme über Priorisierung bis Lösung - und bist Eskalationsinstanz bei komplexen Fällen
Du behältst die MSB-relevanten Postfächer im Blick, ordnest Nachrichten von Marktpartnern den richtigen Vorgängen zu und stellst sicher, dass keine fristrelevante Kommunikation untergeht
Du lernst Praktikant:innen und Werkstudent:innen in Prozesse, Tools und die MSB Bibel ein, begleitest sie bis zur Eigenständigkeit und hältst die Doku aktuell


Benefits

Verantwortung: zentrale Rolle in unserem Kernteam

Vergütung: Kompetitives Gehalt und Anteile am Unternehmen

Startdatum: so bald wie möglich, unbefristet

Team & Benefits: Lustiges Team, Tech Budget von 2 Tsd.€, regelmäßige Team Events und Learning Lunches, Gratis Getränke, Deutschlandticket

Weitere Vorteile: Tägliche Zusammenarbeit mit den Gründern, Getränke & Snacks, Personalverantwortung und die Möglichkeit, das Unternehmen von Grund auf mitzugestalten

Das Wichtigste: Du brennst für Unternehmertum und Start-ups. Bei uns entstehen keine endlosen Slide-Decks oder rein theoretische Modelle – wir bauen ein Unternehmen und machen tagtäglich einen großen Schritt nach vorne. Wenn du von Tag 1 an etwas Großem mitgestalten möchtest, bist du bei uns genau richtig.

Noch ein paar Worte zum Schluss

Bei VREY sind wir davon überzeugt, dass Vielfalt uns als Unternehmen und Gesellschaft stärkt. Weder bei der Einstellung noch während des Beschäftigungsverhältnisses werden Entscheidungen auf Basis von Hautfarbe, Religion oder religiösen Glaubens, ethnischer oder nationaler Herkunft, Behinderung oder Alter getroffen.

Auch wenn du nicht alle Anforderungen erfüllst, zögere nicht, dich trotzdem zu bewerben. Wenn du von unserer Mission begeistert bist und glaubst, einen Beitrag leisten zu können, möchten wir von dir hören!

Der beste Weg ist eine warme Intro: Kennst du jemand, der auf diese Rolle passt? Empfiehl die Person und erhalte 3.000€ bei erfolgreicher Einstellung.

Voraussetzung: Die Person ist uns noch nicht bei uns im Prozess und wird offiziell vorgeschlagen. Auszahlung nach bestandener Probezeit. Bei mehrfacher Nennung zählt die erste eingegangene Empfehlung.

  • Du suchst bewusst keinen 9-to-5-Job, sondern willst in einem schnelllebigen, gründer-nahen Umfeld Verantwortung übernehmen, Strukturen aufbauen und das Wachstum aktiv mitgestalten
  • Du bist in Berlin (oder bereit umzuziehen) - unser Büro ist unser Homebase
  • Du sprichst Deutsch und Englisch fließend

Deine Aufgaben

Mission der Rolle

Du sitzt an einer unternehmenskritischen Schnittstelle: tief drin im operativen Energiedaten-Geschäft und mit dem Mandat, dieses Geschäft durch eigene Datenanalysen, Tools und KI-Agenten grundlegend zu automatisieren.   • Datenanalyse & Automatisierung durch eigene KI-Agents
  • Du analysierst Messwerte, Zählerstände und Versandjobs auf Muster, Ausreißer und wiederkehrende Fehlerursachen
  • Du übersetzt dieses Wissen in KI-Agenten, die Fehler eigenständig diagnostizieren und Lösungswege vorschlagen oder umsetzen
  • Du bist der fachliche Motor der Messstellenbetrieb (MSB) App: du erkennst aus dem Tagesgeschäft, welche Features fehlen, spezifizierst sie und bringst sie mittels eigener Entwicklung ins Produkt
  • Operative Energiedaten-Verantwortung bis zur Abrechnungsreife
  • Du bringst Projekte Monat für Monat zur Abrechnungsreife: fehlende oder unplausible Messwerte korrigieren, Ersatzwerte über Referenzprofile bilden, Werte maskieren und neu berechnen lassen
  • Du legst Versandjobs an, überwachst deren Status und plausibilisierst die Daten nach jedem Fix
  • Du arbeitest dabei täglich in der App unserer Partner und unserer internen MSB App entlang der marktüblichen MSB-Prozesse
  • Ownership & Skalierung des MSB-Bereichs
  • Du verantwortest alle Energiedaten-Tickets intern (Projekt- und Abrechnungsteams) wie extern (VNB, Lieferanten, ÜNB) - von Annahme über Priorisierung bis Lösung - und bist Eskalationsinstanz bei komplexen Fällen
  • Du behältst die MSB-relevanten Postfächer im Blick, ordnest Nachrichten von Marktpartnern den richtigen Vorgängen zu und stellst sicher, dass keine fristrelevante Kommunikation untergeht
  • Du lernst Praktikant:innen und Werkstudent:innen in Prozesse, Tools und die MSB Bibel ein, begleitest sie bis zur Eigenständigkeit und hältst die Doku aktuell

Benefits

Verantwortung: zentrale Rolle in unserem Kernteam

Vergütung: Kompetitives Gehalt und Anteile am Unternehmen

Startdatum: so bald wie möglich, unbefristet

Team & Benefits: Lustiges Team, Tech Budget von 2 Tsd.€, regelmäßige Team Events und Learning Lunches, Gratis Getränke, Deutschlandticket

Weitere Vorteile: Tägliche Zusammenarbeit mit den Gründern, Getränke & Snacks, Personalverantwortung und die Möglichkeit, das Unternehmen von Grund auf mitzugestalten

Das Wichtigste: Du brennst für Unternehmertum und Start-ups. Bei uns entstehen keine endlosen Slide-Decks oder rein theoretische Modelle – wir bauen ein Unternehmen und machen tagtäglich einen großen Schritt nach vorne. Wenn du von Tag 1 an etwas Großem mitgestalten möchtest, bist du bei uns genau richtig.

Noch ein paar Worte zum Schluss

Bei VREY sind wir davon überzeugt, dass Vielfalt uns als Unternehmen und Gesellschaft stärkt. Weder bei der Einstellung noch während des Beschäftigungsverhältnisses werden Entscheidungen auf Basis von Hautfarbe, Religion oder religiösen Glaubens, ethnischer oder nationaler Herkunft, Behinderung oder Alter getroffen.

Auch wenn du nicht alle Anforderungen erfüllst, zögere nicht, dich trotzdem zu bewerben. Wenn du von unserer Mission begeistert bist und glaubst, einen Beitrag leisten zu können, möchten wir von dir hören!

Der beste Weg ist eine warme Intro: Kennst du jemand, der auf diese Rolle passt? Empfiehl die Person und erhalte 3.000€ bei erfolgreicher Einstellung.

Voraussetzung: Die Person ist uns noch nicht bei uns im Prozess und wird offiziell vorgeschlagen. Auszahlung nach bestandener Probezeit. Bei mehrfacher Nennung zählt die erste eingegangene Empfehlung.

Title: Sr. Product Analyst (m/w/x)
Description:
About Grover

Founded in 2015, Grover enables consumers and businesses across Europe to subscribe to tech devices and comprehensive technology solutions - from individual smartphones, laptops, and wearables to full corporate device setups. The company offers access to over 1,000 unique tech items on flexible and financially convenient terms. A pioneer of the circular economy, Grover refurbishes and recirculates devices to help eliminate e-waste.

To continue this incredible adventure, we are currently looking for a Sr. Product Data Analyst to join our talented Product Team at our Berlin HQ (3 days per week - Tuesday-Thursday).

Reporting to the Product Director, you will act as a key strategic partner for Product, Engineering, and Design, with a specialized focus on optimizing our Acquisition and Retention domains. You will be responsible for enabling data-inspired product decisions that lift Grover’s user experience to a new level and have a considerable business impact. You foster an environment where data is leveraged effectively to shape product strategy, identify opportunities, and measure success. You do so by ensuring each team has access to the right data, delivering high-quality analyses that uncover actionable insights, and championing best practices in experimentation and data-inspired decision-making.

🎯 What You Will Contribute


Domain Expertise: Serve as the primary data partner for the Acquisition and Retention domains, uncovering insights that drive growth and long-term customer loyalty.
Advanced Experimentation: Own the end-to-end A/B testing lifecycle using our experimentation platform, Eppo, ensuring statistical reliability and continuous improvement.
Strategic Insights: Support and consult on company-wide decision-making through deep-dive product insights and behavioral analysis.
KPI Management: Contribute to defining and maintaining Grover's PIs/KPIs, ensuring they are socialized and understood by key stakeholders.
Roadmap Expansion: Drive new high-impact use cases by collaborating with Data Platform, Engineering, and Product teams to align technical solutions with business objectives.


🤝 What You Bring


Analytic Power: A strong background in Product Analytics, ideally in fast-paced scale-up eCommerce and/or digital subscription environments, with a proven track record of delivering impactful insights.
Domain Versatility: Ability and excitement to work across different domains; prior experience supporting Acquisition and Retention is considered a strong plus.
Technical Stack: High proficiency in SQL and experience with data visualization tools like Tableau, Looker, or Power BI. Familiarity with Segment is a plus.
Experimentation Rigor: Proven experience designing and running A/B tests (experience with Eppo is a significant advantage) and measuring the impact of new features.
AI Adaptability: An "AI-first" mindset with an openness to using tools like Claude to fast-track reporting, enhance documentation, and optimize analytical processes.
Project Management: Strong project management skills - you can take a complex question from a vague idea to a structured, delivered insight.
Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English, with the ability to translate complex data into actionable recommendations for both technical and commercial stakeholders.


🚀 The Grover Way - How We Drive Success


Own It: We take ownership seriously and define what success looks like. We drive shared ownership and don't wait - we drive. We keep one another accountable and take responsibility when issues arise.
Challenge, Decide, and Commit: We engage in proactive support, active listening, and healthy conflict to reach the best outcomes. We value diverse perspectives and, once a decision is made, we commit to it fully.
Empower and Grow: We enable, trust, and coach one another toward high performance, always thinking and acting like owners. We seek growth, apply feedback, and support the development of our peers.
Respect, Transparency, and Clarity: We strive for clear, respectful, and open communication with no surprises. We simplify complex information so everyone knows the "what, why, and how".


❤️‍🔥 What You Will Love About Us


BVG monthly discount to drive you everywhere in Berlin
Virtual or In-person Coaching Sessions with the Fürstenberg Institut
Physical health support with Urban Sports Club
Annual learning budget of 750€
15 remote business days per year to work abroad
Exclusive Grover Tech discount for you & your loved ones
Engaging, open office located in Berlin-Schöneberg with regular events
A diverse global team of 75 nationalities (and counting!) - genuinely the nicest group of colleagues who will soon become friends


Embark on a rewarding journey with the Grover Rocketship, where your impact is felt, and together, we cultivate a more circular world. 💚

Grover is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and welcome every applicant, regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, disability, or background.

We are looking forward to e-meeting you! 🚀

Description:
Legal & General (L&G) is a leading UK financial services group and major global investor.



We’ve been safeguarding people’s financial futures since 1836, and strive to build a better society, while improving the lives of our customers and creating value for shareholders.



We are one of the world’s largest asset managers and provide powerful asset origination capabilities. Together, these underpin our retirement and protection solutions: we are an international player in pension risk transfer, in UK and US life insurance, and in UK workplace pensions and retirement income.



Our Group Functions provide the services that all areas of the business need. This requires a talented and diverse team behind the scenes, who enable everyone at L&G to do what they do best. 



Joining us means helping to improve the lives of our customers and contributing to the success of the business every day.





Job Description



We're looking for a Liability Data Analyst to join our Payroll & Reinsurance team within Institutional Retirement. This is an opportunity to work at the heart of Pension Risk Transfer operations, helping ensure complex liability data is accurate, reliable and delivered to the highest standards.



You'll work with a broad range of stakeholders, supporting major pension transactions while helping improve the quality and integrity of data used across the business. Whether you're already experienced in pensions data or looking to further develop your technical analytical skills, this role offers excellent exposure and development opportunities.



What you’ll be doing:



Managing data cleansing, validation and transformation activities
Supporting Pension Risk Transfer transactions from end to end
Consulting with stakeholders to understand data requirements
Improving the quality and integrity of data across systems
Supporting testing activities and documenting operational processes
Maintaining accurate audit trails and governance standards
Delivering timely and accurate data solutions to internal customers
Identifying opportunities to improve processes and ways of working

Who we’re looking for:



Advanced Microsoft Excel skills
Strong analytical and problem-solving capability
Experience working with complex data sets
Ability to manage priorities and meet deadlines
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills
High attention to detail and commitment to quality
Experience with Python, SAS or SQL would be beneficial
Knowledge of Defined Benefit pensions would be advantageous

Whatever your role, we reward performance and behaviour with a package that looks after all the things that are important to you. Here are some of the benefits we offer:



The opportunity to participate in our annual, performance -related bonus plan and valuable share schemes
Generous pension contribution
Life assurance
Healthcare Plan (permanent employees only)
At least 25 days holiday, plus public holidays, 26 days after 2 years’ service. There’s also the option to buy and sell holiday
Competitive family leave
Participate in our electric car scheme, which offers employees the option to hire a brand-new electric car through tax efficient salary sacrifice (permanent employees only)
There are many discounts we offer – both for our own products and at a range of high street stores and online
We’re creating net‑zero carbon workplaces by 2030 by investing in our sustainable, modern offices across the UK, all designed to bring people together and elevate the in‑person experience


Additional Information



At L&G, we believe it's possible to generate positive returns today while helping to build a better future for all.



If you join us, you’ll be part of a welcoming, inclusive culture, with opportunities to collaborate with people of diverse backgrounds, views, and experiences. Guided by leaders with integrity who care about your future and wellbeing. Empowered through initiatives which support people to develop their careers and excel.



We care passionately about outcomes rather than attendance and are therefore open to discussing all kinds of flexible working options including part-time and job shares. Although some roles have limited flexibility due to customer demand, we accommodate requests when we can.



It doesn’t matter if you don’t meet every single criterion in this advert. Instead, think about what you excel at and what else you can bring in terms of strengths, potential and connection to our purpose.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Do you love turning data into meaningful insights? Are you naturally curious, analytical, and passionate about helping businesses make better decisions?

We're looking for a Data Analyst to join our Data & Insights team at Goodwood. Supporting a diverse range of departments across the Estate, you'll help uncover trends, understand customer behaviour, and provide valuable insights that influence business decisions.

No two days are the same at Goodwood, and you'll have the opportunity to work with data from our world-famous events, hospitality venues, leisure businesses, and customer experiences.

What You'll Be Doing

As a Data Analyst, you'll support the delivery of reporting and insights across the business, helping teams better understand performance and identify opportunities for improvement.

Your responsibilities will include:


Working closely with stakeholders to understand their reporting and insight requirements
Analysing data from a variety of sources to identify trends, patterns, and opportunities
Monitoring and reporting on key performance indicators using Power BI and other reporting tools
Producing customer insights to support marketing, sales, and commercial decision-making
Building, analysing, and reporting on survey results
Presenting findings and recommendations in a clear and engaging way, supporting stakeholders to act on insights and drive meaningful outcomes
Support the Data & Insights team with ad hoc analysis, report building and data projects
Help to maintain and continuously improve the accuracy and integrity of key customer data systems


What We're Looking For

We're looking for someone who enjoys solving problems, has a keen eye for detail, and is excited by the opportunity to turn data into actionable insights.

You'll have:


Prior experience using Power BI and advanced Excel skills
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities
The ability to interpret data and communicate findings clearly
Excellent attention to detail and a commitment to data accuracy
Strong communication skills and the confidence to work with a variety of stakeholders
A proactive and curious approach, with a genuine interest in understanding customers and business performance
Strong presentation and communication skills, with the ability to translate data and insights into clear, engaging recommendations that support decision-making and drive positive outcomes


Why join us?

This is a fantastic opportunity to join a collaborative team and make a real impact through data.

At Goodwood, you'll gain exposure to a wide range of business areas while helping teams make informed decisions that enhance both operational performance and customer experience.

If you're passionate about data, curious by nature, and enjoy uncovering the story behind the numbers, we'd love to hear from you.

Title: RFID Analyst
Description:
Because we strive to put people first.

Culture, our way

Technology at Primark

What’s a career at Primark all about? The positive impact you’re making, the experiences you’re having and the people you’re with. You’re our inspiration. Embrace what sets you apart, own your career and develop in ways you never expected. Leave your mark. And do it your way.

Our technology team is actively shaping the next wave of advancements. Engaged with innovative initiatives, your expertise will propel our business into the future. Collaborating with a creative team of tech enthusiasts, you’ll contribute your unique skills to fuel our technological advancements.

What You’ll Get

People are at the heart of what we do here, so it’s essential we provide you with the right environment to perform at your very best.

Let’s talk lifestyle: Healthcare, Potential Bonus, Pension,27 days of leave, plus bank holidays and if you want, you can buy 5 more. Because Primark is all about tailoring to you, we offer Tax Saver Tickets, fitness centre, and a subsidised cafeteria.

What You’ll Do as a RFID Analyst

We want you to feel challenged and inspired. Here, you’ll develop your skills across a range of responsibilities:


Analyze RFID and operational data to identify high-volume continuity merchandise, recommending targeted actions in partnership with supply chain and logistics teams to improve availability and performance.
Evaluate and interpret RFID count saturation test results across departments and depots, providing insights to optimize inventory accuracy and operational effectiveness.
Identify, quantify, and drive value realization opportunities across all phases of RFID implementation, including sales growth, shrink reduction, and process efficiency improvements.
Develop and present robust business case proposals, partnering with Finance to validate benefits, costs, and return on investment.
Leverage industry best practices, vendor partnerships, and external retail networks to shape and deliver the RFID roadmap and future use cases.
Apply predictive analytics and market insights to drive performance improvements, while effectively communicating progress, risks, and opportunities to senior stakeholders and cross-functional teams.


What You’ll Bring

Here at Primark, we want everyone to feel valued – so please bring your authentic self to work, of course with some other key experience and abilities for this role in particular:


Minimum 2 years’ experience working with RFID-generated data, supporting deployments and identifying opportunities for new use cases and business value creation.
Over 5 years’ experience in retail or supply chain environments, with a strong understanding of central functions, operational processes, and performance drivers.
Advanced analytical skills with experience building dashboards and managing complex datasets using Power BI, Tableau, or similar business intelligence tools.
Strong ability to interpret data from multiple sources, draw evidence-based conclusions, and provide actionable recommendations that balance cost, value, and customer experience.

Title: Data Ops Analyst
Description:
Technology at Primark

Our technology team is actively shaping the next wave of advancements. Engaged with innovative initiatives, your expertise will propel our business into the future. Collaborating with a creative team of tech enthusiasts, you’ll contribute your unique skills to fuel our technological advancements.

We are seeking a Data Ops Analyst to join Primark’s Data Platform & Engineering team, supporting the operational reliability, governance and release management of our modern enterprise data platform on Databricks. Working closely with Data Engineering and Platform teams, you will help ensure data products are production-ready, well monitored and fully supportable through effective incident management, deployment coordination and operational controls. This role is ideal for someone with strong analytical and operational skills who is passionate about data platforms, service management, continuous improvement and delivering reliable data services at scale.

What You'll Do


DataOps & Release Management: Support the operational delivery of Primark’s Databricks, dbt Cloud and Azure data platforms by coordinating release readiness, deployment activities, promotion processes and production handovers.
Monitoring & Incident Management: Monitor production data pipelines and platform services, triage incidents and alerts, coordinate escalations and support the timely resolution of operational issues to minimise business impact.
Platform & Environment Support: Coordinate environment readiness, access management and operational support activities while working across Engineering, Platform, Security and SIAM teams to maintain platform stability.
Operational Controls & Documentation: Maintain runbooks, support guides, service documentation and operational dashboards, ensuring data products are fully supportable and production-ready.
Service Performance & Reporting: Track pipeline health, support demand, deployment activity and service performance metrics, providing visibility into operational trends and opportunities for improvement.
Collaboration & Continuous Improvement: Partner with Data Engineers, Platform teams and operational stakeholders to improve reliability, strengthen DataOps processes and promote best practices across the Data & Analytics organisation.
Platform Modernisation & Automation: Support the migration from Teradata to Databricks while driving automation, observability and operational efficiency improvements across monitoring, deployment and support processes.


What You'll Bring


Data Operations Experience (2-4 Years): Experience working in Data Operations, Application Support, Platform Support, Data Engineering Support or a similar operational role within a data and analytics environment.
Data Platform & Technical Knowledge: Understanding of ETL/ELT processes, scheduling, dependencies and production support concepts, with exposure to technologies such as Databricks, dbt Cloud, Azure data services, SQL, Python and Azure DevOps.
Monitoring & Service Management: Experience using monitoring, alerting, incident management, ticketing or service management tools to support operational reliability and service performance.
Release & Environment Management: Knowledge of release management, deployment processes, environment management and operational readiness activities, with a disciplined approach to governance and change control.
Operational Excellence & Documentation: Experience maintaining runbooks, support documentation, handover processes and operational controls that ensure data products are reliable, observable and fully supportable.
Problem Solving & Cross-Functional Collaboration: Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to investigate issues methodically and work effectively across Engineering, Platform, Security, Governance, SIAM and business teams.
Continuous Improvement & Learning Agility: Demonstrated commitment to improving operational processes, reducing recurring issues, increasing automation and building expertise across modern data platforms, DataOps practices and support tooling.

Role Description

An exciting opportunity has arisen for a Pricing Analyst to join our growing Animal Health Technical Pricing Team. Our team is at the heart of achieving the company’s strategy and it is an exciting time for you to join and shape the future of our business.

This is a great role for someone looking to develop their data and analytics skills to drive and improve business outcomes. A great advantage of being a member of the Animal Health Pricing team is the extensive training provided. The UK team has collaborated with the worldwide Allianz Group, to deliver an accreditation scheme designed to train you in all aspects of pricing. From data science modelling in cutting edge software to automating optimisation calculation routines honed across global markets.

Pricing will play a key role in delivering this ambition. We are looking for individuals who have an eye for detail, love working with technology and have a passion for analysing data. You’ll be at the sharp end of our business, delivering analytical models that are used to drive commercial decisions, solve challenging problems, and deliver enhancements to our products and pricing techniques.

Location

This role is based in our Guildford office. This is a hybrid role with expectation of you attending the office one day per week

Salary Information

This role offers a circa range of £41,000 to £43,000 per year. Pay is based on relevant experience, skills for the role, and location. Salary is only one part of our total reward package.

About You


Build sophisticated technical Pricing Models using Willis Tower Watson tools (Emblem and Radar) and Machine Learning.
Develop demand forecasting models and contribute to the analysis of customer retention and cancellation patterns
Be part of strategic projects to create tariff of new products.
Monitor carefully the risk of our existing products and share any statistical analysis with other teams.
Be part of many projects involving Machine Learning: Data preparation, Classification and Regression Models, Automation, Risk monitoring
Consider any market disruptions (Covid, Economic crisis) that impact our models
Support initiatives to maintain our “Excellent” Technical Price Certification.
Share and promote knowledge, skills and best working practices within the team.
Be fully supported in your development and wider career ambitions
Be part of a motivated an exciting team where the word boring does not exist!


Essential Skills


Previous experience working in a business environment
Experience of using data analytics tools like WTW tools (Emblem / Radar), SAS, Python, SQL, Excel, VBA.
Qualified to degree level and have a high degree of numerical ability: E.g. Mathematics, Actuarial, Economics, Statistics
Well-developed problem-solving skills, logically working through scenarios and thinking multiple steps ahead to understand potential impacts
Experience of using machine learning.
Excellent analytical and data interpretation skills when working with large volumes of complex data
Ability to communicate findings to technical and non-technical audiences
Business acumen as well as a basic understanding of the insurance sector

At Gist, we're proud to be part of the M&S Group, the logistics engine behind M&S Food.

From our distribution centres to our transport operations and support functions, we connect people, technology and expertise to ensure the right products reach the right stores at the right time.

As we continue to invest in our people, technology and network, there's never been a more exciting time to join Gist and help shape the future of food logistics.

The Opportunity

Our Solution & Optimisation team have an exciting opportunity for an analytically strong Solution Design Analyst where you will support both M&S and Gist on the network renewal programme applying analytical techniques to produce outputs which will be instrumental in shaping the future network, automation and design processes.

This pivotal role will see you working either at our Gist Chineham or M&S Paddington offices with the ability to work from home.

What You'll Be Doing

Reporting into the Head of Solutions, you will be crucial in applying problem solving to a range of operational and organisational challenges where you will engage with both M&S and Gist stakeholders to drive change projects gaining buy-in and agreement. You will take time to understand the M&S and Gist data structure and access to enable you to recommend the most suitable solution.

This role will see you forming new analytical techniques to solve complex problems and challenges in a practical, robust and coherent way. You will use analytical skills to support the wider team to drive informed decision making and produce compelling outputs and communicate with senior stakeholders to help shape their thinking on materials and information gathered.

What We're Looking For

To be successful in your application you will hold a mathematical or data science degree with proven analytical experience and advanced skills in programme language, Python, and SQL.

You will be able to formulate concise approaches to analytical problem solving, producing and interpreting compelling materials explaining complex problems and outputs. It goes without saying that you will be a strong communicator and influencer with the ability to form excellent working relationships at all levels both within Gist and M&S.

Role Details


Salary: Up to £64,000 per annum + Bonus
Working pattern: 37.5 hours per week Monday to Friday.


What’s in it for you?

As Well As a Competitive Salary, You'll Benefit From


20% M&S discount on most things from furniture, fashion and food
25 days’ annual leave plus bank holidays (rising with length of service)
Discounted rates on healthcare cash plan
Attractive annual bonus scheme, based on M&S performance and personal objectives
Auto Enrolment Pension or competitive Defined Contribution Pension Scheme and life assurance (up to 4 times salary)
Amazing perks and discounts via our App to major restaurants and retailers
Access to a wide range of wellbeing support – including our Employee Assistance Programme
A first-class welcome with a tailored induction and a wide range of training schemes to help with your learning and development
Cycle to work scheme


Why Gist?

Title: Portfolio Analyst
Description:
If you’d like to be considered for this opportunity we encourage you to apply promptly to avoid disappointment as if applications are high the role will close before the closing date given.

Portfolio Analyst

 Location:   Aldermaston (Hybrid, by agreement with Line Manager)

Package: £39,500 - £59,350 (depending on your suitability, qualifications and level of experience) 

 Working pattern: AWE operates a 9-day working fortnight. We will consider flexible working requests so that your work may fit in with your lifestyle. Just let us know your preferred working pattern on your application. 

Turn Data into Decisions

At AWE, our P3M Digital, Data, Tools and Systems team enable informed decision-making across some of the UK's most complex projects, programmes and portfolios. We're looking for a Portfolio Analyst who is passionate about data, analytics and continuous improvement.

This is an opportunity to combine project, programme and portfolio delivery knowledge with modern digital tools, transforming data into meaningful insight that drives better outcomes.

What You'll Do


Build impactful dashboards and reports using digital solutions.
Analyse portfolio, programme and project data to identify trends, risks, opportunities and emerging issues.
Work with stakeholders to understand business requirements and turn data into actionable insight.
Improve reporting and management information through automation, innovation and continuous improvement.
Help shape the future of P3M Digital and Data across AWE.


What We're Looking For


Strong data literacy and analytical thinking.
Experience using data and reporting tools to create meaningful visualisations and insights.
The ability to translate complex data into clear, actionable recommendations.
Prior experience in a project or programme environment.
Strong stakeholder engagement and communication skills.
A curious mindset with a passion for solving problems and improving how information is used.
An interest in coding, automation, data engineering or AI-enabled analytics.


Whilst not to be considered a tick list, we'd like you to have experience in some of the following: 


Building with tools within the Microsoft Suite (Power BI, Power Automate, Power Query) and others.
Basic understanding of programming languages such as Python, SQL or DAX.
Portfolio, programme or project delivery experience.


Why Join Us?

We're looking for curious, digitally minded people who want to make an impact. Whether you're already developing data solutions or looking to grow your technical skills, you'll have the opportunity to help shape the future of P3M insights, reporting and analytics at AWE.

 Work hard, be rewarded:  

 We ask a lot and set the bar high because our work truly matters. In return we offer balance, with award winning benefits including:  

 


9-day working fortnight - meaning you get every other Friday off work, in addition to 270 hours of annual leave.  
Market leading contributory pension scheme (we will pay between 9% and 13% of your pensionable pay depending on your contributions). 
Family friendly policies: Maternity Leave - 39 Weeks Full Pay and Paternity Leave - 4 Weeks Full Pay. 
Opportunities for Professional Career Development including funding for annual membership of a relevant professional body. 
Employee Assistance Programme and Occupational Health Services. 
Life Assurance (4 x annual salary). 
Discounts - access to savings on a wide range of everyday spending. 
Special Leave Policy including paid time off for volunteering, public service (including reserve forces) and caring. 


 

The 'Working at AWE' page on our website is where you can find full details in the 'AWE Benefits Guide'. 

Next Steps

Everyone who works at AWE brings unique skills and perspectives to the table. We recognise that great people don’t always ‘tick every box’. That’s why we focus on your potential, your fit with our values, your transferable skills as well as your experience. Even if you don’t meet every point above, but you feel that this role and AWE are a great fit for you, please go ahead and apply, we’d love to receive your application.

Important Things You Need To Know


We encourage you to apply promptly to avoid disappointment if applications are high and the role therefore closes.
You will need to obtain and maintain the necessary security clearance for the role. This will be funded by AWE. The nature of our work does mean you need to be a British Citizen who has been resident in the UK for the past 5 years in order to apply for SC clearance and 10 years for DV.
We want you to feel comfortable and able to shine during our recruitment process. Please let us know on your application form if you need any adjustments/accommodations during the process.
Our interviews typically take place over Teams and for most roles are a 1 stage process.


Our ambition is to create workplaces where we recognise and celebrate differences, encourage diverse contributions and our employees feel able to be themselves at work. We strive to create a genuine culture of openness and inclusion and encourage diverse applicants. Any inclusion information you provide will be stored in accordance with GDPR and kept separate from your application form and CV, and the information will not be shared with anyone involved in interviewing or making hiring decisions.

Please note that you must be a British Citizen to apply for a role with us.

Title: Product Analyst - Anti-Cheating
Description:
Office location: Cambridge, UK - This position offers flexible working options, including predominantly remote work. However, applicants should be based (or be willing to relocate) within a comfortable commuting distance of our office to attend onsite as required.

Are you a data-driven problem solver who is keen on protecting fair play and improving the player experience in MMO games?

As a Product Analyst focused on anti-cheating at Jagex, you'll play a vital role in safeguarding the integrity of our games by helping us understand and combat cheating, botting, and gold farming. Working as part of our Anti-Cheat team, you'll use data to uncover player behaviours, identify emerging threats, and develop insights that help shape detection systems and preventative measures.

This is an exciting opportunity to combine analytical expertise with game knowledge, working alongside Product, Data Science, Game Analytics, and Engineering teams to protect millions of players and ensure our game worlds remain healthy, balanced, and fair.

What you'll be doing:


Support the day-to-day operation of the Anti-Cheat team, helping ensure key KPIs, SLAs, and player sentiment remain on track.
Analyse large datasets to identify suspicious behaviours, botting activity, and gold farming trends.
Work closely with Game Analytics, Data Science, and Product teams to develop effective anti-cheat strategies and deterrents.
Translate complex datasets into clear insights and practical recommendations that improve game integrity.
Support the development and enhancement of game telemetry by partnering with Engineering and Design teams.
Collaborate with central Data teams to define reporting requirements and improve data products.
Build a deep understanding of game systems, player behaviours, and telemetry to improve the effectiveness of anti-cheat initiatives.
Communicate findings clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders, helping drive informed decision-making across the business.


What we're looking for:


Experience querying and analysing data using SQL, with a strong understanding of data cleansing techniques.
A demonstrable understanding of video game player behaviours, particularly in MMORPGs and preferably in Old School RuneScape and/or RuneScape.
Familiarity with modern data platforms and architectures such as AWS, Snowflake, and OLAP technologies.
Experience creating reports and visualisations using tools such as Tableau, Power BI, or similar.
Strong analytical skills with the ability to identify patterns, trends, and anomalies within large datasets.
Excellent communication skills with the ability to present technical findings in a clear, accessible way.
A proactive approach to problem-solving and a passion for using data to improve player experiences.


What we offer:

When you join Jagex you can look forward to a generous Perks & Benefits package including:


Private Healthcare, including Dental Plan.
Minimum 6% Pension contributions.
Employee Assistance Programme & onsite Counselling.
Life Insurance.
Discretionary annual performance bonus.
Enhanced family leave policies from day 1.
Flexible working hours.
25 days annual leave + Bank holidays & the option to buy/sell holidays + so much more!


Inclusion & Accessibility Statement

We are committed to providing equal opportunities and creating an environment where everyone can thrive. We welcome applications from all backgrounds, and we recruit, develop, and promote based on merit and ability.

If you require any reasonable adjustments to support you during the recruitment process, please let us know when you're invited to interview.

Right to Work Statement

This role is only open to applicants who have the permanent right to work in the UK. We are unable to provide or take over visa sponsorship for this position, either now or in the future. Applicants must therefore be able to demonstrate their ongoing eligibility to work in the UK without the need for employer sponsorship.

About Jagex:

We are Jagex: The RuneScape Company- home to one of gaming's most enduring success stories. We create deep, community-powered games with worlds that evolve, inspire, and endure. Our flagship MMORPG franchise, RuneScape has welcomed over 300 million player accounts, inspiring generations of players across PC and mobile for 25 years.

As we begin our 26th year, we are accelerating our strategy to expand RuneScape into a broader ecosystem of forever games and connected experiences, grounded in a renewed commitment to integrity and fair play. This includes the reduction of monetisation mechanics, as well as the launch of RuneScape: DragonWilds into Steam Early Access in 2025 representing a major step in building a multi-genre future for the RuneScape universe. We remain focused on building enduring worlds, empowering player-led innovation, and laying the foundations for the boldest era in RuneScape's history. For more information, visit www.jagex.com.

Headquartered in Cambridge, United Kingdom, We are home to passionate creators, storytellers, engineers, and even a few dreamers, all united by a single mission- to shape the future of online worlds and empower players to make them their own. We're looking for people to join us who share our ambitions & values - We foster an inclusive workplace built on trust, autonomy, and a shared passion for creating experiences which inspire our communities. Our values guide everything we do: We Embrace Fellowship by collaborating and sharing openly. Join us. The next era of RuneScape - and the next chapter of Jagex: The RuneScape Company - starts now.

Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to identify root causes and recommend effective solutions.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to collaborate with cross-functional teams, especially front-line staff, present findings, and drive improvement.

Power BI - Strong Power BI skills with the ability to create, amend and manage performance dashboard as well as ability to present data in new ways


Candidates should ideally live within a one-hour commute of Durrington, Worthing.

Proven investigative and analytical skills, to enable delivery of performance improvements.
Strong IT skills including Power BI and MS Excel.
Self-starter with ability to manage own workload.
Strong communication skills, both oral and written.
Coaching and facilitation skills.

Confidence to provide constructive feedback.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Hey! We're Huel, and we're pleased to meet you 👋

Our culture thrives on high performance, and we set the bar high for new Hueligans who join us.

We invite you to read the advert below for our new Data Analyst position to understand the role, and explore our 7 Huel values before applying to ensure we have the right working environment for you!

The role

Huel is looking for a Data Analyst to turn raw behavioural and commercial data into clear, actionable insights for Marketing, Trading, Product, and Retail teams. You’ll build measurement frameworks, run causal analyses, and create self-serve dashboards, helping the business move fast and make confident, data-driven decisions.

Key responsibilities include:


Owning end-to-end analysis – translate open-ended questions from Marketing, Trading, Product, and Retail into clear analytical briefs, run the analysis, and land unambiguous recommendations.
Designing & evaluating experiments – design A/B tests and causal-inference studies (lift analysis, hold-out tests) and communicate results in plain language.
Defining measurement frameworks – set the right KPIs and establish how new initiatives will be measured, ensuring every launch has a clear success metric and data plan from day one.
Scale our data foundations – team up with Engineering to design efficient, accurate data sets and schemas, define requirements for new data feeds, and automate the checks that keep everything running smoothly.
Championing self-serve analytics – develop and maintain live dashboards, document datasets, and run training sessions so non-analysts can answer routine questions without waiting in a queue.
AI & Automation - Champion the adoption of AI-powered analytics, using AI tools to enhance analysis, automate routine activities, uncover deeper insights, and improve productivity, while enabling colleagues to self-serve trusted data and answer business questions independently.
Spotting growth opportunities – combine behavioural and marketing data with commercial metrics to size new products, markets, and campaigns, prioritising by impact and effort.


This role is based at our HQ in Tring, Hertfordshire. We operate a hybrid working model, with office days on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays, and the flexibility to work from home on Wednesdays and Fridays.

Not yet sure if this is the right role for you? Click HERE to read a more detailed job description.

What we're looking for in you

We’re looking for a confident, curious analyst who’s comfortable working with statistics, behavioural data, and experiment design. You can move seamlessly between SQL, product analytics tools, and storytelling through slides. You’re proactive, independent, and always looking for high-impact opportunities to raise the bar on how we use data. In a fast-paced environment, you adapt quickly and communicate clearly - collaborating with both technical and non-technical teams to get things done.


SQL – you can write quick exploratory queries or optimise a multi-table join on Snowflake without breaking a sweat.
Product analytics – comfortable in platforms such as Heap, Amplitude or Mixpanel and happy to set up events, funnels and cohorts from scratch.
Statistical – solid on A/B testing, experiment design and the basics of causal inference; you know when a result is worth acting on.
Measurement mindset – you’ve built tracking plans and KPI frameworks that let teams see what “good” looks like before they ship.
Data - experience modelling data in dbt (or similar), automating checks and keeping feeds clean and accurate as they scale.


And as always, we’re on the lookout for new Hueligans who love a fast-paced environment and are always striving to be their best. We want people who aren’t afraid to think differently and push boundaries. If you’re all about setting big goals and believe that amazing things happen through creativity and teamwork, you’ll fit right in at Huel!

What do we offer in return?

We know that at times, our teams face demanding pressures, and exceptional effort deserves meaningful rewards. That's why we've created a world-class perks and benefits program designed to support our Hueligans in achieving their best, both professionally and personally, while celebrating the global impact they're making!

🕖 Hybrid working - We spend Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays in the office together. The remaining two days have the option to be worked from home.

🌴 30 days annual leave PLUS bank holidays

🥤 Free Huel to keep you going

🏖️ 2 weeks a year to work remotely from anywhere!

🐾 Dog friendly

🙋 Paid Volunteering Days

🏋️ Free on-site gym with free classes, and we will give you your own nutrition plan

🧘 Free on-site wellness area offering infrared saunas and an ice bath🧘

🧠 Free 1-on-1 therapy provided by Self-Space.

🏥 Private Medical and Health insurance for you and your loved ones, including free life insurance covering up to 4x your salary

⚡ Electric Car Scheme with onsite charging

🚴Cycle to Work Scheme

🤰 Enhanced Family Leave

👪 Workplace Nursery Scheme

🎓 Huel Academy

💸 Paid Employee Referral Scheme

🎉 Biannual events to celebrate success - Have you heard about Huelchella?

We are Hueligans

We know diversity isn’t just important... it’s essential. It makes us stronger, sharper, and better at what we do. At Huel, we’re about people, not just sustainable nutrition - real people with different backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives.

We celebrate what makes each of us unique and we actively bring together Hueligans from all walks of life. Because whilst we share the same 7 values, it’s our differences that power our thinking, challenge our ideas, and help us build better products for a global community.

Belonging matters here. So does fairness. We want every Hueligan to have the opportunity to thrive, contribute, and be heard - no matter where they come from or what path they’ve taken to get here.

We don’t just welcome diversity of thought…we go looking for it!

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
Base Location: You'll be expected to spend 50% of your working week in one of the following locations :London, Reading, Havant, Glasgow or Perth

Salary: £competitive + performance-related bonus + a range of benefits to support your finances, wellbeing and family.

Working Pattern: Permanent | Full Time | Flexible First options available

The role

This role offers the opportunity to innovate how risk, controls and assurance activities are assessed by applying advanced analytics, statistical modelling and AI to identify emerging risks, strengthen control insights and support more proactive decision-making. Working at the intersection of data science and assurance, the role will help shape scalable, data-driven approaches that improve the efficiency, consistency and impact of audit, risk and controls work across the Group.

You will


Use data, analytics and AI to help improve how risks, controls and assurance activities are identified, monitored and understood.
Build statistical and machine learning models that detect patterns, anomalies and emerging risks across complex data sets.
Develop dashboards, visualisations and clear insights that help teams make better decisions and take action with confidence.
Work closely with assurance, risk, controls and technology colleagues to turn business questions into practical data solutions.


Support the responsible use of data and AI by ensuring models and outputs are clear, well-documented and fit for purpose.

You have


Experience using data, analytics or AI to solve practical business problems and turn complex information into clear insight.
Strong skills in data analysis, statistical modelling or machine learning, with the ability to work confidently with large and varied data sets.
Good technical capability in tools such as SQL, Python, Databricks or Power BI, or the ability to quickly build capability in similar platforms.
A clear and collaborative communication style, with the ability to explain technical work in plain English and work well with people from different backgrounds and specialisms.
A curious, responsible and improvement-focused mindset, with sound judgement on data quality, privacy, model transparency and the ethical use of AI.


About SSE

SSE’s purpose is to provide energy needed today while building a better world of energy for tomorrow. We do this by developing, building, operating and investing in electricity infrastructure and businesses needed in the energy transition. Our Transforming for Growth investment plan sees us investing £33bn in critical electricity infrastructure across the five years to 2030.

Our Group Risk & Audit teams support SSE in meeting all risk management responsibilities, including UK Corporate Governance Code obligations. They undertake assurance reviews to help identify and mitigate against any risks that could impact our performance, integrity, solvency or liquidity.

Flexible Benefits To Fit Your Life

Enjoy discounts on private healthcare and gym memberships. Wellbeing benefits like a free online GP and 24/7 counselling service. Interest-free loans on tech and transport season tickets, or a new bike with our Cycle to Work scheme. As well as generous family entitlements such as maternity and adoption pay, and paternity leave.

Work with an equal opportunity employer

SSE will make any reasonable adjustments you need to ensure that your application and experience with us is positive. Please contact francesca.palmer@sse.com / 01738 344763 to discuss how we can support you.

We're dedicated to fostering an open and inclusive workplace where people from all backgrounds can thrive. We create equal opportunities for everyone to succeed and especially welcome applications from those who may not be well represented in our workforce or industry.

Start your online application using the Apply Now box on this page. We only accept applications made online. We'll be in touch after the closing date to let you know if we'll be taking your application further.
