Title: Foundation Pricing Analyst
Description:
Role Description

An exciting opportunity has arisen for a Foundation Pricing Analyst to join our growing Animal Health Technical Pricing Team. The team is responsible for building technical Pricing models and monitoring the risk to support the market leading brand PetPlan as well as our growing LV pet proposition. Our team is at the heart of achieving the company’s strategy and it is an exciting time for you to join and shape the future of our business.

This is a great role for someone looking to develop their data and analytics skills to drive and improve business outcomes. A great advantage of being a member of the Animal Health Pricing team is the extensive training provided. The UK team has collaborated with the worldwide Allianz Group, to deliver an accreditation scheme designed to train you in all aspects of pricing. From data science modelling in cutting edge software to automating optimisation calculation routines honed across global markets.

Pricing will play a key role in delivering this ambition. We are looking for individuals who have an eye for detail, love working with technology and have a passion for analysing data. You’ll be at the sharp end of our business, delivering analytical models that are used to drive commercial decisions, solve challenging problems, and deliver enhancements to our products and pricing techniques.

Location

This role is based in our Guildford office. This is a hybrid role with expectation of you attending the office one day per week

Salary Information

This role offers a circa range of £37,000 per year. Salary is only one part of our total reward package.

About You


Build sophisticated technical Pricing Models using Willis Tower Watson tools (Emblem and Radar) and Machine Learning.
Develop demand forecasting models and contribute to the analysis of customer retention and cancellation patterns
Be part of strategic projects to create tariff of new products.
Monitor carefully the risk of our existing products and share any statistical analysis with other teams.
Be part of many projects involving Machine Learning: Data preparation, Classification and Regression Models, Automation, Risk monitoring
Consider any market disruptions (Covid, Economic crisis) that impact our models
Support initiatives to maintain our “Excellent” Technical Price Certification.
Share and promote knowledge, skills and best working practices within the team.
Be fully supported in your development and wider career ambitions
Be part of a motivated an exciting team where the word boring does not exist!


Essential Skills


Qualified to degree level and have a high degree of numerical ability: E.g. Mathematics, Actuarial, Economics, Statistics
Well-developed problem-solving skills, logically working through scenarios and thinking multiple steps ahead to understand potential impacts
Experience of using machine learning
Excellent analytical and data interpretation skills when working with large volumes of complex data
Experience of using data analytics tools such as SAS, Python, SQL, Excel, VBA or other coding environments.
Ability to communicate findings to technical and non-technical audiences
Business acumen as well as a basic understanding of the insurance sector


We support the government scheme “Access to Work” please feel free to ask us about the access to work scheme.

Desirable Skills


You embrace innovation and like challenge
You take ownership of your projects
Responsible Artificial Intelligence usage is desirable but not essential
Experience of using WTW tools (Emblem / Radar)


What We Will Offer You

Recognised and rewarded for a job well done, we have a range of flexible benefits for you to choose from- so you can pick a package that’s perfect for you. We also offer flexible working options, global career opportunities across the wider Allianz Group, and fantastic career development and training. That’s on top of enjoying all the benefits you’d expect from the world’s number one insurance brand, including:


Flexible buy/sell holiday options
Hybrid working
Annual performance related bonus
Contributory pension scheme
Development days
A discount up to 50% on a range of insurance products including car, home and pet
Retail discounts
Volunteering days


Our Ways of Working

Do you need flexibility with the hours you work? Let us know as part of your application and if it’s right for our customers, our business and for you, then we’ll do everything we can to make it happen. Here at Allianz, we are signatories of the ABIs flexible working charter. We believe in supporting hybrid work patterns, which balance the needs of our customers, with your personal circumstances and our business requirements. Our aim with this is to help innovation, creativity, and you to thrive - Your work life balance is important to us.

Inclusive Support & Accessibility

At Allianz, we are committed to fostering building an inclusive, accessible workplace where everyone can thrive. As a Disability Confident employer, we welcome applications from disabled and neurodivergent candidates and offer tailored adjustments throughout the recruitment process and in the workplace, whether that’s assistive technology, ergonomic equipment, flexible working arrangements, mentoring or coaching. We want to encourage candidates to speak with us about any adjustments they may need. We’re here to support you.

Contact our Resourcing team to opt into this scheme or for any assistance with during the recruitment process including larger text, hard copies, or spoken applications. Hr-recruitment@allianz.co.uk

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
Senior Decision Scientist

Brighton | Up to £90,000 + Benefits




If you enjoy using data to influence product direction, solve complex business problems and drive measurable commercial outcomes, this could be an excellent next step. This role sits at the intersection of analytics, experimentation, product and AI, offering the opportunity to work closely with Product Managers and Engineers to shape decisions that directly impact customers and business performance.




The Company

They are a technology-led business with a strong data culture and significant investment in AI, analytics and product development. As they continue to scale, they are evolving their Data function to embed Decision Scientists more closely within product teams, ensuring data plays a central role in strategic and operational decision-making.

With a modern data environment, strong stakeholder engagement and a clear commitment to innovation, they offer an environment where analytical thinking is valued and acted upon.




The Role

As a Senior Decision Scientist, you'll work closely with Product Managers, Engineers and stakeholders to uncover opportunities, measure impact and influence decision-making.




You'll be responsible for:

Identifying and investigating business and product opportunities
Using data to shape product strategy and prioritisation
Designing and measuring experiments and A/B tests
Defining success metrics and evaluating feature performance
Translating complex analysis into clear recommendations
Supporting the development of data-driven product features
Helping teams understand customer behaviour and journey friction points
Exploring how AI and data can be used to improve customer experiences
Acting as a trusted partner to both technical and non-technical stakeholders




This role is ideal for someone who enjoys being close to the business and wants to see their work directly influence product and commercial outcomes.




Your Skills & Experience

Strong experience in analytics, decision science, product analytics or data science
A commercial mindset and a genuine interest in solving business problems
Experience working with experimentation and statistical testing
Strong SQL skills and experience using Python or R
Ability to communicate findings clearly and influence stakeholders
Experience working closely with Product and Engineering teams
Comfortable working in ambiguity and helping shape solutions
Interest in AI, machine learning and emerging technologies




What They Offer

Salary up to £90,000
Hybrid working, two days per week in Brighton
Private healthcare and enhanced pension contribution
Dedicated learning and development support
Clear progression opportunities within a growing Data & Analytics function
The chance to work on high-impact product and commercial challenges
Exposure to modern AI tooling and a data-driven culture




How to Apply

If you're looking for a role where you can combine analytics, product thinking and commercial impact, we'd love to hear from you. Apply today to find out more.

Title: Technology and Data Risk Analyst
Place: Brighton And Hove, England, United Kingdom
Description:
Legal & General (L&G) is a leading UK financial services group and major global investor.



We’ve been safeguarding people’s financial futures since 1836, and strive to build a better society, while improving the lives of our customers and creating value for shareholders.



We are one of the world’s largest asset managers and provide powerful asset origination capabilities. Together, these underpin our retirement and protection solutions: we are an international player in pension risk transfer, in UK and US life insurance, and in UK workplace pensions and retirement income.



Our Group Functions provide the services that all areas of the business need. This requires a talented and diverse team behind the scenes, who enable everyone at L&G to do what they do best. 



Joining us means helping to improve the lives of our customers and contributing to the success of the business every day.





Job Description



At Legal & General, we're committed to building a secure, resilient and data-driven organisation. As a Technology Risk Analyst, you'll play an important role in supporting the identification, analysis and reporting of technology, information security and data risks across the Group.



Working alongside risk, technology and business teams, you'll help strengthen our technology risk and control framework, support assurance activities, and provide valuable insights through risk data analysis. This is an excellent opportunity for someone looking to develop a career in technology risk, information security, data governance or operational risk within a collaborative and evolving environment.



What you’ll be doing:



Supporting the maintenance and embedding of technology risk policies, standards and controls across the Group
Gathering, validating and analysing risk and control data to support reporting and identify trends, insights and data quality issues
Assisting with assurance reviews, deep dives and spotlight assessments by collecting evidence and documenting findings
Collaborating with technology, information security and business teams to support risk management activities and reporting
Supporting technology change assurance activities by tracking risks, actions and programme updates
Analysing technology-related risk events and control weaknesses to support lessons learned and continuous improvement
Preparing risk reports and management information for governance forums, committees and stakeholders
Promoting awareness of technology risk management practices and maintaining supporting guidance materials

Who we’re looking for:



An interest in technology risk, information security, data governance or risk management
Experience in risk, technology, data, operations or another control-focused environment
The ability to analyse information and use data to support reporting and decision-making
Knowledge of, or exposure to, technology risk and control frameworks such as ISO 27001, COBIT or NIST
Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage priorities and deliver quality outputs
Effective written and verbal communication skills, with the confidence to work with a range of stakeholders
A collaborative approach and willingness to learn from colleagues across different teams
Good analytical thinking, sound judgement and the ability to adapt within a changing technology landscape

Whatever your role, we reward performance and behaviour with a package that looks after all the things that are important to you. Here are some of the benefits we offer:



The opportunity to participate in our annual, performance -related bonus plan and valuable share schemes
Generous pension contribution
Life assurance
Healthcare Plan (permanent employees only)
At least 25 days holiday, plus public holidays, 26 days after 2 years’ service. There’s also the option to buy and sell holiday
Competitive family leave
Participate in our electric car scheme, which offers employees the option to hire a brand-new electric car through tax efficient salary sacrifice (permanent employees only)
There are many discounts we offer – both for our own products and at a range of high street stores and online
We’re creating net‑zero carbon workplaces by 2030 by investing in our sustainable, modern offices across the UK, all designed to bring people together and elevate the in‑person experience


Additional Information



At L&G, we believe it's possible to generate positive returns today while helping to build a better future for all.



If you join us, you’ll be part of a welcoming, inclusive culture, with opportunities to collaborate with people of diverse backgrounds, views, and experiences. Guided by leaders with integrity who care about your future and wellbeing. Empowered through initiatives which support people to develop their careers and excel.



We care passionately about outcomes rather than attendance and are therefore open to discussing all kinds of flexible working options including part-time and job shares. Although some roles have limited flexibility due to customer demand, we accommodate requests when we can.



It doesn’t matter if you don’t meet every single criterion in this advert. Instead, think about what you excel at and what else you can bring in terms of strengths, potential and connection to our purpose.

Title: Pricing Analyst
Description:
About The Role

It is an exciting time to join our newly established pricing team within John Lewis Financial Services. Following the launch of our broker, you will have the unique opportunity to influence the direction of our modeling and reporting from the ground up

As a Pricing Analyst, you will:


Innovate: Develop and deliver price optimisation models for Motor or Home insurance.
Integrate: Use your technical expertise to blend traditional insurance metrics with our proprietary retail data — a data set unique to the Partnership.
Impact: Monitor performance via bespoke dashboards, providing actionable insights that directly influence our strategy.
Salary Expectations:- Up to £45,000 depending on experience.
Working pattern/flexible working - The Partnership has adopted a hybrid working approach, meaning you'll be able to work a mixture between the office and home based upon your personal needs whilst balancing the needs of the business. The team meets in the office 1 day a week to connect.


Key Responsibilities


Providing a range of pricing options for consideration to the Senior Pricing Manager with suggested recommendations, with a particular focus on generating insights and value from our proprietary retail data.
Delivering robust behavioural, demand, and market premium models in Earnix, compliant with regulations, and delivering ongoing value for customers and the business.
Maintaining and enhancing Earnix LTV models with robust assumptions to deliver reliable lifetime value insights for responsible pricing and customer value.
Monitoring the effectiveness of implemented pricing strategies, track key performance indicators (KPIs), and prepare detailed reports and presentations for senior management and stakeholders.
Supporting the specification of monitoring and controls that will ensure continued compliance with all relevant regulations
Ensure adherence to John Lewis policies and procedures, operating within all legal and regulatory guidelines.


Essential Skills/experience You’ll Need


Suitable numerate degree or apprenticeship i.e Mathematics, Statistics, Actuarial Science or similar
previous demonstrable experience of personal line insurance - motor or home insurance pricing.
Expertise in SQL.
Experience with modelling tools (e.g., Emblem, Earnix, R, Python).
Good knowledge of general insurance principles, products, and practices.
Experience building predictive models for general insurance.
Familiarity with relevant regulations, particularly GIPP and Consumer Duty.
Proven business judgement, with the ability to solve complex issues using pragmatic solutions.
Knowledge of retail pricing data and modelling techniques would be desirable


About The Partnership

We’re the largest employee owned business in the UK and home of our cherished brands, John Lewis and Waitrose. We’re not just employees, we’re Partners, driven by our purpose to build a happier world. As we look to our future, there’s never been a more exciting time to join us.

We’re ruthlessly focused on being brilliant at retail. We continue to innovate, adapt and diversify. Never Knowingly Undersold on price, quality and service in John Lewis and passionately serving food-lovers in Waitrose.

As Partners we all share the responsibility of ownership and in its rewards. We use our voices to contribute to our success, working together through the good and challenging times, holding true to our behaviours and treating everyone with kindness and respect.

We all own making the Partnership somewhere we belong. Embracing our differences and creating an environment where we’re free to be ourselves and can THRIVE. Growing ourselves individually, and as a collective.

As Partners, we make all the difference. And, we all own it.

Important points to note:

It’s important to note that some of our roles are subject to pre-employment vetting (which may include DBS checks for successful candidates). If required, you’ll be informed and provided with information about vetting during the recruitment process and we encourage you to complete any vetting documents quickly to avoid delays. Any DBS checks required will be carried out by a third-party registered body and financial probity checks may also be required for some of our roles.

We occasionally close vacancies early in the event we receive a high volume of applications, and therefore, we recommend you apply early. If you require a reasonable adjustment due to a disability which means you may need longer to complete your application please contact us as soon as possible.

We want all of our Partners to have a good work-life balance and we support flexible working. This might mean flexible or compressed hours, job sharing or shorter hour contracts, where possible. Please discuss this further with the hiring manager during your interview.

Title: Data Product Developer
Description:
We are looking for a Data Product Developer to build, maintain, and improve data-driven product capabilities across customer, commerce, content, and digital product experiences. This role turns business and customer data into practical tools, workflows, dashboards, integrations, or product features that support better decisions and better customer outcomes.


Develop data products, reporting layers, integrations, or workflow tools that support product, commerce, marketing, and customer-facing teams.
Partner with stakeholders to clarify business needs and translate them into maintainable technical solutions.
Improve the reliability, usability, and accessibility of product and customer data.
Support analytics, experimentation, segmentation, personalization, or operational reporting where appropriate.
Work with engineering, product, marketing, e-commerce, and business systems teams to align data models and workflows.
Identify opportunities to reuse data capabilities across inMusic brands.
Document data logic, assumptions, and usage patterns clearly.
Experience building data products, internal tools, analytics workflows, integrations, or product-facing data features.
Strong SQL, scripting, API, data modeling, or BI/reporting capability.
Ability to work with ambiguous business questions and turn them into useful, practical solutions.
Understanding of customer, commerce, product usage, or digital experience data.
Strong communication skills with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Bias toward maintainability, clarity, and measurable business impact.
Work on products and platforms used by creators, producers, performers, DJs, and musicians around the world.
Help shape the future of music creation technology across a global portfolio of brands.
Join a practical, creative environment that values clear thinking, customer impact, and measurable outcomes.

About The Role

Customer Analytics & Insights Analyst – Help us deliver for our customers, every day

At Domino’s, you bring the flavour. Together, we deliver delicious.

We’re looking for a Customer Analytics & Insights Analyst to help us better understand our customers, how they order, what they value, and where we can improve. Working as part of our Digital (Marketing) team, you’ll turn data into clear, practical insights that help shape campaigns, improve performance and support smarter decision-making across the business

What You’ll Bring


This role is perfect if you enjoy working with data to solve real business problems and want to build your career in customer analytics. You’ll be based in Manchester or Milton Keynes, working closely with marketing and digital teams to turn customer behaviour into meaningful insight.
Experience working with data in an analytics, data science or insights role, ideally within a retail or e-commerce environment
Strong SQL skills, with the ability to extract, manipulate and analyse large datasets
Experience with customer analytics, including segmentation (e.g. RF/RFM) and lifecycle analysis
Experience using reporting or visualisation tools (e.g. Excel, Power BI, Tableau, Python or R)


What You’ll Be Doing


In this role, you’ll help us understand what our customers are doing and why and turn that into insight teams can act on. You’ll work closely with marketing, CRM and commercial teams, supporting campaigns and helping improve how we connect with customers.
Analyse customer behaviour, performance and segmentation to identify trends, opportunities and risks
Support campaign analysis and recommend ways to improve targeting, engagement and customer value
Build and maintain reports, dashboards and datasets to support ongoing insight and decision-making
Work closely with marketing and digital teams to provide clear, structured insight that informs strategy
Identify ways to improve reporting, data quality and analytical approaches over time


How We Will Support You


A clear, confidence-building induction so you understand your role and how your work connects to the wider business
Support from your manager and team, with people who will help you build your skills and grow your confidence in analytics
Opportunities to develop your technical and commercial understanding, with clear progression pathways within the team
Recognition for great work, both in day-to-day moments and through wider company initiatives


About Us

Domino's UK & Ireland

Who are we? A forward-thinking, inclusive world's leading pizza company:

Domino's is the world's leading pizza company, with over 1,300 stores across the UK and Ireland. We're committed to using the freshest, highest-quality ingredients to create over 110 million delectable pizzas each year. Plus, we're a tech-savvy and data driven bunch – 90% of our system sales come through digital channels and 75% of our digital orders coming via the app we have 9.5 million active app customers!

Our mission? To be the go-to choice for food delivery and collection by crafting hot, freshly made pizzas that earn us accolades and the loyalty of millions of pizza enthusiasts worldwide. We're all about innovation, growth, and a commitment to excellence.

At Domino's, we embrace the power of diversity and foster an inclusive environment where everyone feels valued, respected, and empowered. We celebrate the uniqueness of each individual, regardless of their identity, background, or any other characteristic. When you join our team, you join a family that welcomes and celebrates authenticity!

Our recipe for success? Our DomiDNA:


We Mean Business
We Always Deliver
We’re Open to New Flavours
We’re Tastier Together


If you share our values and are ready to be part of a world-class team that's as passionate about people as we are about pizza, apply now and join the Domino's UK & Ireland family!

About the Role 

As the Data Analyst, you will be responsible for delivering insight that drives improvements across the full commercial ecosystem spanning customer experience on, retailer investment effectiveness, marketing and sales performance, and the broader post-purchase, onboarding and promotional landscape. 

A core part of your remit will be the design, build and ongoing management of a marketing and sales performance dashboard, underpinned by Google BigQuery and delivered in Looker Studio. This will serve as a critical decision-making tool for marketing, e-commerce, retail and CX teams surfacing insight such as campaign uplift, halo effects, retailer investment impact and share performance across products and markets. 

Alongside this, you will analyse customer journeys, benchmark competitors, oversee content performance and support the planning and execution of onboarding and e-commerce promotions using platforms like GWI to create digital personas and audience profiles.

Marketing & Sales Performance Analytics  

Design, build and maintain a marketing and sales performance dashboard in Looker Studio, underpinned by BigQuery, combining sell-out sales data, market volume and share data, and campaign activity logs. 
Define the underlying data model, transform source files and design the reporting layer to support consistent, scalable KPI delivery. 
Identify and quantify the impact of retailer investment, including uplift in sales and market share during campaign periods. 
Analyse correlations between campaign activity and commercial performance to determine which marketing levers are most effective. 
Measure and report on halo effects across products and retailers resulting from promotional and campaign activity. 
Define and calculate key performance metrics including uplift, baseline, market share, activity intensity and halo effects. 
Work with GFK or other syndicated market data sources to enrich performance analysis with market volume and share context. 

Customer Experience & Digital Analytics 

Conduct analysis of the current customer experience, including user behaviour, content and campaign performance and conversion pathways. 
Benchmark key customer journeys against competitor websites to identify gaps and opportunities. 
Provide regular insight into paid promotions, post-purchase experience and customer satisfaction trends. 
Support planning, optimisation and operational management of post-purchase and onboarding experience. 
Analyse content utilisation, engagement and drop-off points, and recommend enhancements. 
Collaborate with HQ and local teams on onboarding content production and implementation. 
Support feature management including evaluation, testing performance and monitoring adoption, with ongoing analysis of content effectiveness and customer experience updates. 
Reporting, Dashboards & Stakeholder Insight 
Build and maintain dashboards, reports and ad hoc analyses across customer experience, onboarding, e-commerce, retail performance and promotion activity. 
Translate data into clear insights that guide decision-making within marketing, CX, digital and commercial teams. 
Present findings clearly to stakeholders at all levels, ensuring insight is embedded in planning and operational processes. 
Use platforms like GWI to build digital personas and audience profiles that support broader marketing planning.

Essential 

Proven experience as a data or insight analyst within digital, e-commerce, retail, marketing or agency environments. 
Strong proficiency in Google BigQuery and advanced SQL, including data modelling and reporting layer design. 
Hands-on experience building dashboards in Looker Studio, with a clear understanding of how to structure underlying data models for robust, scalable dashboard performance. 
Demonstrable experience combining sell-out sales, market share and campaign activity datasets to generate commercial insight. 
Ability to define and calculate metrics including uplift, baseline, market share, activity intensity and halo effects. 
Strong marketing analytics capability, including campaign effectiveness measurement across paid and promotional channels. 
Good understanding of digital customer journeys, content performance metrics and e-commerce KPIs. 
Experience with analytics platforms such as Google Analytics GA4, Adobe Analytics or similar. 
Excellent communication and storytelling ability — capable of translating complex business questions into dashboard logic and presenting findings clearly to non-technical audiences. 
Experience working with multi-market teams and managing stakeholder expectations across business functions. 
A passion for data-driven decision-making and an interest in how AI can enhance analytics workflows. 

Preferred: 

Proficiency in Python (pandas) for data transformation, automation and workflow scripting. 
Broader experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP), including automating data ingestion and transformation workflows. 
Experience working in retail, e-commerce or retailer media environments. 
Familiarity with GfK or other syndicated market data sources. 
Experience with additional BI tools such as Tableau or Power BI.

Title: Workforce Management (WFM) Planner
Description:
Job Description

Workforce Management (WFM) Planner

Brighton

Full time - Hybrid 35 hours per week

Salary starting from £35,200 Per annum

We make health happen

The Planning department is an integral part of Operations across our Global portfolio, supporting the function to maintain high quality KPIs and performance standards within budgetary limits.

 

The WFM Planner will be responsible for analysing resource requirements and designing effective scheduling solutions that align with operational goals. You’ll work closely with stakeholders to ensure that plans are not only data-driven but also practical and responsive to the evolving needs of our teams. The holder will monitor performance, carry out analysis of historic data, calculate effects of strategic or procedural changes, forecast work volumes, recommend staffing needs, carry out administrative scheduling activity, identify opportunities to maximise use of resource, provide justification for budget alterations and supply operational performance data.

How You’ll Help Us Make Health Happen


Analyse historical and forecasted data to create and publish short- and long-term resource plans.
Develop and deliver scheduling strategies that support operational performance and service level targets.
Collaborate with stakeholders across departments to ensure plans meet business needs and reflect how teams work in practice.
Monitor ongoing and operational performance and variance and adjust intra-day schedules to optimise resource utilisation.
Track and report on key metrics including call volumes, handle times, queue times, agent availability, and service level adherence.
Chair regular meetings to review effectiveness of current plan and departmental performance to drive ongoing improved performance and collaboration.
Identify and communicate the impact of external factors on workload volumes.
Escalate system issues and coordinate responses across relevant platforms.
Perform trend analysis to guide strategic decisions and continuous improvement.
Provide clear, actionable insights and updates to operational teams.
Act as a key point of contact for queries related to daily planning and scheduling.
Compare forecasted vs. actual data daily to identify discrepancies.
Communicate actions and updates to affected business areas.


Key Skills/Qualifications Needed For This Role


Extensive familiarity with software applications including: MS Excel
Workforce Management systems (experience with TotalView / NICE IEX preferrable)
Telephony Platforms (experience with Genesys preferrable)
Email Management Platforms (experience with eGain preferrable)
Messaging and Live Chat Platforms (experience with LivePerson preferrable)
Other Workforce Management and telephony systems
Proven experience in resource planning, MI analysis, or workforce management within a customer service or operations environment.
Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence and collaborate across teams.
Analytical mindset with a proactive approach to problem-solving and continuous improvement.
Excellent communication skills and the ability to translate complex data into clear, actionable plans.


Benefits


25 days holiday, increasing through length of service, with option to buy or sell
Bupa health insurance as a benefit in kind
An enhanced pension plan and life insurance
Onsite gyms or local discounts where no onsite gym available
Various other benefits and online discounts


Why Bupa

Bupa Global is the international health insurance division of Bupa. We provide customers who want premium international coverage with products and services to access the healthcare they need anytime, around the world, whether at home or when studying, living, travelling or working abroad.

Bupa Global has offices around the world including London and Brighton (UK), Dublin (Europe), Miami (USA), Dubai (UAE, in partnership with OIC), Egypt and Hong Kong (China) as well as regional offices in mainland China, Singapore, the Dominican Republic, Bolivia, Panama, Guatemala and Ecuador.

Time Type

Full time

Job Area

Administration

Locations:

Victory House, Brighton

Brainlabs is the independent, founder-led agency building the future of media. We have over 1000 Brainlabbers based across the global, all united through the 12 principles laid out in our Culture Code. We're full-service, with people and AI agents working side by side, all aligned to one thing: maximizing our clients' revenue through a genuinely scientific approach to media. If you want to help play your part in achieving this for the world's biggest brands in an environment that will support and challenge you in equal measure, this is where you do it.

What's The Role

We're looking for a Data Analyst to own the flow of data between our operational systems, our data warehouse and the rest of the business. Systems like Hubspot and our People Planner, hold the client, revenue and pipeline data that Finance, Ops and Client Leadership rely on. This role keeps that data well structured, reliably synced and trustworthy as it moves into BigQuery and back out into the tools people use every day. A key part of the job is getting the right, live data presented cleanly in Notion, so client teams can actually use it to inform their day to day workflows.

What You Do


Build and maintain integrations that move operating system data into the data warehouse.
Push data warehouse data back into operating systems to create complete workflows and data lifecycles
Debug data discrepancies across source systems and downstream tools, identifying the causes and automating solutions to prevent issues moving forward.
Own HubSpot (or a comparable CRM) as a system of record: properties, associations, lifecycle stages etc. and the automation that keeps them consistent, including data quality, deduplication and governance at scale.
Work closely with finance, operations, and other business support teams, translating technical decisions into terms non-technical stakeholders can act on.



Who You Are


Deep experience managing data structure (objects, properties, associations, lifecycle stages, automation), not just using it as an end user, with strong data quality and governance practices (deduplication, enrichment, validation, access controls, auditability).
Able to turn a non-technical brief into a full plan and build it, and explain technical solutions to non-technical stakeholders without jargon.
Comfortable in fast-moving rollouts, balancing speed with long-term architecture as requirements evolve.
Experience building sync logic (canonical IDs, upserts, change detection, idempotent reruns) and ETL/ELT pipelines that survive repeated runs without duplicating or corrupting data.
Experience integrating data into BigQuery, Snowflake or similar warehouses via API-based integrations, including reverse ETL back into business systems.
Strong Python (or similar) and SQL for automation, data movement, transformation and validation across warehouse tables and views.
Confident with REST APIs (auth, pagination, rate limits, retries, error handling) and GCP tooling (Cloud Run, Cloud Scheduler, Secret Manager, BigQuery, GitHub Actions) for building and orchestrating automated jobs.
Able to debug data discrepancies across source systems and downstream tools, with good version control hygiene (GitHub or similar).



How You Succeed


Data moves between systems reliably and accurately at scale
Systems stay clean at scale, with properties and associations that hold up as volume grows.
Data discrepancies get caught and fixed at the source
Finance, operations and other business teams trust the numbers
New integrations and automations are shipped with documentation and clear guidance
You balance shipping quickly against building for the long term, and can explain that trade-off to a non-technical stakeholder in plain terms.



What happens next?

We know searching for a job is tough and that you want to find the best career and employer for you. We also want to ensure that this position is the best fit for both you and us. Therefore, you will participate in a comprehensive interview process that includes skills interviews with our team. The goal of this process is to allow you to get to know us as we learn more about you.

A note on our offices: We pride ourselves in being a company with an office-centric culture and, for the majority of roles we expect people to be in commuting distance of the office and come in for around 3 days per week.

Brainlabs actively seeks and encourages applications from candidates with diverse backgrounds and identities. We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace: we are committed to equal opportunity for all applicants and employees regardless of age, disability, sex, gender reassignment, sexual orientation, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion, or belief, and marriage and civil partnerships. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation during the application process, please let us know!

Please note that we will never ask you to transfer cash or make any other payment to us in order to apply for a role or to work for Brainlabs. Any such asks are fraudulent and should be reported to the appropriate authorities in your area.

What's The Role

We're looking for a Data Analyst to own the flow of data between our operational systems, our data warehouse and the rest of the business. Systems like Hubspot and our People Planner, hold the client, revenue and pipeline data that Finance, Ops and Client Leadership rely on. This role keeps that data well structured, reliably synced and trustworthy as it moves into BigQuery and back out into the tools people use every day. A key part of the job is getting the right, live data presented cleanly in Notion, so client teams can actually use it to inform their day to day workflows.

What You Do

  • Build and maintain integrations that move operating system data into the data warehouse.
  • Push data warehouse data back into operating systems to create complete workflows and data lifecycles
  • Debug data discrepancies across source systems and downstream tools, identifying the causes and automating solutions to prevent issues moving forward.
  • Own HubSpot (or a comparable CRM) as a system of record: properties, associations, lifecycle stages etc. and the automation that keeps them consistent, including data quality, deduplication and governance at scale.
  • Work closely with finance, operations, and other business support teams, translating technical decisions into terms non-technical stakeholders can act on.


Who You Are

  • Deep experience managing data structure (objects, properties, associations, lifecycle stages, automation), not just using it as an end user, with strong data quality and governance practices (deduplication, enrichment, validation, access controls, auditability).
  • Able to turn a non-technical brief into a full plan and build it, and explain technical solutions to non-technical stakeholders without jargon.
  • Comfortable in fast-moving rollouts, balancing speed with long-term architecture as requirements evolve.
  • Experience building sync logic (canonical IDs, upserts, change detection, idempotent reruns) and ETL/ELT pipelines that survive repeated runs without duplicating or corrupting data.
  • Experience integrating data into BigQuery, Snowflake or similar warehouses via API-based integrations, including reverse ETL back into business systems.
  • Strong Python (or similar) and SQL for automation, data movement, transformation and validation across warehouse tables and views.
  • Confident with REST APIs (auth, pagination, rate limits, retries, error handling) and GCP tooling (Cloud Run, Cloud Scheduler, Secret Manager, BigQuery, GitHub Actions) for building and orchestrating automated jobs.
  • Able to debug data discrepancies across source systems and downstream tools, with good version control hygiene (GitHub or similar).


How You Succeed

  • Data moves between systems reliably and accurately at scale
  • Systems stay clean at scale, with properties and associations that hold up as volume grows.
  • Data discrepancies get caught and fixed at the source
  • Finance, operations and other business teams trust the numbers
  • New integrations and automations are shipped with documentation and clear guidance
  • You balance shipping quickly against building for the long term, and can explain that trade-off to a non-technical stakeholder in plain terms.


What happens next?

We know searching for a job is tough and that you want to find the best career and employer for you. We also want to ensure that this position is the best fit for both you and us. Therefore, you will participate in a comprehensive interview process that includes skills interviews with our team. The goal of this process is to allow you to get to know us as we learn more about you.

A note on our offices: We pride ourselves in being a company with an office-centric culture and, for the majority of roles we expect people to be in commuting distance of the office and come in for around 3 days per week.

Brainlabs actively seeks and encourages applications from candidates with diverse backgrounds and identities. We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace: we are committed to equal opportunity for all applicants and employees regardless of age, disability, sex, gender reassignment, sexual orientation, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion, or belief, and marriage and civil partnerships. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation during the application process, please let us know!

Please note that we will never ask you to transfer cash or make any other payment to us in order to apply for a role or to work for Brainlabs. Any such asks are fraudulent and should be reported to the appropriate authorities in your area.

Title: Data Operations Officer
Description:
As the Data Operations Officer, your key purpose in post is to ensure efficient, compliant data management, and effective data processes. You will proactively support teams, find improvements, and push for efficiencies to allow Salesforce CRM system users to engage with and effectively manage our supporters. This must be completed with reference to relevant data protection/GDPR laws and within a framework of the most effective data management techniques.




You will play a key role in providing process improvements across teams to enable the further development of an automation programme that speeds up and improves accuracy across imports and exports. You will also be responsible for scoping, defining, and implementing data quality improvements.




Key Responsibilities:




Work with our Extract, Transform, Load (ETL) tool (Clarity Data Transform [CDT]) to bring data into our Salesforce ecosystem. This will include extensive documentation writeup, testing requirements for updates and patches, and a restrained & disciplined approach where quality is more important than speed.
Ensure that any exception files from the CDT automations are triaged and the issues rectified, including escalating issues to the relevant agency, or logging a defect in Jira Software.
Play a supportive role with the development team, completing development work in Salesforce as directed.
Work with the Data Operations Manager to ensure Direct Debit claims and Gift Aid claims are processed accurately and on the agreed schedule.
Carry out more complex data loading processes and act as a point of escalation for issues when raised by the Data Operations Executives.
Critically examine existing processes and drive process improvement across database stakeholders and users.
Support the Data Operations Manager on improvement projects, aimed at both improving the quality of data, and teams’ processes surrounding their use of Salesforce.
Provide second line support for the Data Team ticketing system, ensuring tickets are resolved in a timely manner.
Maintain, enhance, and develop data quality checks and associated processes to improve the integrity and usefulness of our data.
Support the Data Operations Manager in ensuring data management best practice is incorporated into each teams’ processes.
Undertake any other relevant duties and projects in line with the responsibilities of the post.
Other tasks from time to time as identified by the Data Operations Manager




Knowledge, skills and experience needed:

Knowledge of relational databases, CRM systems and/or large datasets.
Knowledge and understanding of ETL tools and practices.
Understanding of data protection/GDPR legislation and its implementation.
Knowledge and understanding of SQL.
Experience of working in the charity sector with charity data.
Experience of using Salesforce or similar CRM systems.
Experience of process improvement and automation.
Experience providing support and training to end users.
Experience using a ticketing system, such as Jira Service Desk.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously.
A creative, positive, and proactive approach to problem solving.
Logical and process orientated.
Good self-awareness with a willingness to learn new skills.
Excellent internal stakeholder management skills.
Proven ability to work to a high standard and with an excellent eye for detail.
Advanced Excel skills.




Additional Information:

Ways of working:

As part of our Agile ways of working you will be required to work approximately 2 days a week from the office, which is subject to the requirements of the role and the business needs. Flexibility on where you work can be split between working from home and our office.

Roles that are classed as part of the Agile ways of working are not able to claim any costs for Mileage/Travel on Public Transport, Accommodation and/or Meals. This includes when attending the office for various meetings/events.




Our Office: Our office is at 3 Riverside, Granta Park, Great Abington, Cambridge, CB21 6AD.

Salary: Circa £32,000 per annum, plus benefits.

Bring more to life.

Are you ready to accelerate your potential and make a real difference within life sciences, diagnostics and biotechnology?

At Abcam, one of Danaher’s 15+ operating companies, our work saves lives—and we’re all united by a shared commitment to innovate for tangible impact.

You’ll thrive in a culture of belonging where you and your unique viewpoint matter. And by harnessing Danaher’s system of continuous improvement, you help turn ideas into impact – innovating at the speed of life.

Progress happens together

At Abcam, we believe the scientific community goes further, faster when we go there together. That’s why we work with life scientists to provide biological reagents and solutions that enable faster breakthroughs in critical areas like cancer, neurological disorders, infectious diseases and metabolic disorders. Our talented team of over 1,400 colleagues worldwide is our greatest asset. By applying our expertise and pushing boundaries, together we strive to better serve our customers, strengthen our impact across our industry, and ultimately our positive impact on society.

Learn about the Danaher Business System which makes everything possible.

The Product Management Performance Analyst role is part of the wider Product Management team and focused on assisting colleagues and improving their productivity with the timely supply of product performance and planning data so that they can better serve our customers effectively and efficiently. Our vision is for this role to act as a catalyst for positive change across the Product Management team and the wider business.

Working within the Pricing team team and partnering with Product Management leaders within the business, you will be responsible for improving global performance levels of our team with data analysis tools, KPIs and reports to drive outstanding commercial activities.

This position reports to the Pricing Director and is part of the pricing team who support the Product Management organisation at Abcam. This is an on-site role located in Cambridge and an opportunity to work in a fast paced environment in a growing global business with a data driven mindset.

In This Role, You Will Have The Opportunity To


Maintain and improve Microsoft PowerBi performance reporting suites for the Product Management teams
Support with the identification of relevant KPIs and measures which reflect the performance of the Product Management teams
Use reporting and analysis to identify areas to drive change, course corrections or further iterations in product strategies and provide ad hoc analytics support to the function on data analysis, reporting and performance.
Prepare and present data/insights to senior stakeholders as needed
Maintain and improve our data sources to allow faster, more automated reporting, working with our Data Engineering team who are owners of our main data sources.


The Essential Requirements Of The Job Include


Experience in a data analytical position, delivering data management, data analysis, insight and reporting solutions and an expert in PowerBi and DAX, with knowledge of Tableau or equivalent data visualisation software with a commitment to learn quickly
Performance management experience – ability to propose new KPIs based on gaps in performance, innovative and inquisitive and someone who thrives in a dynamic, ever-changing environment with the ability to multitask, prioritise and meet deadlines.
Possess strong communication and presentation skills - passionate about storytelling via data and a proactive self-starter who can pick things up quickly and run with projects autonomously
Output focused - motivated by achieving goals


It would be a plus if you also possess previous experience in:


SQL coding
Salesforce CRM
Microsoft Excel and Powerpoint

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Data Analyst




Office - 5 days a week in London Bridge

Salary - £50-60k




We're looking for an experienced data analyst with strong technical skills to join a small, fast-moving team building and using cutting-edge data tools in support of real-world investigations. This is a hands-on, embedded role - you'll work directly alongside researchers, translating complex data into actionable insight, while helping shape the tools that power that work.




The role

You'll act as the primary interface between a technical data team and the researchers who depend on it. Day-to-day, that means sourcing, analysing and interpreting data to support live investigations, drawing on an existing knowledge base and toolset, and reaching further when new techniques or datasets are needed.




You'll also train colleagues to get more out of the tools available, identify new datasets and analytical approaches worth integrating, and feed researcher needs back into the technical roadmap.




What you'll bring




Essential

At least three years of experience as an OSINT/ Data analyst (or equivalent intelligence discipline)
Deep, demonstrable knowledge of the publicly available OSINT data landscape (open-source intelligence)
Proficiency in Python for scripting and data processing
Experience within defence or related industries such as Fincrime and an interest in this space too!




Nice to have

Experience with Neo4j or another graph database
Familiarity with PostgreSQL or BigQuery
Experience with BI tools such as Looker, Tableau or Power BI




This is a London office-based role.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
The Role

At The Law Society, data plays a critical role in helping us better understand our members, improve our services, and make informed business decisions. As a Data Analyst, you will deliver high-quality insights and reporting that support strategic and operational decision-making across the organisation.

You will work with colleagues from a wide range of teams to transform complex data into meaningful recommendations, helping stakeholders understand performance, identify opportunities for improvement, and measure the impact of key initiatives. You will use a variety of analytical techniques to uncover trends, diagnose the root causes of business performance fluctuations, and provide evidence-based recommendations that drive action.

The role will involve developing automated dashboards and reporting solutions using tools such as Power BI and Databricks, enabling stakeholders to monitor key performance indicators with confidence. You will design and evaluate pilots and A/B tests, quantify the impact of service improvements and communications, and build predictive models to forecast future trends and member behaviour.

Working closely with the Data and Governance team, you will support data quality initiatives, helping to identify and resolve data issues while contributing to the maintenance of a trusted, single source of truth. You will also play an important role in increasing data literacy across the organisation by supporting colleagues to access, understand and responsibly use data and insights in their day-to-day decision-making.

This is an exciting opportunity to contribute to the successful delivery of data products across The Law Society while helping to advance our analytical maturity and data-driven culture.








What we're looking for

We are looking for an experienced analyst with a strong track record of turning data into actionable insights and business value. You will have extensive experience using Python for data analysis, particularly with libraries such as Pandas and NumPy, alongside strong SQL or Spark SQL programming skills.

You will bring proven experience of creating engaging visualisations, dashboards and reports using Power BI or similar tools such as Tableau or Qlik, with the ability to present complex information in a clear and compelling way to both technical and non-technical audiences.

You will possess excellent numeracy skills and a strong understanding of statistical analysis and modelling, combined with advanced data wrangling, data cleaning and quality assurance experience. Your analytical mindset and problem-solving capabilities will enable you to identify trends, investigate issues and provide practical recommendations that support organisational objectives.

You will be comfortable managing multiple priorities and delivering high-quality work to agreed deadlines. A collaborative approach is essential, as you will work closely with colleagues across teams and functions to understand their needs and support the successful adoption of data products and insights.

Experience of working with tools such as DevOps, Jira and GitHub would be advantageous, as would an understanding of data governance, data security and regulatory compliance. Most importantly, you will be proactive, curious and committed to continuous improvement, with a passion for helping others make better use of data.
















What's in it for you

This is an excellent opportunity to work with colleagues in a progressive membership organisation. The successful candidate will join a strong brand with a reputation for excellence and legal expertise, committed to promoting equality, diversity and inclusion, and a culture of trust, clarity, excellence and respect.

We offer hybrid working, a generous flexible benefits package, a friendly working environment and the opportunity to develop your career within a professional organisation.

Please note: if you are an internal applicant, Pay Policy will apply.

Interviews are expected to take place during the week commencing 24 August.


The Law Society represents solicitors in England and Wales. From negotiating with and lobbying the profession's regulators, government and other decision makers, to offering training and advice, we're here to help, protect and promote solicitors.

As a Data Analyst, you will deliver high-quality insights and reporting that support strategic and operational decision-making across the organisation.

You will work with colleagues from a wide range of teams to transform complex data into meaningful recommendations, helping stakeholders understand performance, identify opportunities for improvement, and measure the impact of key initiatives. You will use a variety of analytical techniques to uncover trends, diagnose the root causes of business performance fluctuations, and provide evidence-based recommendations that drive action.

The role will involve developing automated dashboards and reporting solutions using tools such as Power BI and Databricks, enabling stakeholders to monitor key performance indicators with confidence. You will design and evaluate pilots and A/B tests, quantify the impact of service improvements and communications, and build predictive models to forecast future trends and member behaviour.

Working closely with the Data and Governance team, you will support data quality initiatives, helping to identify and resolve data issues while contributing to the maintenance of a trusted, single source of truth. You will also play an important role in increasing data literacy across the organisation by supporting colleagues to access, understand and responsibly use data and insights in their day-to-day decision-making.

This is an exciting opportunity to contribute to the successful delivery of data products across The Law Society while helping to advance our analytical maturity and data-driven culture.




What we're looking for

We are looking for an experienced analyst with a strong track record of turning data into actionable insights and business value. You will have extensive experience using Python for data analysis, particularly with libraries such as Pandas and NumPy, alongside strong SQL or Spark SQL programming skills.

You will bring proven experience of creating engaging visualisations, dashboards and reports using Power BI or similar tools such as Tableau or Qlik, with the ability to present complex information in a clear and compelling way to both technical and non-technical audiences.

You will possess excellent numeracy skills and a strong understanding of statistical analysis and modelling, combined with advanced data wrangling, data cleaning and quality assurance experience. Your analytical mindset and problem-solving capabilities will enable you to identify trends, investigate issues and provide practical recommendations that support organisational objectives.

You will be comfortable managing multiple priorities and delivering high-quality work to agreed deadlines. A collaborative approach is essential, as you will work closely with colleagues across teams and functions to understand their needs and support the successful adoption of data products and insights.

Experience of working with tools such as DevOps, Jira and GitHub would be advantageous, as would an understanding of data governance, data security and regulatory compliance. Most importantly, you will be proactive, curious and committed to continuous improvement, with a passion for helping others make better use of data.








What's in it for you

This is an excellent opportunity to work with colleagues in a progressive membership organisation. The successful candidate will join a strong brand with a reputation for excellence and legal expertise, committed to promoting equality, diversity and inclusion, and a culture of trust, clarity, excellence and respect.

We offer hybrid working, a generous flexible benefits package, a friendly working environment and the opportunity to develop your career within a professional organisation.

Please note: if you are an internal applicant, Pay Policy will apply.

Interviews are expected to take place during the week commencing 24 August.

The Law Society represents solicitors in England and Wales. From negotiating with and lobbying the profession's regulators, government and other decision makers, to offering training and advice, we're here to help, protect and promote solicitors.

Introduction

We are Ocado Group, and we're bringing world-class automation to online grocery. Our Ocado Smart Platform (OSP) combines cutting-edge robotics, AI, and IoT within our advanced CFCs (Customer Fulfilment Centres). We've mastered the single pick, transforming online delivery for our global partners. Join us and be part of a team pushing the boundaries of retail technology.

As a Last Mile Geospatial Analyst in the Global Technology Services (GTS) Analytics team, you'll use data to transform final-stage order fulfilment across the Ocado Smart Platform. Based in Hatfield, you'll deliver insights that improve delivery efficiency, customer satisfaction, and partner performance, with a focus on network planning, resource strategy, and routing optimisation.

Working across technology, operations, and international partners, you'll lead high-impact analytics projects, influence strategic decisions, and help drive lower costs and reduced carbon emissions. You'll also champion data best practices and mentor colleagues, combining technical expertise with leadership to shape the future of last-mile operations.

Key Responsibilities


Support the strategic roadmap for last-mile analytics, ensuring alignment with broader organisational goals and industry trends.
Partner with Last Mile leadership to develop data-driven strategies for route optimisation, network planning, and customer experience.
Build advanced forecasting and optimisation models to improve delivery efficiency, routing, and capacity utilisation.
Apply statistical methods and machine learning techniques to uncover actionable insights from complex delivery and customer datasets.
Track, analyse, and report on performance trends to identify operational bottlenecks and drive cost-saving initiatives.
Design, build, and maintain interactive dashboards and self-service tools using Looker to provide stakeholders with real-time performance insights.
Collaborate with software development teams to integrate analytics solutions into operational workflows and inform platform enhancements.
Provide strategic guidance and actionable insights to international partners and strategy planners across the globe.
Mentor, coach, and provide constructive feedback to team members, championing analytical best practices and supporting career development.


Essential

What We’re Looking For


Experience applying geospatial analytics and location-based data to optimise (things like) delivery networks, routing, and operational decision-making.
Exceptional stakeholder management skills, with a passion for driving the implementation of recommendations that deliver measurable results.
Technical proficiency in SQL and BigQuery.
Programming experience with Python or R is beneficial.
Proven experience creating data visualisations and dashboards using tools such as Looker, Tableau, or Looker Studio.
Strong analytical, numerical, and statistical skills, with the ability to translate complex data into actionable business insights.
Hands-on experience utilising AI tools to accelerate and enhance analytics workflows, from initial data exploration through to insight generation.


Nice to Haves


Experience in last-mile logistics, home delivery, network strategy, or retail/eCommerce fulfillment operations.
Experience in last-mile logistics and network planning, including holistic operational cost-to-serve modeling.
An understanding of eCommerce customer behavior and key operational metrics such as drop densities and on-time delivery rates.
Professional experience within a consulting or advisory role, bringing structured problem-solving to projects with varied stakeholders.
A proven track record of working closely with external partners to deploy and operationalise data solutions at scale.


Benefits

Commuter perks: Cycle to Work Scheme and free shuttle buses to/from Hatfield and Welwyn Garden City stations.
Exclusive discounts: 15% off at Ocado.com with free delivery (starting in your first month).


Be bold, be unique, be brilliant, be you. We are looking for individuality and we value diversity. We are an equal opportunities employer and we are committed to treating all applicants and employees fairly and equally. We are committed to making reasonable adjustments to provide a positive, barrier-free recruitment process and supportive work environment. If you have any support or access requirements, we encourage you to advise us at the time of application.

Title: Pricing Analyst
Description:
About Pikl

Pikl is on a mission to enable the growth of digital marketplaces, starting with vacation rentals. We design and deliver insurance-enabled solutions that help platforms, property managers and owners unlock new revenue and deliver better customer experiences.




Founded in 2016, we began by protecting individual hosts and homeowners with specialist holiday-let cover. That experience now powers our insurance-enabled products, which increase participation, lift conversion and drive revenue across the marketplace value chain: platforms, homeowners and guests.




With offices in Norwich and London, and plans for international expansion, we work with some of the most recognised brands in travel as well as major insurance aggregators.




About the Role

Supporting the Pricing and Underwriting team in the delivery of pricing activity across Pikl's insurance products and partnerships. The role is responsible for pricing analysis, portfolio monitoring and supporting the development of pricing models to ensure sustainable and profitable growth.




Working collaboratively with Underwriting, Product, Claims and Partnership teams to understand performance drivers, identify opportunities and support pricing decision making. Supporting the pricing of new schemes and products, ongoing portfolio management and the continued development of pricing capability across the business.




Key Responsibilities

Support the development, maintenance and enhancement of pricing models across Pikl products.
Conduct pricing and portfolio analysis to identify trends, opportunities and areas of concern.
Monitor product and portfolio performance, including premium adequacy, loss ratios, rating performance and profitability.
Support the pricing of new products, schemes and partnership opportunities.
Produce pricing analyses, reports and recommendations to support business decision making.
Work closely with Underwriting, Claims, Product and Partnerships teams to understand portfolio performance and drivers of risk.
Support the ongoing monitoring and validation of pricing models and rating structures.
Contribute to the assessment and integration of internal and external data sources.
Undertake competitor and market analysis to support pricing recommendations.
Support the development of pricing processes, tools and reporting capabilities.
Ensure pricing activity complies with regulatory requirements and fair value principles.
Be a source of pricing and pricing delivery support within the business.




About You:

Experience in an insurance pricing, pricing support, actuarial or pricing-related analytical role.
Experience using data to support pricing decisions and business recommendations.
Strong Excel skills.
Experience of analysing large datasets and identifying trends and insights.
Ability to interpret data and translate findings into practical recommendations.
Good communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences.
Ability to manage competing priorities and work effectively within a fast-paced environment.
Collaborative approach with the ability to build relationships across teams.
Progress towards a professional qualification (e.g. IFoA) or interest in pursuing further professional development.
Experience within General Insurance pricing.
Experience using SQL for data extraction and analysis.
Experience using Python, R or similar analytical tools.
Experience using pricing software such as Radar or Earnix.
Understanding of insurance pricing concepts and portfolio performance metrics.
Exposure to predictive modelling, machine learning or statistical modelling techniques.
Experience working within an MGA, delegated authority or capacity-backed environment is desirable.




Our Values

At Pikl, our values are the foundation on which our success is built. They guide how we work together, how we make decisions for customers and colleagues, and what we recognise and reward.




Possibility

We think big and are fearless in turning challenges into opportunities. We stay curious, test ideas and learn quickly.




People

We put people first, building relationships rooted in empathy and trust. We respect, include, and learn from one another. We celebrate progress.




Progress

We unlock growth opportunities for our customers and each other yet make it our personal responsibility to own actions and see them through.




Why work at Pikl

Hybrid & Flexible working set up
Access to an incredible working space in Norwich and London
Annual leave entitlement of 28 days, plus bank holidays
35 hour working week
Employee Assistant Program with 24/7 GP support and wellbeing services for you and your immediate family
10% discount with Sykes Cottages
Training and development opportunities
Social events
Support from an awarding-winning CEO & Founder

Title: Technical Modelling Analyst
Description:
About Homeprotect

Cover for Almost every Home

We founded Homeprotect on a simple principle - to provide protection to people underserved by the home insurance industry. Since 2002, we've been combining smart technology with real human expertise to protect hundreds of thousands of unique homes across the UK, and we're just getting started.

If you're someone who loves solving interesting problems, taking ownership and working with a team that aims high, speaks up and lifts each other, Homeprotect is a place where you can do meaningful work, grow your career and make a real difference for our customers.

What It's Like To Work Here

Our customers come from all walks of life and so do our people. We're a small but perfectly formed team of insurance specialists, technologists, data scientists and customer champions - all bringing individual expertise, an appetite for innovation and a shared ambition to protect the homes and things people love.

We work at pace, but we trust our people to work in a way that brings out their best. You'll collaborate closely across teams, have real ownership from day one and see the impact you have first-hand with flexible working to help you balance the needs of your role with the rhythm of your life.

We've been recognised as a Great Place to Work UK for seven consecutive years - most recently ranked 29th nationally, jumping 71 places in a single year.

ROLE PURPOSE

The Technical Modelling Analyst will report to the Lead Technical Modelling Manager and support the design and build of risk price projects for home insurance. It involves data extraction, analysis and modelling across the portfolio of retail products/perils. This role involves collaboration with other teams; strong communication skills required. The role resides within the technical pricing and underwriting team and wider commercial team working alongside retail pricing experts, data science and product deployment. As part of pre-deployment analysis, you will support management with the analysis or rate impact calculations. Monitoring rates and determining appropriate action is also necessary.

Key Responsibilities


The Technical Modelling Analyst will report to the Lead Technical Modelling Manager and support the design and build of risk price projects for home insurance.
It involves data extraction, analysis and modelling across the portfolio of retail products/perils.
This role involves collaboration with other teams; strong communication skills required.
The role resides within the technical pricing and underwriting team and wider commercial team working alongside retail pricing experts, data science and product deployment.
As part of pre-deployment analysis, you will support management with the analysis or rate impact calculations.
Monitoring rates and determining appropriate action is also necessary.


KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS & EXPERIENCE


Pricing analytical skills (essential)
Personal Lines risk pricing (essential)
Working knowledge with Akur8/Emblem/similar (highly beneficial)
Actuarial science background (beneficial)
Machine Learning/algorithms (beneficial)
SQL/SAS – data extraction and analytical expert (essential)
Open-source R/Python coding (highly beneficial)


We would love to hear from people with the following skills and experience for this role:


Actuarial science
Risk Pricing
Data science; open-source solutions (pricing specific experience)
Emblem/Akur8/Radar/related


Benefits

We want you to feel rewarded, supported and set up to thrive throughout your career with us.

Learning and Growth: We invest in your development through structured learning, mentoring, buddying, on-the-job experience and cross-functional projects. We support role-relevant professional qualifications where they'll make the biggest difference, and our Lunch and Learn sessions to help you stay connected to what’s going on right across the business.

Health and Wellbeing: Your wellbeing matters here. We offer private healthcare through BUPA, an Employee Assistance Programme covering legal, financial and counselling support for you, a Wellbeing Centre with online tools and resources, regular wellbeing seminars and workshops, annual flu jabs and an annual eye care voucher.

Financial Security and Reward: We offer an annual discretionary bonus scheme up to 30% of your base pay, life insurance at four times your salary, and a pension with Aegon. You'll also receive a significant discount on Homeprotect home insurance - with a friends and family discount too, and a staff referral bonus when someone you recommend joins the team.

Time Off: 25 days' annual leave plus bank holidays, with the option to buy or sell up to five additional days each year.

Genuine Flexible Working We trust our people to work in a way that best suits them - with flexible working to balance the needs of your role with the rhythm of your life. We ask that everyone comes into the office at least once a week, as we believe in-person connection is important for collaboration, culture and building great relationships. You'll receive a homeworking starter kit from day one and can claim towards additional home office equipment within your first six months.

Purpose and Community: We care about more than just the work. Through our charity partnership with Refuge, the UK's largest specialist domestic abuse charity and regular social, wellbeing and charitable events throughout the year, there are plenty of ways to connect, give back and feel part of something bigger.

UNIQUE AS STANDARD

We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer and actively encourage applications from all backgrounds. We believe in celebrating difference - everything that makes both our customers and our people unique. We consider visa sponsorship on a case by case basis for the right candidate, so please don't let that stop you from applying.

We encourage you to let us know if you need any extra help with your application or have any requirements at any stage of the recruitment journey, we want the process to work for you.

Your data will be maintained in line with our recruitment data privacy policy.

Regulatory Responsibilities

Cover for Almost every Home

We founded Homeprotect on a simple principle - to provide protection to people underserved by the home insurance industry. Since 2002, we've been combining smart technology with real human expertise to protect hundreds of thousands of unique homes across the UK, and we're just getting started.

If you're someone who loves solving interesting problems, taking ownership and working with a team that aims high, speaks up and lifts each other, Homeprotect is a place where you can do meaningful work, grow your career and make a real difference for our customers.

What It's Like To Work Here

Our customers come from all walks of life and so do our people. We're a small but perfectly formed team of insurance specialists, technologists, data scientists and customer champions - all bringing individual expertise, an appetite for innovation and a shared ambition to protect the homes and things people love.

We work at pace, but we trust our people to work in a way that brings out their best. You'll collaborate closely across teams, have real ownership from day one and see the impact you have first-hand with flexible working to help you balance the needs of your role with the rhythm of your life.

We've been recognised as a Great Place to Work UK for seven consecutive years - most recently ranked 29th nationally, jumping 71 places in a single year.

The Technical Modelling Analyst will report to the Lead Technical Modelling Manager and support the design and build of risk price projects for home insurance.
