Title: Data Analyst
Description:
THE OPPORTUNITY

The First Nations Tax Commission's is looking for a Data Analyst to help build and advance our Data and Statistics function. Reporting to the Director, Information & Technology, the Data Analyst helps transform data into meaningful insights that support strategic decision-making, demonstrate the impact of FNTC services, and strengthen the understanding of First Nation local revenues and economies.




Working closely with the Data Engineer, the Data Analyst develops reports, dashboards, and visualizations that enable evidence-informed decision-making across the organization. As the primary point of contact for staff, the Data Analyst helps ensure data is accessible, understood, and effectively used to support organizational priorities.




This is an exciting opportunity for someone who enjoys solving complex programs, collaborating with others and continuously improving how data is used to support organizational priorities.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

Analyze complex datasets to identify trends, patterns, and insights that support organizational planning, decision-making, and program evaluation.
Prepare, interpret, and communicate analytical findings through dashboards, reports, infographics, and other data visualizations.
Develop and maintain key performance indicators, performance measures, and reporting frameworks.
Translate technical and statistical information into meaningful business insights for technical and non-technical audiences.
Respond to requests for information, reporting, and data analysis from across the organization.
Serve as the primary point of contact for staff requiring support with dashboards, reporting tools, and the Data and Statistics Function.
Collaborate with business areas to identify reporting needs, gather requirements, and recommend data-driven solutions.
Support user training and promote effective use of reporting tools and dashboards.
Develop and maintain documentation for reporting methodologies, business definitions, and analytical processes.
Partner with the Data Engineer to improve reporting capabilities, data quality, and analytical processes.
Support the development and continuous improvement of policies, procedures, and standards related to data collection, validation, management, and reporting.
Contribute to organizational information management, privacy, records management, and data governance practices.
Support compliance with ISO certification requirements and other applicable data standards and best practices.
Identify opportunities to automate reporting, improve data accessibility, and enhance organizational reporting capabilities.
Contribute to projects that strengthen organizational research, evidence-informed decision-making, and continuous improvement.




WHAT YOU BRING

We're looking for a naturally curious professional who enjoys transforming data into meaningful insights. Someone who thrives on problem solving, collaborating with others, and continuously improving how data is collected, analyzed, and used to support better decision-making.




The successful candidate will likely bring:

A post-secondary education in Computer Science, Data Science, Information Systems, Business Analytics, Software Engineering, or a related discipline—or an equivalent combination of education, training, certifications, and experience.
Two (2) to three (3) experience in data analysis, business intelligence, reporting, or analytics, with the ability to analyze complex datasets and translate findings into meaningful business insights.
Experience developing dashboards, reports, and visualizations using Power BI or similar business intelligence tools.
Understanding of data governance, data quality, information management, privacy legislation, and records management principles.
Experience with Microsoft Fabric, Azure, Databricks, SQL, or similar analytics platforms is considered an asset. Microsoft certifications in Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, Azure, Data Analytics, or related disciplines are considered assets.
Knowledge of artificial intelligence technologies and their application to analytics and business intelligence is considered an asset.
Strong analytical and critical thinking skills, with the ability to identify trends, patterns, and opportunities from complex data.
The ability to communicate technical and statistical information clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Excellent organizational, project management, and time management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
Strong interpersonal, written, verbal, and presentation skills, with a collaborative approach to working across teams.
A commitment to continuous learning and staying current with emerging technologies, analytics tools, and industry best practices.




WHY JOIN US? 

At the FNTC, you'll have the opportunity to build something meaningful. We offer:

A competitive total rewards package, including a comprehensive benefits plan and a 7% employer-matched retirement savings program.
Generous paid time off, including an annual winter office closure.
Observance of federal holidays, including paid recognition of National Indigenous Peoples Day
Ongoing learning and development opportunities that support your professional growth and career growth.
A collaborative, inclusive, and purpose-driven team environment committed to enabling healthy, vibrant and sustainable First Nation communities. 




We are an equal opportunity employer that values and celebrates the unique experiences and perspectives of First Nations peoples and individuals from diverse backgrounds across Canada. We are committed to fostering an inclusive environment where everyone feels respected and supported.




As a First Nations-led institution, we strongly encourage applications from individuals with lived or living experience as an Indigenous person.




Ready to apply?

Please submit a resume and cover letter as part of your application. Thank you in advance for your interest in this opportunity—please note that only those selected for an interview will be contacted. 




ANALYSTE DE DONNÉES, SERVICES INTÉGRÉS




LA POSSIBILITÉ

La Commission de la fiscalité des premières nations est à la recherche d’un ou d’une analyste de données pour nous aider à établir et à faire progresser notre fonction de Données et statistiques. Relevant du directeur ou de la directrice, Information et technologie, l’analyste de données aide à transformer les données en informations utiles qui appuient la prise de décisions stratégiques, démontrent l’incidence des services de la CFPN et renforcent la compréhension des recettes et des économies des Premières Nations.




En travaillant en étroite collaboration avec l’ingénieur ou l’ingénieure de données, l’analyste de données élabore et communique des tableaux de bord et des visualisations qui permettent la prise de décisions éclairées par des données probantes à l’échelle de l’organisation. En tant que personne-ressource principale pour le personnel, l’analyste de données aide à veiller à ce que les données soient accessibles, comprises et utilisées de manière efficace pour soutenir les priorités organisationnelles.




Il s’agit d’une possibilité passionnante pour quelqu’un qui aime résoudre des programmes complexes, collaborer avec les autres et améliorer de façon continue la façon dont les données sont utilisées pour soutenir les priorités organisationnelles.

 

CE QUE VOUS APPORTEZ

Le candidat retenu ou la candidate retenue apportera probablement :

Des études postsecondaires en informatique, Sciences des données, Systèmes d’information, Analyse commerciale, Génie logiciel ou dans une discipline connexe—ou une combinaison équivalente d’études, de formation, de certifications et d’expérience;
De deux (2) à trois (3) ans d’expérience en analyse de données, informatique décisionnelle, production de rapports ou en analytique, de même que la capacité d’analyser des ensembles de données complexes et de traduire les résultats en perspectives d’affaires utiles;
De l’expérience dans l’élaboration de tableaux de bord, de rapports et de visualisations en utilisant Power BI ou des outils semblables d’informatique décisionnelle;
Une compréhension de la gouvernance des données, de la qualité des données, de la gestion de l’information, des lois sur la protection de la vie privée et des principes de gestion des documents;
De l’expérience avec Microsoft Fabric, Azure, Databricks, SQL ou des plateformes d’analyse semblables est considérée comme étant un atout. Des certifications Microsoft en Power BI, en Microsoft Fabric, en Azure, en analyse de données ou en d’autres disciplines connexes sont considérées comme des atouts;
La connaissance des technologies d’intelligence artificielle et de leur application à l’analyse et à l’informatique décisionnelle est considérée comme un atout;
De solides compétences analytiques et de pensée critique, accompagnées de la capacité à cerner les tendances, les schémas et les possibilités à partir de données complexes;
La capacité de communiquer clairement de l’information technique et statistique autant à des public-cibles techniques que non techniques;
Un sens de l’organisation et d’excellentes aptitudes en matière de gestion de projet et de gestion du temps, accompagnés de la capacité de gérer plusieurs priorités en même temps;
De solides habiletés interpersonnelles, en communication écrite et verbale et en techniques de présentation, accompagnées d’une approche axée sur la collaboration pour travailler avec différentes équipes;
Un engagement vis-à-vis l’apprentissage continu et à se tenir à jour avec les nouvelles technologies, les nouveaux outils d’analyse et les pratiques exemplaires de l’industrie.




Vous êtes prêt(e) à postuler?

Veuillez nous faire parvenir un curriculum vitæ et une lettre d’accompagnement dans le cadre de votre demande. Merci à l’avance pour votre intérêt à l’égard de cette possibilité d’emploi—veuillez noter que nous ne communiquerons qu’avec les candidats et candidates retenus pour une entrevue.

We are a trusted construction partner for many leading developers with over 12 million square feet under construction in Metro Vancouver, Victoria, Calgary, Toronto, Seattle, and Nashville. From iconic residential developments to community-oriented public spaces, our focus on delivering an exceptional product and customer experience sets us apart. Together, our team of construction professionals takes pride in building value in everything we do, with the highest quality standards and a safety-first culture.

Our people bring more than outstanding skills and experience—they bring our values to life: Accountability, Autonomy, Humility, Respect, and Excellence. How do our values show up? In the ownership we take for our work and pride in what we build. In the respect we have for everyone we work with, no matter their role. In our ability to balance confidence with humility by listening first, being open to new ideas and innovation. In our leadership trusting our people to make decisions, own outcomes, and do what’s right for the team, project clients, and trade partners.

Does it sound like you’d thrive here? Learn more about how our people live our values.

YOUR NEW OPPORTUNITY

This will be our first dedicated Data Analyst and will be a unique opportunity to create meaningful and impactful change within Axiom Builders. This role partners closely with our Data Engineer to ensure data is accurate, well-defined, and usable through curated datasets, standardized metrics, and high-quality Power BI dashboards. You will partner closely with our executives to create high-impact reports and insights into the business.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build, maintain, and improve Power BI dashboards and scorecards for project/site, departmental, and executive audiences;
  • Apply best practices in visualization, measure design, performance, and report governance;
  • Develop and maintain a KPI/data dictionary and report documentation (definitions, refresh cadence, intended use, and limitations);
  • Support a “single source of truth” approach by aligning stakeholders on definitions and interpretation of metrics;
  • Validate data quality (accuracy, completeness, consistency, timeliness) for key dashboards and critical reporting outputs;
  • Investigate anomalies and reconcile results across systems;
  • Promote data literacy by explaining metrics in plain language and documenting “how to” usage for key reports.

Skills & Experience

  • 3-5 years of experience between Data Analytics and/or Engineering;
  • Diploma or similar education in Computer Science or Data Analytics; comparable data-focused programs and work experiences will also be considered;
  • Advanced skills using Power BI (data modeling concepts, DAX measures, report design, performance optimization);
  • Experience with tools like Power Query and SQL for querying, validating, and reconciling reporting datasets;
  • Knowledge of Construction Management reporting concepts (RFIs, submittals, change management, issues, inspections), or a keen interest in learning about construction is considered an asset.

YOUR REWARDS

Axiom Builders offers more than just competitive compensation and benefits; we give you the tools to build a long-term career.

Hear from our people on what it means to grow here, and learn about all the extras we offer: Why Axiom Builders.

The base salary range for this role is $90,000 to $110,000, adjusted for experience, plus a competitive bonus program. During the interview process, let’s talk to get the right fit for your experience level.

A proactive learner who is curious, adaptable, and driven to improve processes

Title: Pricing Analyst
Description:
Clio is the global leader in legal AI technology, empowering legal professionals and law firms of every size to work smarter, faster, and more securely.

We are transforming the legal experience for all by bettering the lives of legal professionals while increasing access to justice.

Summary:

We are currently seeking a Pricing Analyst to join our Marketing Team in Vancouver, Calgary, or Toronto.

What your team does:

The Monetization team leads Clio’s AI-first pricing and packaging strategy and execution across all regions, including initiatives for new and existing customer segments, products, plans, bundles and cross-portfolio upgrades. This is a highly strategic team contributing to Clio’s success in a highly cross functional role working across nearly all functions at Clio.

Who you are:

You're analytical and curious about customer behaviour, comfortable working through large volumes of data to find the story in the numbers. You like turning ad hoc, manual processes into something repeatable, and you enjoy building partnerships across the business. You're also detail-oriented, organized, and self-managing, with a habit of verifying your own work. You build in checks, flag what looks off, and hold a high bar for accuracy.

What you’ll work on:

As a Pricing Analyst, you'll own the execution and measurement of pricing changes, from account migrations in our billing systems and Salesforce to the modeling, reporting, and testing that tell us whether a change worked.


Own recurring price-based account migrations end to end, from cohort segmentation and batch processing through QA and post-migration validation, and build the formula-driven templates that make them repeatable and auditable at scale
Support the models that price new releases and size the impact of changes on existing customers, and help package the findings into recommendations
Partner with Data & Insights to build the dashboards and automated reporting that track realized vs. list price, discount depth, and ARPA by cohort, so the team catches problems early
Work across Billing Ops, Sales Ops, CS Ops, and Enablement to automate the manual steps in pricing execution and equip Sales and CS when prices change
Help design and run in-market price tests to validate willingness to pay before changes roll out broadly
Use AI tooling to compress the analysis and execution cycle, from generating and QA'ing migration cohorts to automating the handoff into Salesforce and building intuitive internal pricing calculators and price sheets


What you may have:


2+ years in financial or business analysis and modeling, preferably for B2B SaaS, including heavy spreadsheet work with nested logic and QA across large datasets
Hands-on experience in a subscription billing system (Zuora, Stripe, Chargebee, or similar) and a CRM like Salesforce, including bulk updates and data validation across large account sets
2+ years building dashboards and queries in Looker, Tableau, or similar
Experience with pricing analysis across SaaS charge models, such as subscription, usage-based, tiered, and per-seat
Experience running cross-functional projects in Asana or similar, coordinating with ops and GTM teams to keep work moving
Strong communication skills, with the ability to deliver clear status updates, business insights, and recommendations in written, presentation, and spoken form
Experience using AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini) to support analysis, workflows, and day-to-day productivity


Serious bonus points if you have:


Experience with Workato or similar integration and task-automation tools
Prior experience executing pricing or plan migrations at scale

The Monetization team leads Clio’s AI-first pricing and packaging strategy and execution across all regions, including initiatives for new and existing customer segments, products, plans, bundles and cross-portfolio upgrades.   • Experience with pricing analysis across SaaS charge models, such as subscription, usage-based, tiered, and per-seat

  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to deliver clear status updates, business insights, and recommendations in written, presentation, and spoken form
  • Experience using AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini) to support analysis, workflows, and day-to-day productivity

  • Experience with Workato or similar integration and task-automation tools
  • Prior experience executing pricing or plan migrations at scale

Title: iLottery Digital Gaming Analyst
Description:
We’re looking for a detailed-orientated individual to join our growing analytics team as an iLottery Digital Gaming Analyst to work remotely within Canada in the Central or Eastern time zone. This is an exciting opportunity that performs analysis and projections related to iLottery digital gaming to influence the success of the organization’s new and current iLottery portfolio. Reporting to the Manager of Digital Analytics, this role will plan, organize, and follow through on requirements related to game launches and player behavior within iLottery products.

Who We Are

With a legacy spanning over a century, Pollard Banknote has become a world leader in instant ticket manufacturing and digital lottery solutions that enhance player engagement through cutting-edge technology. Our diverse and talented team brings ideas to life through creativity, innovation, and collaboration. From exciting lottery experiences to impactful partnerships, we’re shaping the future of gaming and making a difference in millions of lives. Join us and help reimagine how the world plays.

What We Offer


Competitive compensation
Profit sharing program – every role plays a part in our success!
Comprehensive Group Benefits
Opportunities for professional development
A variety of committee-driven employee engagement activities
Remote Work Environment


What You'll Do


Ensure on time delivery of regular reporting and actionable eInstant Game Studio insights to internal and external stakeholders to inform strategic business decisions
Assist in eInstant Benchmark reporting design and development
Maintain and analyze iLottery annual and monthly goals model
Assist with iLottery new business analysis by request
Monitor and collaborate on insights from iLottery industry with internal stakeholders
Assist and support the Manager of Digital Analytics as needed
Miscellaneous tasks as requested by Director of Digital Games Studio


Who You Are


A highly motivated self-starter with superb verbal and written communication skills
A creative go-getter who dives in, takes the initiative and sees projects through to completion
An analytical thinker who collects and analyzes data & insights to make sound decisions
A team player with the ability to build and maintain relationships at all levels of the organization
A detail-oriented professional with the ability to prioritize tasks and remain organized in a fast-paced environment


What You'll Bring


3+ years working in the analytics industry
Post-Secondary education in a field with an emphasis on statistical and analytical skills such as statistics, mathematics or computer science
Superior written and verbal communication skills
Proficient in the Microsoft Office Suite; Word, Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint

Title: Staff Analytics Analyst, Full Stack (Revenue)
Description:
Affirm is reinventing credit to make it more honest and friendly, giving consumers the flexibility to buy now and pay later without any hidden fees or compounding interest.

About The Team

We’re looking for an experienced, highly independent analytics engineer to join our Revenue Analytics team. This team owns the data products, reporting infrastructure, semantic foundations, and analytical systems that support Affirm’s Revenue organization.

About The Role

In this role, you will lead the development of scalable, trusted data products for Affirm’s revenue teams. You turn ambiguous business and technical problems into scalable solutions across data modeling, metrics, dashboards, automation, governance, and AI enablement. You will help set the technical direction for Revenue’s data layer, establish the semantic and metadata foundations required for AI, and raise the quality and impact of data across the Revenue organization.

What You’ll Do


Lead high-impact data product initiatives for Revenue, from ambiguous problem definition through technical design, implementation, rollout, and adoption.
Advance AI initiatives within the Revenue data ecosystem by identifying high-value use cases, integrating AI into analytics engineering workflows, and establishing the semantic, metadata, context, quality, and evaluation foundations required for AI.
Design and build durable, well-tested data products that power revenue operations, field and executive reporting, external merchant reporting, and analyst self-service.
Set technical direction for Revenue’s data layer across dbt models, metrics, semantic structures, documentation, lineage, testing, governance, and access controls.
Identify opportunities to simplify, automate, and scale Revenue Analytics through improved data architecture, tooling, governance, and enablement.
Provide technical leadership and mentorship to analysts and cross-functional partners, raising the bar for how data products are designed, built, and maintained.


What We Look For


7+ years of experience in analytics engineering, business intelligence, data engineering, data product development, or a related technical analytics role.
Deep expertise in SQL, dbt, data modeling, metrics design, data quality, documentation, and modern analytics engineering practices.
Strong working knowledge of BI tools such as Sigma, Looker, or Tableau, cloud data warehouses such as Snowflake, and modern data platforms such as Databricks.
Strong understanding of the foundations required for reliable AI—including semantic layers, metadata, evaluations, documentation, lineage, access controls, and data quality—and experience applying AI tools within analytics engineering workflows.
Demonstrated ability to independently lead complex, ambiguous projects by defining scope, sequencing work, managing tradeoffs, aligning stakeholders, and delivering durable technical solutions.
Experience designing scalable data products for multiple audiences and influencing technical and non-technical stakeholders around architecture and product direction.
Familiarity with Salesforce and experience supporting commercial, GTM, revenue, or sales operations teams.


Pay Grade - O

Equity Grade - 6

Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range. Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure which is based on a variety of factors, including location, experience and job-related skills.

Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include equity rewards, monthly stipends for health, wellness and tech spending, and benefits (including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental and vision for you and your dependents.)

CAN base pay range per year: $173,000 - $233,000

Please note that visa sponsorship is not available for this position.

Affirm is proud to be a remote-first company! The majority of our roles are remote and you can work almost anywhere within the country of employment. Affirmers in proximal roles have the flexibility to work remotely, but will occasionally be required to work out of their assigned Affirm office. A limited number of roles remain office-based due to the nature of their job responsibilities.

Benefits

We’re extremely proud to offer competitive benefits that are anchored to our core value of people come first. Some key highlights of our benefits package include:


Health care coverage - Affirm covers all premiums for all levels of coverage for you and your dependents
Flexible Spending Wallets - generous stipends for spending on Technology, Food, various Lifestyle needs, and family forming expenses
Time off - competitive vacation and holiday schedules allowing you to take time off to rest and recharge
ESPP - An employee stock purchase plan enabling you to buy shares of Affirm at a discount


We believe It’s On Us to provide an inclusive interview experience for all, including people with disabilities. We are happy to provide reasonable accommodations to candidates in need of individualized support during the hiring process.

[For U.S. positions that could be performed in Los Angeles or San Francisco] Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, Affirm will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

By clicking "Submit Application," you acknowledge that you have read Affirm's Global Candidate Privacy Notice and hereby freely and unambiguously give informed consent to the collection, processing, use, and storage of your personal information as described therein.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
At Kabam, we’re constantly raising the bar of excellence in free-to-play gaming. We hire for passion and diversity so that we can triumph in our collective skill. Our teams are made up of a fusion of personalities and interests bound together by a collaborative nature, fun-loving culture, and a drive to do what it takes to make great games. And this is where you come in…

The Data Analyst utilizes their quantitative analytical skills and scientific thought process to interpret and

analyze large sets of complex data, while extracting meaningful insights for Kabam. This role works

closely with our internal gaming team to optimize every facet of player retention and monetization to

ensure the continued success of our games.

This role is a full-time, on-site position based 5 days a week at our Downtown Vancouver studio.

Provide Cross-functional Support

In this role, you can expect to:


Collaborate with various teams across the organization to understand their business goals and data needs.
Improve reporting processes by identifying inefficiencies and suggesting enhancements.
Assist with larger-scale projects as required, contributing data-driven insights.


Data Exploration And Analysis


Use SQL to extract and manipulate data from various sources.
Perform hands-on exploration of data sets to answer business questions.
Utilize statistical analysis to identify trends, correlations, and patterns within the data.
Create data visualizations to communicate findings effectively.


Dashboard And Report Management


Develop and maintain a suite of dashboards and reports tailored to the needs of different teams within the organization.
Ensure that dashboards and reports are up-to-date and accurate.
Prepare ad-hoc reports as requested.


A/B Testing


Design, execute, and manage multiple A/B tests to gain insights into key performance indicators (KPIs) such as retention, acquisition, and monetization.
Analyze the results of A/B tests to draw actionable conclusions.
Make data-driven recommendations for optimizing business strategies based on results of A/B testing.


Product Feature Analysis And Optimization


Measure the success of newly released product features using key metrics and data analysis.
Drive data-driven iteration and optimization of product features to enhance performance and user experience.


Task Prioritization And Project Management


Assist in task prioritization within the data team based on business needs and project requirements.
Collaborate with team members to achieve project goals efficiently.


To Be Successful In This Role, Your Background Includes


Bachelor’s Degree in related field.
3+ years of industry data analysis experience, with solid knowledge of statistical methods.
1+ years of industry data experience in games (mobile, console, PC), online casino, slot games, or any high volume B2C mobile apps.
Expert SQL skills and experience querying very large data sets.
Proven ability to thrive using multiple mixed, varied, and inconsistent data sources.
Fundamental knowledge of project management methodologies.
Regular communication with stakeholders from other departments and drive actionable items for continuous improvement.
Experience with Google BigQuery, Tableau, JIRA and/or other project management software.
Experience working for a social or mobile game developer.
Understanding of game design concepts and principles.


Benefits

Our success is due to the hard work of our people. We share our success with our people through flexible benefits and reward programs, sweet swag, snacks, and more. Here’s a look at some of the support we provide our people:


Extended Health Coverage: effective day one, no waiting period! Our benefits cover health, dental, life, disability, and extended paramedical services such as vision care, mental health practitioners, massage, physiotherapy, acupuncture, and much more.
DEIB Benefits: DEIB is important to us and to our people - that’s why our benefits include gender-affirming care, fertility care, and other hormonal treatments and drugs.
Flexible Spending Accounts: our benefits are built on a flex credit model, so you’re able to choose the coverage levels that are right for you, and allocate the rest to a group RRSP/TFSA, Health Spending account, and/or Personal Spending Account.
RRSP Matching: everyone retires eventually, and we help our people save for their futures with a contribution matching program once you reach 90 days with us.
Commuter Benefit: we believe in the power of in-person collaboration, and want to support you in making it work for you! We provide a flexible, monthly cash allowance to help cover the costs of transit, parking, or even personal logistics like childcare and pet care.
PTO and Parental Leave: we offer paid parental leave, flexible paid time off, paid time off for volunteering, sick leave, and holiday closures.
Employee and Family Assistance Program: this program provides crisis management support, immediate mental health care, and generalized support for emotional, mental, and financial well-being.
Telus Virtual Health: we provide increased access to remote healthcare providers for prescription refills or referrals from the comfort of your home.
Learning and growth: We encourage people to grow both personally and professionally, and support this through regular lunch & learns and an education stipend.
Pay transparency: We share with employees the pay range their role falls within and clear career maps to determine how they can grow within their role or level-up to a promotion.
Cool spaces: Our offices are in Vancouver, Montreal, Los Angeles, and San Francisco. Whether it’s summers on the rooftop patio in Downtown Vancouver, or watching the fireworks in Montreal’s South Shore - we want our people to feel like their time spent in office is worthwhile!
Giving back: Kabammers have a dedicated paid day off every year to volunteer to a cause close to their hearts. Some teams even band together for group volunteer days off-site!


$73,300 - $91,600 a year

The typical hiring range listed above is specific to candidates located in Vancouver. The salary will be determined based on your knowledge, skills and competencies, and you’ll have room to grow after you join!

If you’re interested in the position but your expectations don’t fully align with the provided range, we still encourage you to apply! Considerations may be made based on your experience level.

Who We Are

Simon Fraser University is a leading research university, advancing an inclusive and sustainable future. Our purpose – the essence of SFU – is to create and connect knowledge, learning and community for deeper understanding and meaningful impact. We are committed to fostering excellence, innovation, belonging and community in all that we do.

Student Services at Simon Fraser University is a large and diverse organization comprised of multiple departments working towards the common goals of strategic enrolment management, holistic student development and well-being, academic growth and success, co-curricular learning, and many other critical services and resources supporting individual SFU students along their educational journey. Dedicated to an inclusive and accessible approach to understanding its ever-changing student community, Student Services is proactive and responsive to the needs of SFU students and determined to meet its students where they’re at with innovative and student-centric initiatives.





About The Role

The Quantitative Analyst is responsible for the development and delivery of statistical modeling and forecasting, data analysis, and providing assessment information to support strategic planning, decision making, policy development, and business process improvement for Student Services. Acting as a data scientist, the Quantitative Analyst designs research and statistical methodology, provides in-depth data analysis, in-depth statistical analysis, quantitative and qualitative analysis and reporting for Strategic Enrolment Management (SEM) functions. The Quantitative Analyst maintains expertise in all aspects of student records and student success outcomes; assists in the oversight of Business Analysis and Assessment (BAA) reporting infrastructure; and prepares, delivers, and evaluates training on the use of reporting and other software systems. The Quantitative Analyst assists in the development, updating, and management of data and information in the Student Services databases. The role extracts data and information from other internal and external sources to prepare ad hoc and recurring reports and assessments.

Bachelor's degree in Statistics or a related quantitative science and three years of relevant experience in developing statistical and data analysis and survey methodologies, or an equivalent combination of education, training, and experience.


Excellent knowledge of query and programming languages, and relational databases (e.g. R, Python, SQL, SAS, Stata).

Advanced quantitative problem-solving skills, knowledge of research methodologies, data analysis, and report writing skills.
Excellent interpersonal and communication skills.

Title: Cloud Data Analyst (Methods Analyst II) (ID: 55798)
Description:
Are you passionate about leveraging modern cloud data architecture and artificial intelligence to make a tangible impact on public transit?

Edmonton Transit Service (ETS) is looking for an innovative and collaborative Cloud Data Analyst to act as the cloud infrastructure expert of our team. In this pivotal role, you will architect and scale end-to-end data pipelines (ETL/ELT) on the Google Cloud Platform, transforming over million rows of complex and raw transit telemetry daily into actionable insights and advanced AI models. Your technical expertise will directly support daily transit operations, optimize workforce scheduling for over 2,000 transit operators, and continuously improve the transit experience across our city. If you are driven by cloud computing efficiency, pipeline reliability, and writing scalable production code, this is your opportunity to build upon our existing enterprise architecture and scale it for the AI era!

What will you do?


Build & Scale Data Architecture: Design, maintain, and optimize robust ETL/ELT pipelines in Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and BigQuery to process over a million rows of transit data daily
Optimize Cloud Costs & Performance: Continuously evaluate data compute environments using advanced SQL, table partitioning, and clustering techniques to ensure fiscal responsibility and performance efficiency
Automate Data Quality: Create automated validation framework rules to systematically clean data anomalies such as duplicate bus pings, corrupted data payloads and logical outliers - before data feeds AI agents and downstream applications
Enable Data-Driven Decision Making: Leverage applied statistics and predictive analytics to solve complex transit business problems. Transform the outputs of massive data pipelines into clear, enterprise-grade dashboards (using tools like Tableau or Looker) that empower cross-functional leadership to make strategic, data-informed decisions
Operational Support: Facilitate the Annual Operator Vacation Sign-Up process for nearly 2,000 transit operators, balancing operational needs with collective agreement parameters
Enable AI & Predictive Analytics: Structure and provision clean, reliable enterprise data feeds that serve as the foundational truth. In future phases of the roadmap, build, configure and deploy the AI micro-agents and predictive models that utilize this data
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Actively partner with analysts across Edmonton Transit Service (ETS) to ensure enterprise pipelines align with diverse operational workflows and municipal requirements



Qualifications:


University Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Management Information Systems, Data Science/Analytics, Applied Statistics, Operations Research, or a directly related technical field
Minimum of four (4) years of directly related hands-on experience in programmatic data engineering, cloud data architecture, and enterprise ETL/ELT pipeline development



Assets:


Google Cloud Professional Data Engineer or Google Cloud Professional Machine Learning Engineer certifications
Formal credentials or demonstrated experience in modern Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), or agentic AI frameworks
Experience or training in modern data orchestration tools (e.g., Apache Airflow, dbt)



Skills required for success:


Technical Mastery: Deep proficiency in programmatic data manipulation using Python and advanced analytical SQL. Highly capable of writing complex time-series logic utilizing Common Table Expression (CTEs) and Window Functions
Cloud & Orchestration Expertise: Demonstrated ability to manage cloud data warehouses and implement structural optimizations like table partitioning and clustering in Google BigQuery. Proven experience orchestrating complex production pipelines using Apache Airflow or dbt / Dataform, while adhering to software delivery best practices including Git and CI/CD
Pipeline Reliability: Proven track record of designing highly scalable, idempotent ETL/ELT pipelines that can process massive daily data volumes and safely recover from automated failures without duplicating records
Analytics & Visualization: Strong proficiency in applied statistics, enterprise BI tools (Tableau, Looker, PowerBI), and advanced data analytics (descriptive, diagnostic, and predictive). Demonstrated ability to go beyond basic reporting by transforming massive pipeline outputs into strategic, actionable insights that solve operational transit problems
Communication & Collaboration: Clear communication skills with proven ability to translate complex ETL/AI technical concepts into accessible insights for diverse non-technical team members and collaborators
Problem Solving & Time Management: Exceptional ability to independently navigate and process massive, high-velocity data streams under tight deadlines while balancing short-term operational demands with long-term architecture goals
Strict adherence to fiscal responsibility, demonstrating the ability to proactively balance scalable data architecture with rigid cloud compute budgets to prevent cost overruns
Alignment to our Cultural Commitments and Leadership Competencies ( https://bit.ly/4brRrXm )
Embracing a culture of equity, diversity, reconciliation and inclusion



Conditions of Employment:


Satisfactory completion of relevant background checks prior to commencement



Work Environment:


This role primarily operates in a standard, modern office setting with options for hybrid working arrangements in accordance with City of Edmonton policies. Physical demands are minimal and typical of a computer-focused administrative position
The weekly hours of work for this position are currently under review and may change at a future time. Any changes will be made in accordance with the City of Edmonton/Civic Service Union 52 collective agreement, and the incumbent will be notified in advance

Meridia Recruitment Solutions has partnered with the Nova Scotia Pharmacy Regulator (NSPR) on their search for a Data Engineer to join their team.




The NSPR is the regulatory body responsible for overseeing pharmacy professionals across Nova Scotia, ensuring safe, ethical, and high quality care for the public. NSPR's Research and Engagement team relies on strong data infrastructure and rigorous analysis to guide strategic, evidence-based decisions across all organizational functions, including registration, quality assurance, professional conduct, and policy..




Position Scope:

Reporting to the Director of Research and Engagement, the Data Engineer will act as the critical bridge between raw operational data and the strategic, evidence-based decisions that guide NSPR. The role combines Salesforce architecture with data engineering and quantitative research methods, transforming raw administrative data into statistically sound, meaningful insights.




Responsibilities:

Build, automate, and maintain ETL pipelines using Python, SQL, and Databricks, integrating data from source systems including Salesforce and Qualtrics
Establish and oversee Master Data Management (MDM) protocols to ensure data consistency and accuracy
Manage NSPR's cloud data warehouse within the Department of Health and Wellness' Health Cloud
Provide day-to-day Salesforce administration, including field mapping, configuration changes, and report generation, partnering with external developers on larger platform builds
Design, build, and maintain complex Salesforce reports and dashboards across multiple standard and custom objects
Design scalable data models and define KPIs to support regular reporting
Translate complex datasets into clear, visually compelling insights for technical and non-technical stakeholders
Execute annual reporting in alignment with the Regulated Health Professions Act and Canadian Institutes for Health Information requirements
Conduct descriptive and inferential statistical analyses to generate research briefs
Maintain strict adherence to data governance, privacy, and security standards




Position Requirements:

5+ years of experience in data engineering, data analytics, or business insights
Demonstrated experience as a Data Engineer, BI Developer, or Quantitative Data Analyst
Strong grasp of BI principles, Master Data Management, data modeling, and quantitative research design
Exceptional ability to translate data into insights that drive business action
Strong organizational, project management, and communication skills
Ability to work independently and collaboratively, with a high degree of integrity




Assets:

Experience working in regulation, healthcare, or a related field
Understanding of the Salesforce ecosystem, including Salesforce certifications
Experience with Microsoft Azure and Databricks
Hands-on coding experience with Python and advanced Excel
Formal training or working knowledge of quantitative research methodologies, biostatistics, or experimental design
Experience supporting or contributing to a data governance review or framework

Title: Supply Chain Data Analyst
Description:
Convergint is looking for a team-oriented, results-driven, Supply Chain Data Analyst, to join our amazing culture. As the Supply Chain Data Analyst, you will be responsible for maintaining vendor item master catalogs and provide reporting and analytics to support the source to pay process. This role involves tasks like data entry, updates, and resolving discrepancies, with a strong focus on data integrity and efficiency in operations. This role has an emphasis on support of the supply chain and sales teams, and motivation in building effective business relationships with vendors and customers alike.

Who You Are

You have a passion for providing world-class service to customers, colleagues and communities. You are a person of integrity with a commitment to growth, accountability and delivering results. You want to join an organization with a positive culture that embraces inclusion and allows everyone to be the best version of themselves at work and home.

Who We Are

With 20-years of proven growth and exceptional performance, our mission is to be our customer’s best service provider. We realize the importance of diversity in achieving that goal. Our company was built upon a solid foundation of 10 Values and Beliefs which drive our unmatched culture, making us the #1 global, serviced-based systems integrator in the industry. We take great pride in protecting the lives and assets of our customers and their communities with the solutions we provide.

What you’ll do with “Our Training and Your Experience”


Creating, updating, and managing item records within relevant systems.
Ensure the accuracy, completeness, and consistency of item data, including descriptions, classifications, units of measure, vendor information, pricing, and other relevant details.
Conduct regular audits to identify and correct errors, duplicates, or outdated records.
Manage the lifecycle of item records, including creation, updates, and decommissioning.
Support for item master data management, including troubleshooting issues and assisting with system enhancements.
Interact with suppliers, manufacturers, and distributors on an on-going basis, which may include negotiating prices, discounts, credit terms, and logistics.
Participating in the development and implementation of best practices for item master data management.
Work with Supply Chain leadership to develop and implement best practices, demand planning, and other optimizations in order to help grow the business and to ensure process transparency, fairness, impartiality, and confidentiality.
Collaborate with global counterparts to align with process standardization and consistency in reporting across all regions.
Provide reporting and data analytics to Supply Chain leadership to show trends, address discrepancies, and generate accurate forecasting.
Develop constructive and cooperative working relationships with internal stakeholders and vendors alike and maintain them over time.
Executes all work in accordance with Provincial/State, local regulations, general best practices as well as company health and safety policies and procedures.
Acts as “our customer’s best service provider” at all times thereby ensuring Convergint Technologies is the customer’s first choice for service.
Communicates with and works with the other team members consistently to improve overall operations of the Convergint Technology Center, and company.
Keeps up to date and informed on all company policies.
Presents a professional image of Convergint Technologies at all times in appearance and behavior.
Performs other duties and responsibilities as requested or required.


What You’ll Need


Strong attention to details.
Strong verbal, written and interpersonal communication skills and ability to deal with a wide cross section of people both internal and external to the business.
Excellent Excel, Word, and Outlook skills.
Excellent proficiency in financial software specifically related to purchase order entry, accounts payable, and inventory management.
Strong negotiation skills.
Strong financial knowledge and skills—ability to understand basic financials such as accounts receivable/payable, purchase orders, work orders, etc.
Excellent organizational skills and the ability to handle multiple projects tasks simultaneously.
Excellent attention to detail.
Strong flexibility to adapt to changing priorities, work processes, department structure, environment and technology in a dynamic work environment.
Self-driven and motivated to meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
Strong analytical skills are necessary to resolve problems and look for solutions.
Strong ability to demonstrate independence, resourcefulness and tenacity.
Shows initiative – regularly engages in proactive behavior and looks for opportunities.


Requirements


Diploma and/or certificate in Business Administration or Purchasing required.
SCMP designation highly desirable.
Minimum of five years of procurement experience including elements of the supply chain
preferred.
Minimum of five years of negotiation and vendor management experience preferred.
Minimum of five years of customer service experience is required.
Experience in Ivalua, Salesforce, and NetSuite highly desirable.
Relevant industry experience in electrical, security, building automation, or fire is required


Company Benefits And Perks

Convergint fosters a supportive, accessible, and inclusive environment in which individuals of different backgrounds and identities are able to realize their maximum potential within the company. We offer a variety of programs and exceptional benefits to all of our colleagues:


Company Holidays and Paid Time Off
Immediate comprehensive benefit plan (medical, dental, etc.)
Employer contribution to RRSP
Work environment committed to safety.
Colleague Assistance Program
Tuition reimbursement
Competitive salary and compensation plan
Corporate Social Responsibility Day
And much more…

Job Description

We are looking for a Data Analyst to take on a pivotal role in our organization by not only analyzing and interpreting data but also driving strategic initiatives through data insights. The ideal candidate will have a strong foundation in data analysis, an aptitude for advanced analytics, and the ability to provide actionable recommendations that influence key business decisions.

Role & Responsibilities


Data Analysis & Interpretation: Collect, clean, and analyze large datasets to identify trends, patterns, and insights that support business decisions.
Data Visualization: Create compelling data visualizations using tools like Power BI, Tableau, or Excel to communicate findings effectively to stakeholders.
Reporting: Generate regular and ad-hoc reports that provide actionable insights and recommendations to various departments within the organization

Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.


Benefits


Competitive salary and benefits package.

Collaborative and supportive team environment.
Continuous learning and professional development opportunities.

Title: Operations Analyst - Flow
Description:
YVR is a place of connection, bringing together people, places and cargo while ensuring a safe and efficient experience for everyone. Airport Operations an integral part to the success of the airport system, as a key role in facilitating safe and efficient and predictable movement of aircraft and all customers that those aircraft serve. Roles in Airport Operations are exciting and dynamic and require a strong team approach – which is key to everything we do.

Position Overview

Are you a data-driven, team player? As the Operations Analyst – Flow, you will be responsible for tracking and reporting on YVR’s real-time operational performance and will use this data to influence our operational performance to both our internal and external stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities Include


Maintaining a real-time operational metric database by reporting on all key flow areas across groundside, terminal, baggage and airside
Establishing a means to track real-time operational performance across all areas, and providing quantitative and qualitative reporting for day-of operations and forecasting
Identifying obstacles and anomalies through data analysis to help justify initiating projects aimed at improving operational efficiency
Managing all aspects of projects including creating documents and change management plans for stakeholders


Key Qualifications Include


At least two years of relevant experience in an operational environment, ideally in a major international airport, supplemented by at least two years of post-secondary training (Aviation Management, Business, Operations and/or Logistics preferred); or an equivalent combination of training and experience
Proficiency with MS Office and advanced skills in data analytics; preference for those with experience with major BI tools such as MS Fabric, PowerBI, Qlik and/or Databrick
Proven ability to quickly interpret abstract data from independent sources and present to a variety of stakeholders
Strong technical writing skills with excellent communication skills and a demonstrated ability to present to large audiences
Exceptional critical thinking and decision-making skills, with a proven ability to work with minimal supervision


Shift schedule with alternating day and night shifts will be required as this role supports the operation on a 24-hour basis, with a requirement to support winter operations for 24/7 operations. As an employee on a shifted work schedule, you may be eligible for shift and weekend premiums.

The results of this posting will apply to any subsequent part-time Operations Analyst – Flow positions that may become vacant as a result of filling the full-time position referenced in this posting (Ref #26-106). If no subsequent vacancies immediately arise from this posting within the Operations Analyst – Flow classification, future vacancies will be posted in accordance with standard procedures.

Although not required, French language skills are an asset as we are committed to providing bilingual services to our visitors and passengers. Candidates who do not speak French are still strongly encouraged to apply.

This position is open to Vancouver Airport Authority employees and external applications. Previous job performance will be taken into consideration for all internal candidates that apply for this position.

As part of our recruitment process, short-listed candidates may be required to participate in an assessment process.

Salary Range : $71,560 to $93,525 per annum, based on 37.5 hours per week. This is individually tailored to reflect your unique experience, qualifications and internal equity. At YVR, your work experience goes beyond the paycheck. We support your personal and professional development, well-being, and a thriving work culture with generous vacation days, extensive health benefits, retirement savings matching, wellness programs, community engagement, commuting support, and continuous learning opportunities. Learn more at https://careers.yvr.ca/benefits.

Who We Are

YVR is more than just an airport. We connect our beautiful province and all it has to offer to the world. We are all leaders and trailblazers for change and innovation, so no matter the department or team you’re a part of, the work you do matters.

At YVR, we are flexible in everything we do. We will work together to find ways to deliver customer excellence that helps us all thrive.

Whatever your background and wherever you’re from, you belong at YVR. If you have any questions about accessibility or require any assistance applying, please reach out at careers@yvr.ca.

Description:
About The Role

Job Overview:

As a Power BI Developer, you will play a dual role—developing impactful business intelligence solutions while also building strong relationships with potential clients. You will design, develop, and maintain business analytics dashboards and reports using Power BI to provide actionable insights for clients. Additionally, you will help explain the value of Power BI and other technology solutions to prospective clients, ensuring they understand how our offerings can solve their business challenges.

Key Responsibilities

Client Engagement: Establish and maintain relationships with clients, understanding their data analytics needs and offering customized BI solutions.

Solution Development: Design, create, and manage Power BI reports and dashboards that transform raw data into meaningful insights.

Data Analysis: Work with clients to analyze business data, identify trends, and provide solutions that improve business performance.

Requirement Gathering: Collaborate with clients to understand their needs and translate them into effective Power BI solutions.

Technical Expertise: Advise clients on the best Power BI practices, data modeling, DAX expressions, and report optimization.

Sales Collaboration: Work closely with the sales team to present Power BI solutions to prospective clients, demonstrating the value of data-driven decision-making.

Continuous Improvement: Stay up-to-date with Power BI features, and incorporate new tools and methodologies to improve client solutions.

Lead Generation Support: Assist in generating leads through strategic conversations and presentations that highlight our BI solutions.

Qualifications:


Proven experience (3+ years) working as a Power BI Developer or Business Intelligence Specialist.
Strong technical skills in Power BI, including data modeling, DAX (Data Analysis Expressions), Power Query, and visualization best practices.
Experience with data integration from multiple data sources like SQL, Excel, and cloud-based databases.

Description:
As one of the world’s leading independent global investment firms, Invesco is dedicated to rethinking possibilities for our clients. Job Description

The team:

We are a unified, collaborative marketing team focused on creating meaningful client connections that drive business growth. We combine deep insights with strong partnerships to deliver timely, relevant, and impactful experiences for our clients. Our team is committed to continuous learning, innovation, and excellence in everything we do. We align closely with distribution partners to generate demand and unlock new opportunities across the business. Above all, we measure and optimize our efforts to ensure we consistently deliver value, drive engagement, and strengthen loyalty to Invesco.

The role:

The Content Enablement Content Analyst is a key role within Invesco’s Global Content Enablement team, supporting the Americas & EMEA Marketing organization. This position executes the content strategy and roadmap to enhance the quality, accessibility, and usability of content across the EMEA region. The role focuses on building and managing content infrastructure, ensuring accurate categorization, distribution, and access across platforms and audiences. It partners closely with business and technology stakeholders to deliver consistent, well-governed content solutions and ensure requirements are clearly defined and tested. This hands-on role is critical to improving content quality and driving engagement, ultimately enabling a stronger client and investment experience.

Responsibilities of the role:

Provides analytics support primarily for EMEA content domains, with additional support for North America.
Partners closely with EMEA Content Product Owners to deliver analysis across development, deployment, and research initiatives.
Defines and standardizes content quality metrics, building reporting and dashboards to provide visibility into content performance for senior leadership.
Collaborates with EMEA and NA domain experts to develop and maintain global taxonomy, aligning stakeholders to standardized definitions and fields.
Bridges business and technology teams to ensure solutions meet requirements and align with strategic priorities.
Maps business processes, develops expertise in content sources, and provides recommendations to improve content effectiveness.
Translates stakeholder needs into user stories and supports execution of content initiatives, including testing, impact analysis, and cross-team coordination.
Leads governance and documentation efforts, including content quality monitoring, process improvement, issue escalation, and maintaining records in tools such as Jira and Confluence.


Requirements of the role:

Bachelor’s degree, 5+ years in technology platforms, project management, or content development and distribution.
Experience with CMS and/or DAM platforms, content lifecycle management, and content migrations, including API-based integrations.
Familiarity with AI-assisted content analysis and UX or digital marketing concepts.
Strong skills in workflow/process mapping, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines, and operate effectively in ambiguous environments.
Advanced technical proficiency, including SQL and Excel (advanced formulas, pivot tables; VBA a plus), along with strong desktop tool capabilities.
Strong analytical and statistical reasoning skills, with ability to organize, analyze, and communicate large data sets with accuracy and attention to detail.
Knowledge of content categorization (campaign, program, asset class, product), with preferred experience in investment or asset management content.
Client-focused, execution-oriented professional with strong communication, organizational, relationship-building, and influencing skills, plus a data-driven approach to measuring content performance and impact.

Title: Maximo Technical Data Package Analyst
Description:
Location: Halifax - Wilkinson, Canada

In fast changing markets, customers worldwide rely on Thales. Thales is a business where brilliant people from all over the world come together to share ideas and inspire each other. In aerospace, transportation, defence, security and space, our architects design innovative solutions that make our tomorrow's possible.

Maximo Technical Data Package Analyst

Halifax, NS, Canada (Hybrid)

Position Summary

Thales has a vacancy for a Maximo Technical Data Package Analyst to act as the primary integrator between Technical Data, ILS, Supply Support, Life Cycle Material Managers (LCMMs), and Engineering departments. They are responsible for identifying and resolving part changes within the Technical Data Package (TDP), managing the full lifecycle of Document Change Requests (DCRs) via a JIRA board, and ensuring total data alignment across internal and government systems.

Regulatory Compliance Requirements


This position requires direct or indirect access to hardware, software or technical information (data) controlled under the Canadian Export Control List and/or the ITAR or the US the Export Administration Regulations (EAR). All applicants must be eligible or able to obtain authorization for such access.
Requires a positive Controlled Goods assessment as you will have direct access to hardware, software, technology or technical data controlled under the Canadian Controlled Goods Program
Required to obtain and maintain a Security Clearance at the NATO Secret Level



Key Areas of Responsibility


Technical Data Package (TDP) Management & Configuration Control: Conduct deep-dive audits of the TDP to ensure National Stock Numbers (NSNs), part numbers, and vendor references are current; perform hands-on updates to technical documentation to reflect the as-supported fleet configuration; and resolve technical discrepancies between engineering drawings and procurement/cataloguing systems.
Change Management & Workflow Coordination: Manage and maintain a dedicated JIRA board to track technical changes; coordinate DCRs from identification through approval and implementation by obtaining required inputs from LCMMs and Engineering; and identify and resolve process bottlenecks to advance stalled requests.

Title: Talent Acquisition Analytics & AI Specialist
Description:
About Boomi and What Makes Us Special

Are you ready to work at a fast-growing company where you can make a difference? Boomi, the data activation company for AI, powers the agentic enterprise by bringing data to life across the business. The award-winning Boomi Enterprise Platform is the active data foundation that delivers essential agentic infrastructure enabling organizations to drive agentic transformation and harness the power of AI with secure, scalable connectivity.  Trusted by over 30,000 customers and supported by a network of 800+ partners, Boomi helps organisations of all sizes achieve agility, efficiency, and innovation at scale. At Boomi, you’ll work with world-class people and industry-leading technology. We hire trailblazers with an entrepreneurial spirit who can solve challenging problems, make a real impact, and want to be part of building something big. If this sounds like a good fit for you, check out boomi.com  or visit our Boomi Careers page to learn more.

How You'll Make An Impact

Are you a data-fluent, technically minded analytics professional looking to build the future of Talent Acquisition (TA)? We are looking for a TA Analytics & AI Specialist to join our team during a pivotal chapter. 

In this role, you won't just pull standard reports—you will own the data pipeline from our source systems into Snowflake, build advanced dashboards in Power BI, and architect AI agents to automate high-friction TA workflows. If you are a systems thinker who thrives on writing optimized SQL, configuring API connections, and leveraging advanced prompt engineering to scale operations, this role is for you.

What You'll Do

Implementation & Data Architecture 

Act as the technical data lead, ensuring data fields, schemas, and historical data migrate with 100% integrity.
Partner with IT and Enterprise Data teams to manage our TA data pipelines inside Snowflake and write optimized SQL queries to blend disparate datasets.
Audit, clean, and rebuild calculated fields, data schemas, and dashboards to ensure absolute data integrity across platforms.

 AI Agents & Automation Orchestration

Design, test, and deploy autonomous AI agents and automated workflows to eliminate manual TA administrative tasks and maximize operational efficiency.
Leverage advanced LLMs like Claude (including Artifacts, Projects, and API connections) for rapid data prototyping, drafting complex code scripts, and building intelligent automation loops.
Find creative ways to use generative AI and API integrations to streamline TA operations, absorbing manual administrative overhead through tech.

 Cross-Functional Reporting & Predictive Analytics

Own the end-to-end delivery of weekly, monthly, and quarterly TA metrics, narrative reports, and automated dashboards for critical stakeholders, including the Head of TA, the Executive Leadership Team (ELT), Finance, HRBPs, and Regional TA Leaders.
Translate complex datasets into clean, scannable visual stories and data packets that cross-functional, non-technical stakeholders can easily action.
Move beyond standard, lagging indicators to design advanced capacity models, hiring velocity forecasts, and pipeline bottleneck analytics.
Design and execute data projects that bridge the gap between TA and the business—such as correlation studies tying interview/assessment data to on-the-job performance.

 The Experience You Bring

Experience: 2–5 years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, or systems operations
The Hard Tech Stack: Strong, hands-on proficiency in writing complex SQL queries and building dynamic dashboards in Power BI or Tableau. Direct experience working with relational databases and data warehousing tools like Snowflake is highly preferred
AI & Agent Fluency: Advanced proficiency using Claude or similar LLMs to build reports, analyze complex datasets, and prototype technical data solutions. Practical understanding of prompt engineering, connecting APIs, and building AI agents/automated workflows
Systems Thinker: High attention to detail. You enjoy figuring out how "Field A" in one system impacts "Report B" in another, and you understand how data orchestration impacts downstream analytics

 Bonus Points If You Have

Exposure to HR/Talent Acquisition data structures and schemas.
Hands-on experience building integrations or orchestrating workflows using the Boomi platform. 

 Aren’t sure if you’re a match? We know that impostor syndrome and the confidence gap can prevent us from meeting spectacular candidates — so don’t hesitate to apply; you could be the perfect fit!

Compensation and Benefits 

Boomi is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. Base compensation for this position in our Vancouver hub ranges from $92,000 - $115,000 CAD annually + applicable bonus. Final compensation will be determined by various factors including the candidate’s knowledge, skills, experience, and geographic location.

 

Be Bold. Be You. Be Boomi. We take pride in our culture and core values and are committed to being a place where everyone can be their true, authentic self. Our team members are our most valuable resources, and we look for and encourage diversity in backgrounds, thoughts, life experiences, knowledge, and capabilities.  

Boomi strives to create an inclusive and accessible environment for candidates and employees. All employment decisions are based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications.

Office of the CXO

The Office of the CXO drives effectiveness across the EA Experiences organization with a focus on excellence in business operations, comprehensive fan intelligence, plus internal technology and business solutions. Your Impact

You will transform complex data into actionable insights that improve fan experiences and support business decisions. Working with large-scale gaming and customer datasets, you'll partner with teams across EA to solve business challenges using statistical analysis, experimentation, and machine learning.

Responsibilities


Analyze structured and unstructured datasets to identify trends and business insights.
Build, validate, and improve predictive and prescriptive models using Python or R.
Design and evaluate experiments to measure product and business outcomes.
Develop dashboards and visualizations that communicate analytical findings.
Partner with cross-functional teams to translate business questions into analytical solutions.
Present recommendations through clear visualizations and business-focused storytelling.
Apply responsible AI practices, including model validation, fairness, and bias monitoring.


Required Qualifications


Master's degree in Statistics, Operations Research, Data Science, or a related field; equivalent experience considered.
Experience using Python or R for statistical analysis and modeling.
Experience with SQL and relational databases.
Experience using visualization tools such as Tableau, Streamlit, or RShiny.
Experience applying statistical methods to business problems.


Core Skills And Experience


2+ years applying statistical modeling in a business environment.
Experience preparing, analyzing, and interpreting large datasets.
Knowledge of experimentation and causal inference methods.
Experience communicating analytical findings through dashboards and presentations.
Familiarity with Git and cloud-based analytical environments.

Title: Analytics Data Specialist
Description:
Welcome Home!

We’re more than Canada’s largest independent hardware and building supplies retailer—we’re part of communities across the nation.




Build Trusted Data. Empower Every Decision.

As the Analytics Data Specialist, you will champion and deliver enterprise data products that turn raw data into trusted insights, enabling scalable analytics through an Analytics Centre of Excellence. As part of the team that powers enterprise reporting and decision-making, you'll empower every area of the business with trusted data and insights that drive measurable business outcomes. Led by the Manager, Data and Analytics, this opportunity suits a collaborative and detail-oriented professional who enjoys building scalable data solutions, enabling enterprise analytics, and solving complex data challenges.




Ready to make an impact in a new role? Here’s how:

Design, build, and maintain scalable data products within Microsoft Fabric and Azure ecosystems that deliver trusted, business-ready data for reporting, analytics and decision making.
Develop and maintain Lakehouse and Warehouse data architectures, ensuring structured high performing data layers that support enterprise analytics.
Design and optimize business aligned semantic models that enable consistent reporting and analytics.
Develop automated data pipelines and integrated workflows using Fabric Data Factory, notebooks and Azure services to transform and deliver data.
Implement scalable data transformations that standardize how data is curated and modeled for analytics consumption.
Ensure data quality, integrity and reliability through validation, monitoring and cleansing processes across all datasets.
Collaborate with analytics teams to deliver high quality data solutions and enable adoption of enterprise data products.
Support enterprise data governance and master data management practices by applying data standards and lineage tracking.




We’re looking for:

Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Data Analytics, Data Engineering, or a related field; additional analytics certifications are an asset.
A minimum of five years of experience in data analytics, data engineering, or a related analytics role.
Strong experience with cloud data platforms, particularly Microsoft Fabric, Azure Synapse, and Azure SQL.
Strong experience with data engineering and analytics languages (PySpark, SQL, Python, R).
