Position Summary

The Pricing Analyst is responsible for developing contract and non‑contract pricing program strategies and supporting the execution and analysis of WFS overall pricing approach. Reporting to the Business Intelligence Manager, this role will conduct detailed pricing and financial analyses and collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to drive profitable growth.

The role supports the implementation of pricing and discounting strategies by providing analysis, modeling, and insights that inform execution across the business.

The successful candidate brings a deep understanding of competitive dynamics and business economics and knows how to bring pricing strategies to life across multiple channels.

This position partners with business leaders to support and advance pricing strategies and plans through rigorous analysis, modeling, and insights that inform decision-making.

Job Responsibilities (You Will)


Pricing Strategy & Analysis
Develops contract and non-contract pricing strategies using customer, financial, and market data.
Evaluates competitive pricing activity and recommends responses based on quantified business impact.
Modeling & Advanced Analytics
Builds and maintains pricing, forecasting, and financial impact models.
Applies statistical and data modeling techniques to transactional data to inform pricing recommendations.
Execution & Enablement
Supports pricing execution through QRP price-point maintenance and post-implementation analysis.
Partners with cross-functional teams to ensure pricing decisions are operationalized effectively.
Insight & Communication
Synthesizes complex analysis into clear insights and recommendations for senior leaders.
Conducts post-implementation reviews and recommends continuous improvements.
Process & Governance
Contributes to the improvement of pricing tools, processes, and governance frameworks.

Education/Experience (You Have)


Post-secondary degree/diploma in Business, Analytics, Computer Science, or related field (or equivalent experience).
3–5 years of experience in pricing, analytics, or a data-focused analytical role.
Strong proficiency in SQL; experience working with large, complex datasets.
Strong financial and analytical skills with the ability to translate data into insights.
Experience with Snowflake and Power BI.
Experience with R or Python.
Exposure to pricing, commercial analytics, or revenue management.
Experience partnering with cross-functional business teams.

Medical, dental, vision and prescription drug coverage

Title: Management Information Systems (MIS) Analyst, E-Commerce
Description:
Company Summary

Founded in 2015, IMGadgets is a fast-growing Canadian lifestyle brand dedicated to elevating everyday living through purposeful innovation across our family of sub-brands. From our pioneering roots in safe personal e-mobility with Gyrocopters to our broader evolution into fitness, home, and family essentials, we focus on delivering high-quality products that add real value to daily life.




Position Summary

We are seeking an analytical, highly organized, and detail-oriented MIS Analyst, E-Commerce to serve as the operational and data backbone of our digital sales team. Reporting directly to the Senior Manager of E-Commerce, this role combines heavy Excel-based data management, ongoing competitive data tracking, and comprehensive multi-channel reporting across Shopify, main marketplaces, and secondary marketplaces with precise catalog execution and warehouse inventory synchronization.




Key Responsibilities

Heavy Excel & Data Management: Utilize advanced spreadsheet skills to manage master product feeds, bulk catalog data, pricing matrices, and inventory data sheets across multiple channels.
Competitive Data Tracking: Maintain and continuously update competitor pricing sheets and market trackers by logging competitor prices as directed, without formulating strategic pricing recommendations or positioning strategies.
Product Research: Aid the sales team in conducting and compiling product research using 3rd party tools to help with brand expansion decisions.
Multi-Channel Reporting: Compile, format, and generate regular performance, sales, inventory, and listing status reports for Shopify, main marketplaces, and secondary marketplaces to support leadership decision-making.

Title: Senior Analyst, Marketing
Description:
Why Meridian?

At Meridian our aspiration is to integrate our purpose into everything we do for people, the planet, and communities. We believe that our greatest opportunity is to create opportunity and meet people where they are.

Factor us into your next career opportunity. We want you to grow with us and have an experience that’s different. This is a place where you can expect the unexpected.

Find our story here: About Meridian

The role: The Senior Marketing Analyst provides proactive, actionable, analytical support and business insight to

marketing department, as well as their stakeholders (LOBs). The role will have significant impact on Meridian’s marketing strategy, as they are responsible for segmenting, deploying and executing the communication of marketing campaigns, product launches and focused research. As a subject matter expert, the Senior Marketing Analyst demonstrates an ability to present complicated analytical material in a concise and compelling manner and, interpret insights in a meaningful way for

management and partners.

The role will support the advancement of analytics and data management, processes, and tools to contribute to the achievement of Meridian’s strategic and in year goals and improve business profitability. In partnership with colleagues, this role will maintain existing marketing reporting while working to improve and refine processes through the integration of AI and automation.

This is an 18 Month Contract opportunity

Key Responsibilities

Analysis & Insights


Measure the effectiveness of Marketing tactics (paid, organic, brand, email, website, social etc.) while you partner with the marketing team to set goals, measure results, and share actionable insights. Build and develop models that help to accelerate marketing’s long term strategic plans.
Analyze, prepare and present scheduled reports (i.e. key business performance indicators, and dashboards) and ad hoc reports (i.e. in support of organizational projects or initiatives) for the marketing team, both proactively and upon request.
Lead the development of management reporting that empowers leaders to take action, by converting data into meaningful information that identifies issues, opportunities and emerging trends.
Foster cross-functional collaboration across all MCU departments—particularly with Enterprise Analytics & Data, Data Governance and Culture, Member Experience Services, and Sales—to streamline communication, gather data, define terms and conditions, and consolidate information from multiple platforms into a centralized source for segmentation and reporting.
Leads qualitative and quantitative analysis of relevant industry and consumer behaviour trends to identify revenue opportunities and grow our capital base.
Assists with the development of various programs by collecting, analysing and collating Member and prospect information ensuring that Meridian delivers a personalized solution that is in relation to their transactional, advice or price-driven relationships while also considering long-term Member value.
Analyze prospect and Member-level information to determine the effectiveness of campaigns and generate additional profitability-enhancing strategies
Networks with other like-minded individuals within the Enterprise Analytics and Data community at Meridian, as well as industry events, to keep abreast of new solutions, resources, and analytical techniques


Execution


Employ Marketing experiments, test-and-learns, A-B testing, etc, with the focus to continually improve our Member experience and increasing KPIs such as response rates, balance growth and cross-sell
Identify key business opportunities for growth by profiling the existing Member base and assessing emerging needs through industry research and competitive analysis.
Proficient in leveraging diverse marketing deployment platforms (e.g., Acoustic, Dynamics, Soapbox, internal banking systems, Google, Meta) to scope, segment, and prepare audience lists, ensuring accurate and timely system integration and deployments.
Primary lead on verifying data quality, personalization, and quality execution across all transactional and Marketing communications and journeys. Ensuring adherence to industry regulations such as CASL & PII.
Collaborate with Enterprise Analytics team to develop models such as product profitability or propensity models
Support the improvement of marketing attribution using tools such as marketing mix modeling and multi-touch attribution


Communication & Business Solutions


Demonstrated ability to work with all levels of the organization (operational staff to Executive to Board of Directors) and the ability to obtain required information to support or develop analysis.
Interprets results and delivers information and/or presentations with impact
Effectively demonstrates the ability to explain complex information and concepts to different audiences, including professionals in a manner tailored to the audience and elicits receptivity
Coordinates the acquisition of data from various, relevant data sources and applies analytical skills to convert data into meaningful information.
Demonstrates an ability to leverage technology to streamline processes, tools and analysis and seeks out opportunities to leverage AI and other automation tools to increase department efficiency
Support CRM in partnership with Centre of Excellence on future enhancements and capabilities within the platform.
Review key marketing strategies to collect requirements and design solutions with marketing operations, IT and Digital teams, ensuring the necessary data is integrated into various platforms, such as CRM (Dynamics 365), to support the operation of marketing journeys, processes, and campaign measurement.
In partnership with Marketing Operations, conduct User Acceptance (UAT) and Post-Production testing to ensure proposed solutions work as intended.


Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities


Strong working knowledge of an analytics stack, working with analytics tools, data warehouses and data visualization tools
Strong financial acumen, excellent interpersonal skills and ability interacting with all levels of the organization, including Executive management
Excellent written and verbal communication and presentation skills. Ability to communicate detailed information in an impactful way
Strong process management skills, initiative, ability to manage competing priorities and attention to detail are critical
Technical writing experience in relevant areas, including queries, reports, and presentations
High level of proficiency in designing & developing custom analytics utilizing available or externally obtained data
Business and partnership focused with an understanding of how Marketing enables the business
Aptitude for investigating complex problems and a passion for creative problem-solving. Continuously innovates to achieve great results
A strong business acumen and can translate insights into actionable recommendations that align with business objectives
Ability to establish strong cross functional relationships with proven track record of working successfully with a divergent group of internal business partners
Highly motivated self-starter with high energy and a very positive attitude
Desire to propose changes that proactively seize market opportunities
Forward thinking with an openness to change to identify new opportunities
Ability to work independently and in a team-oriented environment
Possess a strong attention to detail; be concise without comprising the facts
Experience coaching and mentoring junior teammates
Able to handle confidential and proprietary information with discretion
Member Focus - Personally demonstrating that our Members are our highest priority.
Comfort learning and adopting new digital tools, with an openness to using AI‑enabled technology to enhance productivity, accuracy, and the Member experience


Education, Work Experience, And Professional Designations/Certifications


Degree or diploma in mathematics, statistics or computer science or related discipline
Experience in a financial institution environment with a strong understanding of financial metrics, segmentation and industry drivers.
Five (5+) years' in an analytics driven role with proven analytic skills, including mining, evaluation, analysis, and visualization (ability to analyse large datasets)
Strong SQL and PySpark skills in Fabric environment required, with the ability to learn other analytic tools
Practical experience in statistical analysis through the use of statistical packages including Excel, Power BI and SAS
Working experience in digital analytics using Google Analytics, and Data Studio.
Expert in diverse marketing deployment platforms (e.g., Acoustic, Dynamics, Soapbox, Google, Meta)
Demonstrated experience working in scripting languages such as Python or R, VBA, to set up automation and integrations is considered an asset.


This role represents an existing vacancy. Internal candidates are being considered as part of our standard process.

Salary Range: $59,800.00 to $89,800.00 CAD

Compensation for this role is based on a combination of skills, experience, and internal equity. Candidates with stronger alignment to the role’s requirements may be placed higher within the range. Your recruiter will share more information about our total rewards package during the hiring process.

Office Location: This is a hybrid work opportunity with the option to work from Toronto Corporate Office or St. Catharines office.

Meridian has a remote work policy that allows flexibility for employees to work remotely but also requires a minimum of one day per week in the office for purposeful meetings to collaborate, innovate, and build effective relationships with your team, your colleagues, and your leader, which is important to us.

What’s in it for you?


We have an inclusive and collaborative working environment that encourages teamwork, creativity, curiosity, and celebrates success.
We provide you with the tools and technology needed to delight your candidates and clients.
You will get to work with and learn from diverse industry leaders and colleagues, who have hailed from top organizations.
Hybrid work arrangements with in-person office time to collaborate, innovate, and build relationships with your colleagues.
This is not your typical “corporate” job. We work hard and we have fun!


Build the Future of Banking with Us

At Meridian, we’re not just adapting to the future—we’re shaping it. We see talent as a catalyst for sustainable growth, community impact, and future-readiness. As the financial landscape evolves, we’re looking for team members who bring:


Embedding & leveraging technology – Confidence and willingness to learn and integrate AI and emerging technologies into new ways of working. Experience with low/no code tools like the Microsoft Power Platform and generative AI productivity tools like Microsoft Copilot is considered an asset
Critical Thinking – The ability to analyze, evaluate and interpret information from various sources and apply logic and problem solving to make decisions.
Data Driven– Leverage data and insights to identify, prioritize and improve member experience and business efficiency.
Curiosity & Flexibility – Comfortable navigating and embracing change and uncertainty, ask more questions, explore more options. Continuously learn and grow.


Experience the Difference!

Meridian committed to promoting an inclusive, accessible environment, where all employees and customers feel valued, respected and supported. We are dedicated to employing a workforce that reflects the diversity of our communities and Members in which we live and serve.

Qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, or disability.

Title: Analyst, Data Governance
Description:
What You Will Do


Data Governance Leadership: Support the development, implementation, maintenance, monitoring, and enforcement of data governance standards, policies, procedures, and controls to ensure adherence to privacy, compliance, risk, regulatory, and legal requirements. This includes AI Governance to ensure ethical use and compliance with regulatory standards for AI-driven processes.
Stakeholder Collaboration: Collaborate with leadership, IT departments, business units, Legal, Compliance, Privacy, Risk teams, data producers and consumers, and IT data platform teams to align on data governance goals and support the operationalization of a robust data governance framework.
Promote data literacy by developing materials and conducting training on best practices.
Policy Development: Assist in the creation and enforcement of data management policies to ensure compliance with regulatory requirements.
Contribute to shaping the data governance accountabilities and operating model and enable data stewardship.
Data Quality Assurance: Contribute to the enhancement and implementation of robust data quality frameworks and conduct regular audits to maintain high data standards.
Support the development and evolution of data governance metrics and KPIs; monitor & measure the overall efficacy of the data governance program.
Proactively monitor data, metadata, and reference data to ensure quality across the CTB data lifecycle.
Implement and leverage data governance tools and platforms to enable capabilities; manage and maintain metadata and other data governance artifacts such as glossaries, classifications, and lineage.
Risk Management: Identify potential risks related to data governance and develop mitigation strategies.
Support data sharing and collaboration across teams and departments; ensure proper data access, usability, and monitoring of data sharing agreements.
Project Oversight: Contribute to large-scale data governance projects from inception to completion.
Stay updated on industry trends, standards, and regulatory requirements related to data governance; recommend appropriate modifications to existing policies and practices.


What You Bring


Post-secondary education in Computer Science, Information Systems Management, or a related field.
Proven experience with corporate data environments supporting cross-functional governance.
Proficient in PL\SQL and confident working in a structured data environment.
Knowledge of business intelligence, modern data warehousing techniques, cloud solutions such as Azure or GCP.
Experience with ETL/ELT processes and modern integration frameworks like API and event streaming.
Experience in IBM Cloud Pak for Data and/or Databricks Unity Catalog.
Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Visio, PowerPoint, and Excel.
Expertise in creating/enforcing data governance policies to ensure data integrity, privacy, compliance, security.
Ability to work with Legal, Privacy, Compliance, and Risk partners
Hands-on experience with data analysis, quality assessment, metadata management.
Excellent communication skills for presenting complex concepts to non-technical audiences.
Strong organizational skills and attention to detail; ability to problem-solve and handle ambiguity.
Effective stakeholder management; ability to build trusted relationships and influence decision-making.
Experience in process design/improvement initiatives and leveraging automation.
CDMP certification is an asset.


We’re always looking for great talent! In addition to competitive pay, we offer:


Comprehensive benefits and retirement programs
Performance incentives, Continuing Education Programs
Other perks to support your well-being
Career growth opportunities and product discounts


Our typical hiring range is between $53,000 and $88,000 Salary decisions are also dependent on other factors such as your experience, job-related knowledge, skills and competencies, market location, industry benchmarks, internal equity and other role-specific requirements.

About Us

At Canadian Tire Services Limited/Canadian Tire Bank, it is our mandate to continue to create innovative and rewarding financial solutions for our customers. Our growing suite of products and services showcase the dynamic contributions from our employees and our success is driven by a strong vision, loyal customers, and our ability to build teams that reflect the diverse customers and communities in which we live and work. Join us, where there's a place for you here.

Our Commitment to Diversity, Inclusion and Belonging

We are committed to fostering an environment where belonging thrives, and diversity, inclusion and equity are infused into everything we do. We believe in building an organizational culture where people are consistently treated with dignity while respecting individual religion, nationality, gender, race, age, perceived ability, spoken language, sexual orientation, and identification. We are united in our purpose of being here to help make life in Canada better. .

Accommodations

We stand firm in our Core Value that inclusion is a must. We welcome and encourage candidates from equity-seeking groups such as people who identify as racialized, Indigenous, 2SLGBTQIA+, women, people with disabilities, and beyond. Should you require any accommodation in applying for this role, or throughout the interview process, please make them known when contacted and we will work with you to help meet your needs.

You will be the dedicated analytical partner to the Self-Serve product team, measuring how new features — a redesigned signup experience, onboarding improvements, and lifecycle campaigns — drive customer activation and growth. You'll own the funnel from acquisition through engagement, define the metrics that matter, and deliver the insights that inform where the business invests next. The ideal candidate pairs analytical rigor with a builder's instinct — turning recurring questions into well-defined, reusable datasets instead of one-off answers — and can translate findings into a clear narrative for both technical and non-technical audiences.

Produce high-impact analyses on Self-Serve performance that directly inform product and go-to-market strategy
Own the Self-Serve funnel — acquisition, signup, onboarding, and engagement — building the dashboards and datasets that give the team real-time visibility into product health

Partner closely with Product and Engineering to validate instrumentation and surface data gaps before they distort the funnel or new features launch — catching the data quality issues that stay invisible until someone goes looking
Turn recurring reporting into well-defined, reusable datasets, replacing one-off queries with durable foundations others can build on
Identify recurring workflows worth automating, and help build the prompts, context, and guardrails that make AI analytics tooling reliable for the wider team

Partner with Data Science & Analytics, Marketing, and other cross-functional stakeholders to inform strategy and drive decisions
Translate insights into a cohesive narrative and present technical findings to senior leadership and non-technical audiences

3+ years of experience in a data analytics or business intelligence role, ideally in a product, growth, or B2B context
Proficiency in SQL — able to write structured and efficient queries on large data sets
Experience with funnel analytics, conversion measurement, and A/B testing (preferred)
Proficiency in a data visualization tool like Tableau, Looker, Mode, or similar

Strong analytical skills with the ability to tackle ambiguous problems, break them down, and deliver clear, actionable insights
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to present complex data to a variety of stakeholders clearly and compellingly
A strong attention to detail and a commitment to data accuracy and integrity
Ability to collaborate across functions, manage competing priorities, and drive projects to completion

Title: Business Intelligence & Data Systems Analyst
Description:
About Labtician

Labtician Ophthalmics is a Canadian-owned pharmaceutical company focused on developing, manufacturing, and marketing innovative ophthalmic products. We offer a collaborative, entrepreneurial environment and supportive team culture, where employees can make a meaningful impact on the business. We offer competitive compensation, benefits and development opportunities. 




Position Summary

The Business Intelligence & Data Systems Analyst plays a critical role in managing and optimizing the company's data ecosystem and transforming data into actionable business insights. This position is responsible for overseeing key data platforms, supporting reporting and analytics initiatives, and partnering directly with business stakeholders to develop KPIs, dashboards, and standardized reporting solutions.

The successful candidate will combine technical expertise with strong business acumen to ensure data integrity, accessibility, and meaningful decision support across the organization.




Key Responsibilities

Data Systems Management

Administer and support the company's data and analytics environment, including Snowflake, Fivetran, Census, Veeva CRM and related data integrations.
Monitor data pipelines and integrations to ensure reliability, accuracy, and timeliness.
Troubleshoot data issues and coordinate resolution with internal and external partners.
Maintain data governance standards, documentation, and system best practices.
Identify opportunities to improve data architecture, automation, and reporting efficiency.

Business Intelligence & Reporting

Develop, maintain, and enhance dashboards, scorecards, and reports using Qlik Sense.
Create and maintain standardized reporting for commercial, finance, operations, and executive teams.
Design and implement KPI frameworks that support strategic decision-making.
Ensure consistency and accuracy of metrics across the organization.
Translate business requirements into scalable reporting and analytics solutions.

Business Partnership

Work closely with stakeholders across Sales, Marketing, Finance, Operations, and Leadership teams to understand reporting needs.
Act as a trusted advisor on data availability, reporting capabilities, and analytical insights.
Support business planning, forecasting, and performance management activities through data analysis.
Present findings and recommendations in a clear and actionable manner.

Data Analysis

Analyze business performance trends and identify opportunities for improvement.
Conduct ad hoc analyses to support strategic initiatives and decision-making.
Validate data quality and investigate discrepancies.
Support special projects involving data integration, automation, and business process improvement.




Qualifications

Required

Bachelor's degree in Business, Data Analytics, Computer Science, Information Systems, Statistics, or a related field.
3–7 years of experience in business intelligence, analytics, data management, or a related role.
Strong experience with Qlik Sense dashboard development and reporting.
Experience working with cloud-based data warehouses such as Snowflake.
Experience managing data integrations and ETL processes.
Strong SQL skills.
Ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills.

Preferred

Experience with Fivetran, Census and Veeva CRM data.
Experience in pharmaceutical, healthcare, life sciences, or regulated industries.
Knowledge of data governance and data quality best practices.
Experience with forecasting, commercial analytics, or KPI development.




Success in This Role

The successful candidate will:

Ensure reliable and scalable data systems that support business operations.
Deliver accurate and insightful reporting that drives decision-making.
Build strong relationships with business stakeholders.
Continuously improve data quality, accessibility, and reporting capabilities.
Serve as a key contributor to the organization's data-driven culture.




Location: Oakville, ON (hybrid 2 days per week in-office currently)

Salary Range: $70-$85K base pay. 




This posting is for an existing, immediate vacancy. Accommodations are available upon request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process. If contacted for an interview, please advise the hiring team if you require any disability-related accommodations.

Title: Manager, eCommerce Analytics & Insights
Description:
Established in 1973, Roots is a proudly Canadian lifestyle brand that celebrates authenticity, quality, and community. Inspired by the great outdoors, we create timeless, sustainable apparel and leather goods designed for comfort and everyday adventure. At Roots, we believe in fostering a culture of inclusivity, creativity, and teamwork – where every team member plays a role in shaping our brand’s legacy. If you bring passion to everything you do, lead with integrity, and believe in the power of collaboration to drive growth, we’d love to have you on our journey!

Nature & Scope → Your Role at Roots

You'll play a key analytical role behind Roots' digital business — turning ecommerce data into the insights that drive strategy, sharpen investment decisions, and support growth online. You're not just tracking what happened; you're helping the business understand why, and what to do next. Sitting at the intersection of Ecommerce, Marketing, and Analytics, you'll own the reporting rhythms, build the forecasts, and surface the opportunities that keep Roots' digital channel moving forward. This is a high-visibility role for someone who is commercially sharp, deeply curious, and passionate about connecting data to real business outcomes.

Key Responsibilities → How You’ll Make An Impact


Act as a key analytics partner for the Ecommerce and digital leadership team — proactively identifying trends, flagging risks, and providing insights to support decision-making.
Deliver the ecommerce performance reporting rhythm — including weekly trading dashboards, channel health reporting, and monthly and quarterly recaps — to support leadership visibility into the digital business.
Define, track, and evolve the KPI framework for ecommerce — including traffic, conversion, AOV, channel mix, and customer acquisition metrics — and translate performance into clear commercial narratives.
Develop and maintain ecommerce forecasts to support planning cycles and investment discussions, including weekly, monthly, and seasonal demand forecasts by channel, category, and key business driver.
Own the hindsighting process for ecommerce — conducting structured post-period reviews that compare actuals to plan, identify what drove variance, and translate learnings into sharper forecasts and better commercial decisions going forward.
Analyze the full digital funnel — from traffic source through to purchase — identifying drop-off points, conversion opportunities, and UX issues that can be acted on by the Ecom and product teams.
Partner with Paid Media, CRM, and Brand Marketing to evaluate campaign and channel effectiveness, connecting marketing spend to revenue outcomes and helping teams optimize where investment is deployed.
Monitor and interpret customer behaviour on-site — including search performance, product page engagement, wishlist trends, and mobile vs. desktop patterns — to surface assortment and experience insights.
Support the A/B testing and experimentation program — helping teams design tests, measure results rigorously, and build a culture of evidence-based iteration.
Answer the hard business questions through ad-hoc analysis — whether it's diagnosing a conversion drop, sizing a new market opportunity, or understanding the true ROI of a promotional event.
Build and maintain Power BI dashboards that give the Ecom and Marketing teams self-serve visibility into their most important KPIs — without needing to pull a report themselves.
Leverage AI and analytics tools to improve the speed, accuracy, and depth of insight generation — and bring a forward-looking perspective on where automation and machine learning can strengthen our ecommerce analytics capability.


Required

Qualifications & Experience → The Skills You Bring


6+ years of experience in ecommerce analytics, digital analytics, or a closely related field, ideally within retail or a consumer brand environment.
Deep understanding of ecommerce performance drivers — traffic, conversion, AOV, channel mix, customer acquisition, and retention — and proven ability to connect metrics to commercial outcomes.
Strong experience with BI tools (Power BI preferred) building dashboards and reports that stakeholders use consistently.
Proficiency with web analytics platforms (GA4 preferred) and the ability to interpret customer journey data across the full digital funnel.
Experience building and maintaining ecommerce forecasts and sales planning models, including seasonal and weekly demand forecasting.
Comfort with hindsighting and post-period analysis — able to close the loop between plan and actuals and turn variance analysis into forward-looking recommendations.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with demonstrated experience presenting to commercial and executive audiences.
Ability to synthesize complex data into clear, decision-ready narratives for non-technical stakeholders.


Nice to Have


SQL or Python experience for self-serve data exploration and more complex analyses.
Familiarity with paid media platforms (Meta, Google, TikTok) and experience evaluating their performance holistically — beyond platform-reported metrics.
Experience with Snowflake or similar cloud data platforms.
Background in omnichannel retail — understanding how digital behaviour connects to in-store and loyalty outcomes.


You Are


A storyteller first — you know that a great insight is only as valuable as how well it's communicated.
Proactive and commercially minded, always connecting data back to business outcomes and growth opportunities.
Naturally curious and relentlessly diagnostic — you're never satisfied with "what happened" and always dig into the "why" to uncover the insight behind the number.
Organized and delivery-focused, able to manage a reporting cadence, a forecast cycle, and ad-hoc requests at the same time without dropping the ball.
Comfortable with ambiguity and skilled at prioritizing the questions that matter most in a fast-moving retail environment.


At Roots we appreciate that skills and expertise are cultivated through a range of experiences. We are committed to reflecting Canada's diverse landscape in our products, team, and workplace culture. We value your unique perspective and encourage you to apply, even if you don't meet every listed requirement. Accommodations are available for applicants throughout the recruitment process.

Please note: Roots uses technology-assisted tools, including artificial intelligence (AI), to support parts of the recruitment process. These tools may be used to help review applications, assess qualifications, and support interview documentation. All hiring decisions are reviewed and made by our Talent team and key leaders involved in the recruitment process.

The posted salary range is intended to reflect the competitive market value of this role and is provided to support transparency in our hiring process. Final compensation will be determined based on a variety of factors, including but not limited to internal equity, relevant skills, demonstrated knowledge, experience, and overall fit for the position.

Title: Pricing Analyst
Description:
Clio is the global leader in legal AI technology, empowering legal professionals and law firms of every size to work smarter, faster, and more securely.

We are transforming the legal experience for all by bettering the lives of legal professionals while increasing access to justice.

Summary:

We are currently seeking a Pricing Analyst to join our Marketing Team in Vancouver, Calgary, or Toronto.

What your team does:

The Monetization team leads Clio’s AI-first pricing and packaging strategy and execution across all regions, including initiatives for new and existing customer segments, products, plans, bundles and cross-portfolio upgrades. This is a highly strategic team contributing to Clio’s success in a highly cross functional role working across nearly all functions at Clio.

Who you are:

You're analytical and curious about customer behaviour, comfortable working through large volumes of data to find the story in the numbers. You like turning ad hoc, manual processes into something repeatable, and you enjoy building partnerships across the business. You're also detail-oriented, organized, and self-managing, with a habit of verifying your own work. You build in checks, flag what looks off, and hold a high bar for accuracy.

What you’ll work on:

As a Pricing Analyst, you'll own the execution and measurement of pricing changes, from account migrations in our billing systems and Salesforce to the modeling, reporting, and testing that tell us whether a change worked.


Own recurring price-based account migrations end to end, from cohort segmentation and batch processing through QA and post-migration validation, and build the formula-driven templates that make them repeatable and auditable at scale
Support the models that price new releases and size the impact of changes on existing customers, and help package the findings into recommendations
Partner with Data & Insights to build the dashboards and automated reporting that track realized vs. list price, discount depth, and ARPA by cohort, so the team catches problems early
Work across Billing Ops, Sales Ops, CS Ops, and Enablement to automate the manual steps in pricing execution and equip Sales and CS when prices change
Help design and run in-market price tests to validate willingness to pay before changes roll out broadly
Use AI tooling to compress the analysis and execution cycle, from generating and QA'ing migration cohorts to automating the handoff into Salesforce and building intuitive internal pricing calculators and price sheets


What you may have:


2+ years in financial or business analysis and modeling, preferably for B2B SaaS, including heavy spreadsheet work with nested logic and QA across large datasets
Hands-on experience in a subscription billing system (Zuora, Stripe, Chargebee, or similar) and a CRM like Salesforce, including bulk updates and data validation across large account sets
2+ years building dashboards and queries in Looker, Tableau, or similar
Experience with pricing analysis across SaaS charge models, such as subscription, usage-based, tiered, and per-seat
Experience running cross-functional projects in Asana or similar, coordinating with ops and GTM teams to keep work moving
Strong communication skills, with the ability to deliver clear status updates, business insights, and recommendations in written, presentation, and spoken form
Experience using AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini) to support analysis, workflows, and day-to-day productivity


Serious bonus points if you have:


Experience with Workato or similar integration and task-automation tools
Prior experience executing pricing or plan migrations at scale


This role is a backfill for an existing position.

What you will find here:

Compensation is one of the main components of Clio’s Total Rewards Program. We have developed a series of programs and processes to ensure we are creating fair and competitive pay practices that form the foundation of our human and high-performing culture.

Some highlights of our Total Rewards program include:


Competitive, equitable salary with top-tier health benefits, dental, and vision insurance
Hybrid work environment, with expectation for local Clions (Vancouver, Calgary, Toronto, Dublin, London, New York City and Sydney) to be in office min. twice per week.
Flexible time off policy, with an encouraged 20 days off per year.
$2000 annual counseling benefit
RRSP matching and RESP contribution
Clioversary recognition program with special acknowledgement at 3, 5, 7, and 10 years


The expected salary range for this role is $97,300 to $131,700 CAD. Initial placement within the range is informed by geographic region, experience, and skillset, with room to progress as impact and tenure grow. Final offer amounts will vary based on candidate profile.

Diversity, Inclusion, Belonging and Equity (DIBE) & Accessibility

Our team shows up as their authentic selves, and are united by our mission. We are dedicated to diversity, equity and inclusion. We pride ourselves in building and fostering an environment where our teams feel included, valued, and enabled to do the best work of their careers, wherever they choose to log in from. We believe that different perspectives, skills, backgrounds, and experiences result in higher-performing teams and better innovation. We are committed to equal employment and we encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.

Clio provides accessibility accommodations during the recruitment process. Should you require any accommodation, please let us know and we will work with you to meet your needs.

Learn more about our culture at clio.com/careers

We're a Human and High Performing AI company, meaning we use artificial intelligence to improve all of our operations. In recruitment, AI helps us streamline the process for greater efficiency. However, we've built our systems to ensure that a human always reviews AI-generated output, and we never make automated hiring decisions.

Disclaimer: We only communicate with candidates through official @clio.com email addresses.

Title: Data Operations Analyst (Contract)
Description:
Choose a workplace that empowers your impact.

Join a global workplace where employees thrive. One that embraces diversity of thought, expertise and experience. A place where you can personalize your employee journey to be — and deliver — your best.

We are a purpose-driven, dynamic and sustainable pension plan. An industry leading global investor with teams in Toronto to London, New York, Singapore, Sydney and other major cities across North America and Europe. We embody the values of our 665,000 members, placing their best interests at the heart of everything we do.

Join us to accelerate your growth & development, prioritize wellness, build connections, and support the communities where we live and work.

Don’t just work anywhere — come build tomorrow together with us.

Know someone at OMERS or Oxford Properties? Great! If you're referred, have them submit your name through Workday first. Then, watch for a unique link in your email to apply.

As a Data Operations Analyst, Investment Data Operations, you will help deliver accurate, timely, and complete market reference data across core systems and business processes. This role supports investment operations, finance, risk, and reporting by applying analytical problem-solving and root cause analysis. In a dynamic, time-sensitive environment, you will be expected to manage multiple priorities, re-prioritize effectively as needs change, and maintain strong attention to detail with a data quality mindset. You will work closely with internal partners and external vendors, using clear communication and cross-functional coordination to resolve data issues, strengthen operational controls, and provide a high-quality data service that enables better business outcomes.

This is a 12-month direct contract opportunity.

You Will Be Responsible For


Support daily market reference data operations, including security setup, onboarding, maintenance, and timely delivery across core systems and reporting processes.
Monitor, investigate, and resolve data exceptions, breaks, and control report issues in partnership with internal teams and external vendors.
Analyze data issues to identify root causes, assess business impact, and recommend practical solutions that improve data quality and operational efficiency.
Support stakeholder requests for data enhancements, operational improvements, and new business requirements.
Document operational procedures, workflows, data definitions, and controls to improve consistency, transparency, and knowledge sharing.
Review and validate pricing and valuation data for public and private investments in line with established policies and data quality standards.
Participate in change initiatives, system upgrades, and testing activities, including data validation, user acceptance testing, and implementation support.
Build strong working relationships across Investment Teams, Risk, Performance, Finance, and Technology to support effective data operations.


Required Skills & Experience


2+ years of experience in data operations, investment operations, middle office, back office, or financial systems support.
Knowledge of investment data domains such as reference data, market data, pricing, valuations, and risk analytics.
Understanding of data management principles, including data quality, controls, governance, and lineage.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to investigate issues, assess impact, and communicate findings clearly.
Strong communication and relationship-building skills, with the ability to work effectively across business and technology teams.


Preferred Skills & Experience


University degree in Finance, Commerce, Mathematics, Economics, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Experience with investment platforms, operational data tools, or reporting systems; familiarity with CRD, Calypso, Eagle PACE, or similar platforms is an asset.
Proficiency with Excel and data analysis tools; SQL, Python, Power BI, and workflow tools such as Azure DevOps are assets.


This posting is for an existing vacancy.

The expected salary range for this position is $72,000.00 - $108,000.00 per year.

You may also be eligible to receive an annual Incentive Award pursuant to our Short-term Incentive plan and our Long-Term Incentive plan (if applicable), and to participate in our group benefits and retirement plans – details on these elements of compensation are included within OMERS & Oxford offer letters.

As one of Canada’s largest defined benefit pension plans, our people-first culture is at its best when our workforce reflects the communities where we live and work — and the members we proudly serve.

From hire to retire, we are an equal opportunity employer committed to an inclusive, barrier-free recruitment and selection process that extends all the way through your employee experience. This sense of belonging and connection is cultivated up, down and across our global organization thanks to our vast network of Employee Resource Groups with executive leader sponsorship, our Purpose@Work committee and employee recognition programs.

Artificial intelligence (AI) tools are used to support certain stages of the OMERS recruitment process. While AI assists us in our process, human judgment and decision-making remain central to our candidate experience.

Title: MarTech Data & Insights Specialist
Description:
Company Description

About Us:

With a history that dates back over 80 years, Starcom is a global communications planning and media leader. We are an agency still grounded in our founding principle that people are at center of all we do. Each day, we apply this belief to harness the transformative power of data and technology to inspire and move people and business forward. With more than 7,000 employees in over 100 offices around the world, Starcom partners with the world's leading marketers and brands.

Within Canada, Starcom is a part of Publicis Media within Publicis Groupe, one of the world’s leading communications groups. Our team spans across our Windsor, Toronto and Montreal offices. We truly love the world of Media and Advertising. We see the planning and buying process as art. However, it is an art that is always best when backed by the science of empirical data.

You will be joining a well recognised agency with credentials:


Great Places to Work certified three years in a row
Only communications company to be ranked in LinkedIn’s Top 25 Great Places to Work
2022 Media Agency of the Year
2023 Media Agency of the Year finalist


What We Offer


Work Your World program enabling you to experience working from anywhere in Canada or overseas for up to 6 weeks a year
Extended long weekends throughout the year with an additional day off each long weekend
Wellness & Tech benefits to support what’s most important to you
Birthday leave
Extensive Learning & Development opportunities, including more than 15,000 learning programs via our online learning platform as well as a Professional Development Allowance
Local and Global Mobility within the Publicis Groupe network


Overview

The Data Activation Specialist will be responsible for utilizing digital platforms and transforming vast data sets into actionable insights that inform targeting and optimization; specifically,

connecting or extracting data, tracking, measuring, and analyzing and optimizing digital media for improved conversion and business performance. You will be part of a growing team, reporting to the Data Activation Manager and will have the opportunity to learn and grow in the emerging field of data strategy, data activation and data analysis.

Responsibilities


Ingest disparate digital data sources across Paid, Owned and Earned Digital Media into a consolidated environment for tracking
Learn how to set up automated process for data extraction, via API, SFTP, SQL etc.
Extract, transform and load data for ingestion into business intelligence platforms
Learn how to build dashboards in business intelligence platforms
Build and deploy semi-automated Excel and PowerPoint digital reporting solutions such as campaign performance tracking
Provide the Planning and Buying teams with analysis, insights and data-informed recommendations from the aforementioned reporting areas
Opportunity to work across key business intelligence platforms for digital media, mainly Datorama
Translate strategy into implementation tactics Data mapping and enhancement
Create segments relevant to objectives that can be pushed to relevant destinations for activation
Translate objectives into digital media measurement plans
Analyze and report on campaign performance through standardized ad-server attribution models
Learn how to build simplistic algorithmic attribution models and implement them
Work alongside data scientists to deploy more complex algorithmic attribution models
Make data-informed recommendations for optimizing digital media and content
Opportunity to work on key attribution platforms such as Google’s Data-Driven
Attribution model with DoubleClick, and proprietary Publicis Media platforms


Qualifications


3-4 years’ experience in Digital Media in Planning/Buying and/or 1 – 2 years Data Science experience
Technically competent and capable of working with and learning new digital and tech platforms
Strong numerical and analytical skills
Demonstrated ability to convert data analysis into meaningful action for brands
Experience with or strong knowledge of ad servers and web analytics platforms such as
DoubleClick, Adobe Media Optimizer, Sizmek, Google Analytics or Adobe Omniture
Effective written and verbal communication skills
Ability to cope under pressure and deliver to tight deadlines autonomously.


Additional Information

We’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. Accommodations are available throughout the hiring process upon request.

Salary

Transparency matters to us. The salary range for this position is $45 - 50k per year. Actual compensation within this range will be based on a variety of factors, including relevant experience, knowledge, skills, and applicable certifications. This range reflects what we reasonably expect to offer based on current market data.

AI Use

We use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of our hiring process, such as reviewing applications or analyzing resumes. These tools assist our recruitment team but never replace human decision-making. We believe in a human-first approach, where your experience and potential are recognized by people.

Starcom is an equal opportunity employer with a strong commitment to diversity and inclusion. We create and nurture a vibrant work environment that celebrates, values and leverages all aspects of diversity and inclusiveness, attracts world-class talent and serves as the industry benchmark for best practices. We encourage applications from all qualified individuals and will provide appropriate accommodation for candidates with disabilities or accessibility needs throughout the recruitment process, upon request. Please contact our recruiter for any questions, accommodations or specific requests. We thank all candidates for their interest in Starcom however, only those candidates selected for an interview will be contacted

Title: E-commerce Inventory Analyst
Description:
TEAMMATES WANTED

Working at Bauer is like playing on a hockey team. We empower each other to be our best. Everyone on the team has an important role to play. You might be leading others or collaborating with teammates on a big project. Whatever your title, you are part of something bigger than yourself.

Founded in 1927, Bauer Hockey developed the first skate. Since then, our passion for the game, drive for innovation, and commitment to the hockey community have made us the most trusted brand in hockey.




Purpose & Core Values

Our purpose at Bauer is to enrich life experiences through sports. We have the responsibility to cultivate the future of our brands. We are always “we” and never “I”. We love what we do. We believe anything is possible and work to be our best. We strive to always redefine the standard of excellence in all that we do.




Want to join our team as an E-commerce Inventory Analyst?




Reporting into the DTC Planning Manager, the E-commerce Inventory Analyst will primarily focus on driving business results through inventory management to meet evolving business needs for Bauer Hockey. This role will be responsible for purchasing, reporting, and monitoring of inventory for the Direct-to-Consumer business. This individual thrives in a fast-paced environment, is detail oriented and brings an entrepreneurial work style.




Essential Job Functions & Responsibilities

Build, maintain and disseminate weekly reports showcasing the performance of Bauer Hockey’s direct to consumer channels.
Propose recommended buys to meet consumer needs based on trends and product launches.
Monitor inventory levels across websites and realms. Place replenishment orders when inventory becomes low on popular items under the direction of the DTC Planning Manager.
Represent DTC team in key cross-functional meetings.
Develop new reports and visualizations that provide your team members with insights.
Fulfill ad-hoc data requests for peers and leadership. This may include data retrieval, building slides and assisting with data-supported recommendations.
Take initiative to monitor trends and discover patterns that can be used to grow the business, improve the digital experience and/or lead us to better outcomes.
Ensures integrity of information reported/presented.




Qualifications

Minimum 3-5 years of experience in forecasting, buying, or supply chain, preferably for an ecommerce business.
Proficiency with Excel, SAP, Anaplan, and cloud-based BI tools, preferably Google, AWS or Tableau.
Experience with Shopify Platform, Google Analytics, Klayvio, Google Ad Words, Facebook Ads Manager is an asset.
Experience in developing reports and dashboards, preferably for an ecommerce business.
Ability to apply data to challenges and transform those into opportunities to astound the consumer or drive operational efficiencies
Tremendous storytelling ability with the ability to weave data into the recommendation.
Excellent interpersonal skills and ability to effectively communicate at all levels of organization.
Curious by nature with a keen sense of what’s normal and what’s anomalous.
Hockey or Lacrosse playing experience would be highly beneficial.
Excellent partner who fosters a team approach to business.
Maintain a high degree of professionalism and confidentiality.




Interested yet? Good. We are, too. We're pretty sure you’ll want to know this position is eligible to participate in the Company’s incentive plan. We also offer one of the most generous benefits packages around including a retirement savings plan with employer match, an employee discount program on apparel and gear, casual & hybrid work environment and a host of other perks we don't have room to mention here.




We are committed to employing a diverse workforce and are an equal opportunity employer.

Title: Data & Analytics Consultant
Description:
You’ve Never Been Satisfied with “Good Enough.”




You want to make an impact, not just manage projects, but change how the world gets built. At Accenture Infrastructure & Capital Projects, you’ll do exactly that. You’ll help develop and deliver the factories, grids, transit systems, and public infrastructure that keep communities moving - and do it smarter, safer, and more sustainably than ever before.




You’ll work alongside people who think big and act bold - project managers, engineers, technologists, and strategists who blend real-world experience with digital innovation and AI.




Together, we’re transforming how capital projects are planned, managed, and executed, creating a better way to build for the future.




Because “good enough” builds the past. You’re here to build what’s next, on a team that outperforms every norm.




Visit us here to learn more about Accenture Infrastructure & Capital Projects




(Internal Title: Business System Configuration / Development II)
Client Relationship & Stakeholder Management: Act as the primary bridge between the client’s business teams (Engineering, Construction, Procurement) and the technical data team. You will navigate complex stakeholder dynamics and manage expectations in a high-pressure environment.
Requirements Translation: Lead requirements workshops and working sessions to uncover business needs, clarify ambiguous requirements, and define KPIs aligned to how capital programs are actually managed. Translate business questions into clear technical specifications, data models, and reporting logic.
Business Intelligence & Visualization: Design and develop interactive, high impact executive dashboards in Power BI. You will be responsible for the "last mile" of data delivery—ensuring insights are accurate, intuitive, and actionable. Apply domain knowledge and program management/project controls expertise to ensure reporting products align to best practices.
Data Logic & Engineering: Work within the client’s Snowflake & Power BI environment to design robust data models. While you will collaborate with architects, you must be capable of writing complex SQL transformations to clean, normalize, and prepare EPC data (Oracle Primavera P6, and other PMIS tools etc.) for reporting.
Quality Assurance: Own the validity of the data. You will trace numbers from the dashboard back to the source to ensure trust and alignment with business rules.
Process Oversight: Collaborate with the technical team to monitor CI/CD pipelines (GitHub/DevOps) and troubleshoot data ingestion issues that impact reporting availability.
Working Conditions:
Hybrid: This role's work location is primarily onsite with our client and partners to enable delivery and cultivate our client relationships, but will see some travel to various client sites at key project milestones.




HERE’S WHAT YOU’LL NEED:

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Business, Engineering, or a related field.
5+ years of experience in Business Intelligence, Project Controls, Data Analytics, or Analytics Engineering.
Stakeholder Management: Proven track record of managing "hard" client relationships, navigating pushback, and driving consensus across technical and non-technical teams.
Power BI Mastery: Advanced proficiency in Power BI, including DAX, data modeling, and UI/UX design principles for executive reporting.
Domain Knowledge: Understanding of capital project controls, scheduling, or construction management
Snowflake & SQL: Strong SQL skills with the ability to query, transform, and model data within Snowflake. You must understand how to prepare data for optimal BI performance.
Data Translation: Experience taking raw data from disparate systems (CSV, Excel, JSON) and turning it into a cohesive business story (Star schema, dimensional modeling).
Agile Collaboration: Comfort working with JIRA, Git, and agile methodologies.
Holding recognized Project Management certification (CAPM, PMP, etc.)




BONUS POINTS IF YOU HAVE:

Technical Depth: Familiarity with Python, dbt, or Azure Data Factory for advanced ETL scenarios
Certifications: SnowPro Core, Microsoft Power BI Data Analyst Associate (PL-300), and PMP/CSM
Ability to arrange priorities and escalate competing risks to meet deadlines
Keen eye for detail and adept problem-solving abilities
Must have demonstrated experience relaying and receiving information (written and verbal)
Effective skills in Microsoft Office
Equipped to work independently and as part of a team

Title: Specialist Data & Analytics
Description:
Job Description

The Opportunity

We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Data and Analytics Specialist to join our growing Data and Analytics team. The ideal candidate will bring deep technical expertise in Snowflake, Azure cloud services, SQL, Python and Power BI, to help design, develop, and optimize data solutions that support strategic initiatives across the organization.

Key Accountabilities


Develop, optimize, and maintain robust data pipelines and ETL processes using Azure Data Factory, Azure Data Lake, and Snowflake.
Write, read, and debug complex SQL queries and Snowflake stored procedures to support data transformation and reporting needs.
Create and deploy scalable Python scripts and Azure Functions for automation, data processing, and advanced analytics.
Collaborate with business stakeholders to understand data requirements and translate them into technical specifications.
Support data governance, quality assurance, and metadata management practices across the organization.
Contribute to the design and documentation of enterprise data models and pipelines.
Develop and maintain analytical reports, dashboards and semantic models using Power BI
Monitor pipeline performance and implement improvements for reliability, scalability, and efficiency.
Stay current with industry trends and best practices in cloud data engineering and analytics.



Qualifications

Education:


Undergraduate degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or related STEM field; a Master’s degree is an asset.



Experience:


Snowflake certification (e.g., SnowPro Core or Advanced Architect) strongly preferred.
At least 3-5 years of experience using a modern data stack with hands-on use of:
Snowflake (warehousing, streams, tasks, UDFs)
Azure Data Factory, Azure Data Lake, Azure Functions
SQL (advanced query development and debugging)
Python (data processing and automation)

Skills & Abilities:


Functional experience with data visualization tools (e.g., Power BI) is required.
DevOps practices is a strong asset.
Strong analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills.
Demonstrated ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.



Effort


Requires sustained mental focus for data analysis, debugging, pipeline optimization, and report development
Involves frequent use of computer systems and cloud-based tools for extended periods
Requires multitasking and prioritizing requests from multiple stakeholders in a dynamic environment
Attention to detail is critical when handling complex data queries, coding scripts, and quality checks



Working Conditions


Work is primarily performed in a corporate office setting with the flexibility of a hybrid work model
May involve occasional extended hours during system deployments, data migrations, or project deadlines
Requires regular virtual collaboration with cross-functional teams and business stakeholders
Must be comfortable working in a fast-paced, agile, and evolving technical environment

Responsible for maintenance and quality of existing product information to ensure complete and accurate information in the Product Information Management (PIM) System. You Will


Execute analysis and track progress of initiatives for global and Acklands-Grainger supplier and purchasing functions

What is the Opportunity?

Reporting to the Project Controls Manager, the Senior Reporting & Analytics Lead will lead project reporting, business intelligence, and analytics initiatives, delivering integrated reporting solutions that provide visibility into project performance. The role will drive the adoption of Microsoft Power Platform technologies, integrate data across multiple enterprise systems, establish reporting governance standards, and provide actionable insights on cost, schedule, risk, and operational performance to support informed decision-making and continuous improvement across the project lifecycle.

What You'll Do Here


Develop, maintain, and continually enhance an integrated project reporting framework, ensuring consistency, accuracy, and alignment across cost, schedule, risk, resource, estimating, and operational reporting.
Lead the design, development, deployment, and governance of Microsoft Power Platform solutions, including Power BI, Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse, Microsoft Fabric, and related technologies to support reporting, analytics, automation, and operational processes.
Lead the integration of project systems including SAP, Primavera P6, InEight, Aconex, SharePoint, Microsoft Teams, and other enterprise platforms, ensuring data consistency and scalability across reporting and analytics solutions.
Develop reporting requirements in collaboration with stakeholders, management, and operations teams, and deliver standardized reporting solutions that provide meaningful insights into project performance and support data-driven decision-making.
Analyze and report on project performance, including cost, schedule, progress, forecasting, trends, risks, opportunities, and other key performance indicators, providing actionable recommendations to senior leadership and project executives.
Establish reporting and data governance standards, including KPI definitions, reporting controls, data validation processes, reporting calendars, data ownership, quality assurance processes, and a single source of truth for project performance reporting.
Provide leadership and subject matter expertise in reporting, analytics, data management, and Power Platform solutions, promoting best practices and supporting capability development across the project team.
Identify and implement continuous improvement initiatives that enhance reporting processes, streamline workflows, improve operational efficiency, and maximize project performance.



What You Bring To The Team


Minimum 6 years' experience in reporting, business intelligence, project controls, data analytics, or a related role, preferably within large-scale construction, infrastructure, transit, rail, or transportation projects.
Post-secondary education in Business Administration, Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, Statistics, Economics, Data Analytics, or a related discipline.
Advanced experience with Microsoft Power Platform, including Power BI, Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse, and Microsoft Fabric, with demonstrated experience developing enterprise reporting, analytics, and workflow automation solutions. Microsoft Power BI, Power Platform, Fabric, or related Microsoft certifications are considered an asset.
Strong technical expertise in data modeling, semantic models, dimensional modeling, DAX, Power Query (M), SQL, and enterprise reporting architecture. Experience with Python, R, SAP Webi, or other analytics tools is considered an asset.
Experience integrating data from multiple enterprise systems, including ERP, scheduling, financial, document control, and operational platforms, into scalable reporting and analytics solutions.
Experience establishing reporting governance frameworks, KPI definitions, data quality standards, reporting controls, and performance management processes.
Strong understanding of project controls principles, including cost management, scheduling, forecasting, progress measurement, change management, and Earned Value Management (EVM). Knowledge of industry best practices such as PMI and AACEI is considered an asset.
Excellent communication, presentation, stakeholder management, and relationship-building skills, with the ability to effectively communicate insights and recommendations to all levels of the organization.
Proven ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced project environment while maintaining a high level of accuracy, attention to detail, and professionalism.
Must be able to travel to other project sites/offices.
Background checks required.
Valid Driver’s License.

Job Description Summary

We are seeking an Analyst, Business Intelligence to support the design, development, and maintenance of interactive dashboards and reports for Inventory Management stakeholders. Responsibilities

Job Description


Design, develop, and maintain Power BI dashboards and reports for Inventory Management processes (e.g., inventory health, stock levels, turns, aging, service levels, fill rate, OTIF, and KPI tracking).
Collaborate with Inventory Management, Demand Planning, and Purchasing stakeholders to gather business requirements and translate them into scalable reporting and analytics solutions.
Build and optimize Power BI data models, measures, and relationships to support inventory visibility and decision-making.
Develop and maintain ETL processes using Power Query and related data transformation tools to integrate inventory, supply, and demand data.
Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and integrity across inventory reports and analytics outputs.
Manage and maintain Power BI workspaces, including access control, deployment pipelines, and governance practices.
Leverage Microsoft Fabric capabilities (e.g., dataflows, lakehouse, semantic models) to enhance data integration, scalability, and performance of inventory analytics.
Work with data from ERP systems (e.g., SAP), warehouse management systems, and other enterprise data sources.
Optimize report performance and troubleshoot issues related to data refresh, model performance, and visualization efficiency.
Document data models, report logic, KPIs, and business definitions related to inventory management.
Provide training and support to end-users on Power BI dashboards and self-service inventory analytics capabilities.
Support continuous improvement initiatives focused on inventory optimization, working capital reduction, and service level performance.
Leverage Python for advanced data analysis, automation, and data transformation (e.g., building data pipelines, performing complex calculations, and enhancing Power BI datasets through integrated workflows).


Qualifications


3–5 years of experience in BI/reporting roles, with at least 2–3 years of hands-on experience in Power BI.
Strong proficiency in:
Power BI Desktop & Service
Power Query (M language)
Data modeling concepts
Solid understanding of Inventory Management and accounting principles.
Strong SQL skills and experience working with relational databases.
Experience integrating data from ERP systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle, Dynamics, etc.) is an asset.
Hands-on experience with Power BI Service, including workspace management and deployment pipelines.
Familiarity with Microsoft Fabric (Dataflows Gen2, Lakehouse, or related components) is an asset.
Ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.

Title: Lead Analyst (Hybrid/Toronto Based)
Description:
About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

Get to Know our Team:

The Supply Analytics team delivers data-driven insights and decision support to optimize Agoda’s supply ecosystem. We analyze partner and marketplace dynamics, build forecasts and models, run experiments, and create scalable dashboards and data products that power strategic direction and operational execution. We bring value through rigorous analyses and pragmatic, measurable recommendations that help Supply, Product and other teams prioritize work and drive impact. Our work improves inventory quality, partner economics, and the long-term health and growth of Agoda.

The Opportunity:

As a Lead Analyst/Senior Analyst, you will report directly to either the Senior Manager or Associate Director within the Supply Department and this will be an individual contributor role. You will be responsible and fully empowered to work with the partners on the ground. You will be supported by a team within the Supply department and work closely with other Team members within Agoda.

In this Role, you’ll get to:


Translate internal briefs into analytical projects (to include refining the initial brief and asking the ‘right questions’, working through potential hypotheses and storyboarding the output)
Use and analyze data from multiple large-scale data warehouses and present statistically strong analysis to a wide range of business stakeholders.
Proactively identify opportunities for growth within supply and the wider business.
Drive new analytical initiatives and projects aimed at improving organizational efficiency and shaping Agoda supply.
Identify, support, and lead projects aimed at scaling up the way the Supply organization leverages on data, insights, and intelligence.
Automate manual operational processes and present back on time savings gained through modernization of business operations


What you’ll Need to Succeed:


At least 2-5+ years of experience working as an Analyst with experience in analytics/data science/insights/strategy/BI
Advanced working knowledge and hands-on experience in SQL
Strong knowledge and hands-on experience in data visualization tools such as Tableau (preferably)
Expert domain of data analysis and data visualization tools and software such as Excel, Python (or R)
Bachelor’s degree ideally in a business or quantitative subject (e.g. computer science, mathematics, engineering, science, economics or finance).
A good understanding of statistical modelling knowledge or any machine learning technique knowledge (such as hypothesis testing, regression, logistic regression, random forest, etc.)
Good stakeholder management experience. Comfortable presenting to senior leadership.
Experience in conducting A/B testing experimentation
Strong experience in finding data insights and provide business recommendation to the business
A hacker’s mindset – the ability to build simple but clever and elegant solutions to new problems within significant resource, operational and time constraints through deep understanding of the business, creative problem solving, and a wide range of expertise in data, analytics, automation, programming, and prototyping.
Excellent communicator with superior written, verbal, presentation and interpersonal communication skills.
Data driven in both decision making and performance measurement.
Extreme comfort in ambiguous, fast-paced environment.
Ability to multi-task, prioritize and coordinate resources.
Willingness and able to work 2-3 evenings per week to meet with the Bangkok office and regional partners.


It’s Great if you Have:


MBA or Masters in a quantitative subject (e.g. computer science, mathematics, engineering, science, economics or finance).
Program management certifications (e.g. PMI, PRINCE2) to compliment your program management experience.
Asian market experience.
Travel industry / e-commerce / tech / consulting experience.


There are a variety of factors that go into determining a salary range, including but not limited to external market benchmark data, geographic location, and years of experience sought/required. In addition to a competitive base salary, roles are eligible to be considered for an annual bonus.

The range for Ontario area is $80,000-120,000 CAD.
